css-value:align-items:flex-start.description: The cross-start margin edge of the flex item is placed flush with the cross-start edge of the line.

css-value:align-items:stretch.description: If the cross size property of the flex item computes to auto, and neither of the cross-axis margins are auto, the flex item is stretched.

css:justify-items.description: Defines the default justify-self for all items of the box, giving them the default way of justifying each box along the appropriate axis
css:justify-items.syntax: justify-items: normal | stretch | <baseline-position> | <overflow-position>? [ <self-position> | left | right ] | legacy | legacy && [ left | right | center ] | anchor-center;

css-value:justify-items:flex-end.description: "Flex items are packed toward the end of the line."

css-value:justify-items:flex-start.description: "Flex items are packed toward the start of the line."

css-value:justify-items:self-end.description: The item is packed flush to the edge of the alignment container of the end side of the item, in the appropriate axis.

css-value:justify-items:self-start.description: The item is packed flush to the edge of the alignment container of the start side of the item, in the appropriate axis..

css-value:justify-items:center.description: The items are packed flush to each other toward the center of the of the alignment container.

css-value:justify-items:stretch.description: If the cross size property of the flex item computes to auto, and neither of the cross-axis margins are auto, the flex item is stretched.

css:justify-self.description: Defines the way of justifying a box inside its container along the appropriate axis.
css:justify-self.syntax: justify-self: auto | normal | stretch | <baseline-position> | <overflow-position>? [ <self-position> | left | right ] | anchor-center;

css-value:justify-self:flex-end.description: "Flex items are packed toward the end of the line."

css-value:justify-self:flex-start.description: "Flex items are packed toward the start of the line."

css-value:justify-self:self-end.description: The item is packed flush to the edge of the alignment container of the end side of the item, in the appropriate axis.

css-value:justify-self:self-start.description: The item is packed flush to the edge of the alignment container of the start side of the item, in the appropriate axis..

css-value:justify-self:center.description: The items are packed flush to each other toward the center of the of the alignment container.

css-value:justify-self:stretch.description: If the cross size property of the flex item computes to auto, and neither of the cross-axis margins are auto, the flex item is stretched.

css:align-self.description: Allows the default alignment along the cross axis to be overridden for individual flex items.

css-value:align-self:auto.description: Computes to the value of 'align-items' on the element's parent, or 'stretch' if the element has no parent. On absolutely positioned elements, it computes to itself.

css-value:align-self:baseline.description: If the flex item's inline axis is the same as the cross axis, this value is identical to 'flex-start'. Otherwise, it participates in baseline alignment.

css-value:align-self:center.description: The flex item's margin box is centered in the cross axis within the line.

css-value:align-self:flex-end.description: The cross-end margin edge of the flex item is placed flush with the cross-end edge of the line.

css-value:align-self:flex-start.description: The cross-start margin edge of the flex item is placed flush with the cross-start edge of the line.

css-value:align-self:stretch.description: If the cross size property of the flex item computes to auto, and neither of the cross-axis margins are auto, the flex item is stretched.

css:all.description: Shorthand that resets all properties except 'direction' and 'unicode-bidi'.
css:all.syntax: all: initial | inherit | unset | revert | revert-layer;

css:alt.description: Provides alternative text for assistive technology to replace the generated content of a ::before or ::after element.

css:animation.description: Shorthand property combines six of the animation properties into a single property.

css-value:animation:alternate.description: The animation cycle iterations that are odd counts are played in the normal direction, and the animation cycle iterations that are even counts are played in a reverse direction.

css-value:animation:alternate-reverse.description: The animation cycle iterations that are odd counts are played in the reverse direction, and the animation cycle iterations that are even counts are played in a normal direction.

css-value:animation:backwards.description: The beginning property value (as defined in the first @keyframes at-rule) is applied before the animation is displayed, during the period defined by 'animation-delay'.

css-value:animation:both.description: Both forwards and backwards fill modes are applied.

css-value:animation:forwards.description: The final property value (as defined in the last @keyframes at-rule) is maintained after the animation completes.

css-value:animation:infinite.description: Causes the animation to repeat forever.

css-value:animation:reverse.description: All iterations of the animation are played in the reverse direction from the way they were specified.

css:animation-delay.description: Defines when the animation will start.

css:animation-direction.description: Defines whether or not the animation should play in reverse on alternate cycles.

css-value:animation-direction:alternate.description: The animation cycle iterations that are odd counts are played in the normal direction, and the animation cycle iterations that are even counts are played in a reverse direction.

css-value:animation-direction:alternate-.description: The animation cycle iterations that are odd counts are played in the reverse direction, and the animation cycle iterations that are even counts are played in a normal direction.

css-value:animation-direction:reverse.description: All iterations of the animation are played in the reverse direction from the way they were specified.

css:animation-duration.description: Defines the length of time that an animation takes to complete one cycle.

css:animation-fill-mode.description: Defines what values are applied by the animation outside the time it is executing.

css-value:animation-fill-mode:backwards.description: The beginning property value (as defined in the first @keyframes at-rule) is applied before the animation is displayed, during the period defined by 'animation-delay'.

css-value:animation-fill-mode:both.description: Both forwards and backwards fill modes are applied.

css-value:animation-fill-mode:forwards.description: The final property value (as defined in the last @keyframes at-rule) is maintained after the animation completes.

css-value:animation-fill-mode:none.description: There is no change to the property value between the time the animation is applied and the time the animation begins playing or after the animation completes.

css:animation-iteration-count.description: Defines the number of times an animation cycle is played. The default value is one, meaning the animation will play from beginning to end once.

css-value:animation-iteration-count:infi.description: Causes the animation to repeat forever.

css:animation-name.description: Defines a list of animations that apply. Each name is used to select the keyframe at-rule that provides the property values for the animation.

css:animation-play-state.description: Defines whether the animation is running or paused.

css-value:animation-play-state:paused.description: A running animation will be paused.

css-value:animation-play-state:running.description: Resume playback of a paused animation.

css:animation-timing-function.description: Describes how the animation will progress over one cycle of its duration.

css:backface-visibility.description: Determines whether or not the 'back' side of a transformed element is visible when facing the viewer. With an identity transform, the front side of an element faces the viewer.

css:background.description: Shorthand property for setting most background properties at the same place in the style sheet.

css-value:background:fixed.description: The background is fixed with regard to the viewport. In paged media where there is no viewport, a 'fixed' background is fixed with respect to the page box and therefore replicated on every page.

css-value:background:local.description: The background is fixed with regard to the element's contents: if the element has a scrolling mechanism, the background scrolls with the element's contents.

css-value:background:none.description: A value of 'none' counts as an image layer but draws nothing.

css-value:background:scroll.description: The background is fixed with regard to the element itself and does not scroll with its contents. (It is effectively attached to the element's border.)

css:background-attachment.description: Specifies whether the background images are fixed with regard to the viewport ('fixed') or scroll along with the element ('scroll') or its contents ('local').

css-value:background-attachment:fixed.description: The background is fixed with regard to the viewport. In paged media where there is no viewport, a 'fixed' background is fixed with respect to the page box and therefore replicated on every page.

css-value:background-attachment:local.description: The background is fixed with regard to the element's contents: if the element has a scrolling mechanism, the background scrolls with the element's contents.

css-value:background-attachment:scroll.description: The background is fixed with regard to the element itself and does not scroll with its contents. (It is effectively attached to the element's border.)

css:background-blend-mode.description: Defines the blending mode of each background layer.

css-value:background-blend-mode:normal.description: Default attribute which specifies no blending

css-value:background-blend-mode:multiply.description: The source color is multiplied by the destination color and replaces the destination.

css-value:background-blend-mode:screen.description: Multiplies the complements of the backdrop and source color values, then complements the result.

css-value:background-blend-mode:overlay.description: Multiplies or screens the colors, depending on the backdrop color value.

css-value:background-blend-mode:darken.description: Selects the darker of the backdrop and source colors.

css-value:background-blend-mode:lighten.description: Selects the lighter of the backdrop and source colors.

css-value:background-blend-mode:color-do.description: Brightens the backdrop color to reflect the source color.

css-value:background-blend-mode:color-bu.description: Darkens the backdrop color to reflect the source color.

css-value:background-blend-mode:hard-lig.description: Multiplies or screens the colors, depending on the source color value.

css-value:background-blend-mode:soft-lig.description: Darkens or lightens the colors, depending on the source color value.

css-value:background-blend-mode:differen.description: Subtracts the darker of the two constituent colors from the lighter color..

css-value:background-blend-mode:exclusio.description: Produces an effect similar to that of the Difference mode but lower in contrast.

css-value:background-blend-mode:hue.description: Creates a color with the hue of the source color and the saturation and luminosity of the backdrop color.

css-value:background-blend-mode:saturati.description: Creates a color with the saturation of the source color and the hue and luminosity of the backdrop color.

css-value:background-blend-mode:color.description: Creates a color with the hue and saturation of the source color and the luminosity of the backdrop color.

css-value:background-blend-mode:luminosi.description: Creates a color with the luminosity of the source color and the hue and saturation of the backdrop color.

css:background-color.description: Sets the background color of an element.

css:background-image.description: Sets the background image(s) of an element.

css-value:background-image:none.description: Counts as an image layer but draws nothing.

css:background-origin.description: For elements rendered as a single box, specifies the background positioning area. For elements rendered as multiple boxes (e.g., inline boxes on several lines, boxes on several pages) specifies which boxes 'box-decoration-break' operates on to determine the background positioning area(s).

css:background-position.description: Specifies the initial position of the background image(s) (after any resizing) within their corresponding background positioning area.

css:background-position-x.description: If background images have been specified, this property specifies their initial position (after any resizing) within their corresponding background positioning area.
css:background-position-x.syntax: background-position-x: [ center | [ [ left | right | x-start | x-end ]? <length-percentage>? ]! ]#;

css-value:background-position-x:center.description: Equivalent to '50%' ('left 50%') for the horizontal position if the horizontal position is not otherwise specified, or '50%' ('top 50%') for the vertical position if it is.

css-value:background-position-x:left.description: Equivalent to '0%' for the horizontal position if one or two values are given, otherwise specifies the left edge as the origin for the next offset.

css-value:background-position-x:right.description: Equivalent to '100%' for the horizontal position if one or two values are given, otherwise specifies the right edge as the origin for the next offset.

css:background-position-y.description: If background images have been specified, this property specifies their initial position (after any resizing) within their corresponding background positioning area.
css:background-position-y.syntax: background-position-y: [ center | [ [ top | bottom | y-start | y-end ]? <length-percentage>? ]! ]#;

css-value:background-position-y:bottom.description: Equivalent to '100%' for the vertical position if one or two values are given, otherwise specifies the bottom edge as the origin for the next offset.

css-value:background-position-y:center.description: Equivalent to '50%' ('left 50%') for the horizontal position if the horizontal position is not otherwise specified, or '50%' ('top 50%') for the vertical position if it is.

css-value:background-position-y:top.description: Equivalent to '0%' for the vertical position if one or two values are given, otherwise specifies the top edge as the origin for the next offset.

css:background-repeat.description: Specifies how background images are tiled after they have been sized and positioned.

css:background-size.description: Specifies the size of the background images.

css-value:background-size:auto.description: Resolved by using the image's intrinsic ratio and the size of the other dimension, or failing that, using the image's intrinsic size, or failing that, treating it as 100%.

css-value:background-size:contain.description: Scale the image, while preserving its intrinsic aspect ratio (if any), to the largest size such that both its width and its height can fit inside the background positioning area.

css-value:background-size:cover.description: Scale the image, while preserving its intrinsic aspect ratio (if any), to the smallest size such that both its width and its height can completely cover the background positioning area.

css:behavior.description: IE only. Used to extend behaviors of the browser.

css:block-size.description: Size of an element in the direction opposite that of the direction specified by 'writing-mode'.

css-value:block-size:auto.description: Depends on the values of other properties.

css:border.description: Shorthand property for setting border width, style, and color.

css:border-block-end.description: Logical 'border-bottom'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:border-block-start.description: Logical 'border-top'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:border-block-end-color.description: Logical 'border-bottom-color'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:border-block-start-color.description: Logical 'border-top-color'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:border-block-end-style.description: Logical 'border-bottom-style'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:border-block-start-style.description: Logical 'border-top-style'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:border-block-end-width.description: Logical 'border-bottom-width'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:border-block-start-width.description: Logical 'border-top-width'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:border-bottom.description: Shorthand property for setting border width, style and color.

css:border-bottom-color.description: Sets the color of the bottom border.

css:border-bottom-left-radius.description: Defines the radii of the bottom left outer border edge.

css:border-bottom-right-radius.description: Defines the radii of the bottom right outer border edge.

css:border-bottom-style.description: Sets the style of the bottom border.

css:border-bottom-width.description: Sets the thickness of the bottom border.

css-value:border-collapse:separate.description: Selects the separated borders border model.

css:border-color.description: The color of the border around all four edges of an element.

css:border-image.description: Shorthand property for setting 'border-image-source', 'border-image-slice', 'border-image-width', 'border-image-outset' and 'border-image-repeat'. Omitted values are set to their initial values.

css-value:border-image:auto.description: If 'auto' is specified then the border image width is the intrinsic width or height (whichever is applicable) of the corresponding image slice. If the image does not have the required intrinsic dimension then the corresponding border-width is used instead.

css-value:border-image:fill.description: Causes the middle part of the border-image to be preserved.

css-value:border-image:repeat.description: The image is tiled (repeated) to fill the area.

css-value:border-image:round.description: The image is tiled (repeated) to fill the area. If it does not fill the area with a whole number of tiles, the image is rescaled so that it does.

css-value:border-image:space.description: The image is tiled (repeated) to fill the area. If it does not fill the area with a whole number of tiles, the extra space is distributed around the tiles.

css-value:border-image:stretch.description: The image is stretched to fill the area.

css:border-image-outset.description: The values specify the amount by which the border image area extends beyond the border box on the top, right, bottom, and left sides respectively. If the fourth value is absent, it is the same as the second. If the third one is also absent, it is the same as the first. If the second one is also absent, it is the same as the first. Numbers represent multiples of the corresponding border-width.

css:border-image-repeat.description: Specifies how the images for the sides and the middle part of the border image are scaled and tiled. If the second keyword is absent, it is assumed to be the same as the first.

css-value:border-image-repeat:repeat.description: The image is tiled (repeated) to fill the area.

css-value:border-image-repeat:round.description: The image is tiled (repeated) to fill the area. If it does not fill the area with a whole number of tiles, the image is rescaled so that it does.

css-value:border-image-repeat:space.description: The image is tiled (repeated) to fill the area. If it does not fill the area with a whole number of tiles, the extra space is distributed around the tiles.

css-value:border-image-repeat:stretch.description: The image is stretched to fill the area.

css:border-image-slice.description: Specifies inward offsets from the top, right, bottom, and left edges of the image, dividing it into nine regions: four corners, four edges and a middle.

css-value:border-image-slice:fill.description: Causes the middle part of the border-image to be preserved.

css:border-image-source.description: Specifies an image to use instead of the border styles given by the 'border-style' properties and as an additional background layer for the element. If the value is 'none' or if the image cannot be displayed, the border styles will be used.

css:border-image-width.description: The four values of 'border-image-width' specify offsets that are used to divide the border image area into nine parts. They represent inward distances from the top, right, bottom, and left sides of the area, respectively.

css-value:border-image-width:auto.description: The border image width is the intrinsic width or height (whichever is applicable) of the corresponding image slice. If the image does not have the required intrinsic dimension then the corresponding border-width is used instead.

css:border-inline-end.description: Logical 'border-right'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:border-inline-start.description: Logical 'border-left'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:border-inline-end-color.description: Logical 'border-right-color'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:border-inline-start-color.description: Logical 'border-left-color'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:border-inline-end-style.description: Logical 'border-right-style'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:border-inline-start-style.description: Logical 'border-left-style'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:border-inline-end-width.description: Logical 'border-right-width'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:border-inline-start-width.description: Logical 'border-left-width'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:border-left.description: Shorthand property for setting border width, style and color

css:border-left-color.description: Sets the color of the left border.

css:border-left-style.description: Sets the style of the left border.

css:border-left-width.description: Sets the thickness of the left border.

css:border-radius.description: Defines the radii of the outer border edge.

css:border-right.description: Shorthand property for setting border width, style and color

css:border-right-color.description: Sets the color of the right border.

css:border-right-style.description: Sets the style of the right border.

css:border-right-width.description: Sets the thickness of the right border.

css:border-spacing.description: The lengths specify the distance that separates adjoining cell borders. If one length is specified, it gives both the horizontal and vertical spacing. If two are specified, the first gives the horizontal spacing and the second the vertical spacing. Lengths may not be negative.

css:border-style.description: The style of the border around edges of an element.

css:border-top.description: Shorthand property for setting border width, style and color

css:border-top-color.description: Sets the color of the top border.

css:border-top-left-radius.description: Defines the radii of the top left outer border edge.

css:border-top-right-radius.description: Defines the radii of the top right outer border edge.

css:border-top-style.description: Sets the style of the top border.

css:border-top-width.description: Sets the thickness of the top border.

css:border-width.description: Shorthand that sets the four 'border-*-width' properties. If it has four values, they set top, right, bottom and left in that order. If left is missing, it is the same as right; if bottom is missing, it is the same as top; if right is missing, it is the same as top.

css:bottom.description: Specifies how far an absolutely positioned box's bottom margin edge is offset above the bottom edge of the box's 'containing block'.

css-value:bottom:auto.description: For non-replaced elements, the effect of this value depends on which of related properties have the value 'auto' as well

css:box-decoration-break.description: Specifies whether individual boxes are treated as broken pieces of one continuous box, or whether each box is individually wrapped with the border and padding.

css-value:box-decoration-break:clone.description: Each box is independently wrapped with the border and padding.

css-value:box-decoration-break:slice.description: The effect is as though the element were rendered with no breaks present, and then sliced by the breaks afterward.

css:box-shadow.description: Attaches one or more drop-shadows to the box. The property is a comma-separated list of shadows, each specified by 2-4 length values, an optional color, and an optional 'inset' keyword. Omitted lengths are 0; omitted colors are a user agent chosen color.

css-value:box-shadow:inset.description: Changes the drop shadow from an outer shadow (one that shadows the box onto the canvas, as if it were lifted above the canvas) to an inner shadow (one that shadows the canvas onto the box, as if the box were cut out of the canvas and shifted behind it).

css:box-sizing.description: Specifies the behavior of the 'width' and 'height' properties.

css-value:box-sizing:border-box.description: The specified width and height (and respective min/max properties) on this element determine the border box of the element.

css-value:box-sizing:content-box.description: Behavior of width and height as specified by CSS2.1. The specified width and height (and respective min/max properties) apply to the width and height respectively of the content box of the element.

css:break-after.description: Describes the page/column/region break behavior after the generated box.
css:break-after.syntax: break-after: auto | avoid | always | all | avoid-page | page | left | right | recto | verso | avoid-column | column | avoid-region | region;

css-value:break-after:always.description: Always force a page break before/after the generated box.

css-value:break-after:auto.description: Neither force nor forbid a page/column break before/after the principal box.

css-value:break-after:avoid.description: Avoid a break before/after the principal box.

css-value:break-after:avoid-column.description: Avoid a column break before/after the principal box.

css-value:break-after:avoid-page.description: Avoid a page break before/after the principal box.

css-value:break-after:column.description: Always force a column break before/after the principal box.

css-value:break-after:left.description: Force one or two page breaks before/after the generated box so that the next page is formatted as a left page.

css-value:break-after:page.description: Always force a page break before/after the principal box.

css-value:break-after:right.description: Force one or two page breaks before/after the generated box so that the next page is formatted as a right page.

css:break-before.description: Describes the page/column/region break behavior before the generated box.
css:break-before.syntax: break-before: auto | avoid | always | all | avoid-page | page | left | right | recto | verso | avoid-column | column | avoid-region | region;

css-value:break-before:always.description: Always force a page break before/after the generated box.

css-value:break-before:auto.description: Neither force nor forbid a page/column break before/after the principal box.

css-value:break-before:avoid.description: Avoid a break before/after the principal box.

css-value:break-before:avoid-column.description: Avoid a column break before/after the principal box.

css-value:break-before:avoid-page.description: Avoid a page break before/after the principal box.

css-value:break-before:column.description: Always force a column break before/after the principal box.

css-value:break-before:left.description: Force one or two page breaks before/after the generated box so that the next page is formatted as a left page.

css-value:break-before:page.description: Always force a page break before/after the principal box.

css-value:break-before:right.description: Force one or two page breaks before/after the generated box so that the next page is formatted as a right page.

css:break-inside.description: Describes the page/column/region break behavior inside the principal box.
css:break-inside.syntax: break-inside: auto | avoid | avoid-page | avoid-column | avoid-region;

css-value:break-inside:auto.description: Impose no additional breaking constraints within the box.

css-value:break-inside:avoid-column.description: Avoid a column break within the box.

css-value:break-inside:avoid-page.description: Avoid a page break within the box.

css:caption-side.description: Specifies the position of the caption box with respect to the table box.

css-value:caption-side:bottom.description: Positions the caption box below the table box.

css-value:caption-side:top.description: Positions the caption box above the table box.

css:caret-color.description: Controls the color of the text insertion indicator.

css-value:caret-color:auto.description: The user agent selects an appropriate color for the caret. This is generally currentcolor, but the user agent may choose a different color to ensure good visibility and contrast with the surrounding content, taking into account the value of currentcolor, the background, shadows, and other factors.

css:clear.description: Indicates which sides of an element's box(es) may not be adjacent to an earlier floating box. The 'clear' property does not consider floats inside the element itself or in other block formatting contexts.
css:clear.syntax: clear: none | left | right | both | inline-start | inline-end;

css-value:clear:both.description: The clearance of the generated box is set to the amount necessary to place the top border edge below the bottom outer edge of any right-floating and left-floating boxes that resulted from elements earlier in the source document.

css-value:clear:left.description: The clearance of the generated box is set to the amount necessary to place the top border edge below the bottom outer edge of any left-floating boxes that resulted from elements earlier in the source document.

css-value:clear:none.description: No constraint on the box's position with respect to floats.

css-value:clear:right.description: The clearance of the generated box is set to the amount necessary to place the top border edge below the bottom outer edge of any right-floating boxes that resulted from elements earlier in the source document.

css:clip.description: Deprecated. Use the 'clip-path' property when support allows. Defines the visible portion of an element's box.

css-value:clip:rect().description: Specifies offsets from the edges of the border box.

css:clip-path.description: Specifies a clipping path where everything inside the path is visible and everything outside is clipped out.

css-value:clip-path:url().description: References a <clipPath> element to create a clipping path.

css:clip-rule.description: Indicates the algorithm which is to be used to determine what parts of the canvas are included inside the shape.

css-value:clip-rule:evenodd.description: Determines the 'insideness' of a point on the canvas by drawing a ray from that point to infinity in any direction and counting the number of path segments from the given shape that the ray crosses.

css-value:clip-rule:nonzero.description: Determines the 'insideness' of a point on the canvas by drawing a ray from that point to infinity in any direction and then examining the places where a segment of the shape crosses the ray.

css:color.description: Sets the color of an element's text

css:color-interpolation-filters.description: Specifies the color space for imaging operations performed via filter effects.

css-value:color-interpolation-filters:au.description: Color operations are not required to occur in a particular color space.

css-value:color-interpolation-filters:li.description: Color operations should occur in the linearized RGB color space.

css-value:color-interpolation-filters:sR.description: Color operations should occur in the sRGB color space.

css:column-count.description: Describes the optimal number of columns into which the content of the element will be flowed.

css-value:column-count:auto.description: Determines the number of columns by the 'column-width' property and the element width.

css:column-fill.description: In continuous media, this property will only be consulted if the length of columns has been constrained. Otherwise, columns will automatically be balanced.

css-value:column-fill:balance.description: Balance content equally between columns, if possible.

css:column-gap.description: Sets the gap between columns. If there is a column rule between columns, it will appear in the middle of the gap.

css-value:column-gap:normal.description: User agent specific and typically equivalent to 1em.

css:column-rule.description: Shorthand for setting 'column-rule-width', 'column-rule-style', and 'column-rule-color' at the same place in the style sheet. Omitted values are set to their initial values.

css:column-rule-color.description: Sets the color of the column rule

css:column-rule-style.description: Sets the style of the rule between columns of an element.

css:column-rule-width.description: Sets the width of the rule between columns. Negative values are not allowed.

css:columns.description: A shorthand property which sets both 'column-width' and 'column-count'.

css-value:columns:auto.description: The width depends on the values of other properties.

css:column-span.description: Describes the page/column break behavior after the generated box.

css-value:column-span:all.description: The element spans across all columns. Content in the normal flow that appears before the element is automatically balanced across all columns before the element appear.

css-value:column-span:none.description: The element does not span multiple columns.

css:column-width.description: Describes the width of columns in multicol elements.

css-value:column-width:auto.description: The width depends on the values of other properties.

css:contain.description: Indicates that an element and its contents are, as much as possible, independent of the rest of the document tree.
css:contain.syntax: contain: none | strict | content | [ [ size || inline-size ] || layout || style || paint ];

css-value:contain:none.description: Indicates that the property has no effect.

css-value:contain:strict.description: Turns on all forms of containment for the element.

css-value:contain:content.description: All containment rules except size are applied to the element.

css-value:contain:size.description: For properties that can have effects on more than just an element and its descendants, those effects don't escape the containing element.

css-value:contain:layout.description: Turns on layout containment for the element.

css-value:contain:style.description: Turns on style containment for the element.

css-value:contain:paint.description: Turns on paint containment for the element.

css:content.description: Determines which page-based occurrence of a given element is applied to a counter or string value.

css-value:content:attr().description: The attr(n) function returns as a string the value of attribute n for the subject of the selector.

css-value:content:counter(name).description: Counters are denoted by identifiers (see the 'counter-increment' and 'counter-reset' properties).

css-value:content:icon.description: The (pseudo-)element is replaced in its entirety by the resource referenced by its 'icon' property, and treated as a replaced element.

css-value:content:none.description: On elements, this inhibits the children of the element from being rendered as children of this element, as if the element was empty. On pseudo-elements it causes the pseudo-element to have no content.

css:counter-increment.description: Manipulate the value of existing counters.

css-value:counter-increment:none.description: This element does not alter the value of any counters.

css:counter-reset.description: Property accepts one or more names of counters (identifiers), each one optionally followed by an integer. The integer gives the value that the counter is set to on each occurrence of the element.

css:cursor.description: Allows control over cursor appearance in an element

css-value:cursor:alias.description: Indicates an alias of/shortcut to something is to be created. Often rendered as an arrow with a small curved arrow next to it.

css-value:cursor:all-scroll.description: Indicates that the something can be scrolled in any direction. Often rendered as arrows pointing up, down, left, and right with a dot in the middle.

css-value:cursor:auto.description: The UA determines the cursor to display based on the current context.

css-value:cursor:cell.description: Indicates that a cell or set of cells may be selected. Often rendered as a thick plus-sign with a dot in the middle.

css-value:cursor:col-resize.description: Indicates that the item/column can be resized horizontally. Often rendered as arrows pointing left and right with a vertical bar separating them.

css-value:cursor:context-menu.description: A context menu is available for the object under the cursor. Often rendered as an arrow with a small menu-like graphic next to it.

css-value:cursor:copy.description: Indicates something is to be copied. Often rendered as an arrow with a small plus sign next to it.

css-value:cursor:crosshair.description: A simple crosshair (e.g., short line segments resembling a '+' sign). Often used to indicate a two dimensional bitmap selection mode.

css-value:cursor:default.description: The platform-dependent default cursor. Often rendered as an arrow.

css-value:cursor:e-resize.description: Indicates that east edge is to be moved.

css-value:cursor:ew-resize.description: Indicates a bidirectional east-west resize cursor.

css-value:cursor:grab.description: Indicates that something can be grabbed.

css-value:cursor:grabbing.description: Indicates that something is being grabbed.

css-value:cursor:help.description: Help is available for the object under the cursor. Often rendered as a question mark or a balloon.

css-value:cursor:move.description: Indicates something is to be moved.

css-value:cursor:-moz-grab.description: Indicates that something can be grabbed.

css-value:cursor:-moz-grabbing.description: Indicates that something is being grabbed.

css-value:cursor:-moz-zoom-in.description: Indicates that something can be zoomed (magnified) in.

css-value:cursor:-moz-zoom-out.description: Indicates that something can be zoomed (magnified) out.

css-value:cursor:ne-resize.description: Indicates that movement starts from north-east corner.

css-value:cursor:no-drop.description: Indicates that the dragged item cannot be dropped at the current cursor location. Often rendered as a hand or pointer with a small circle with a line through it.

css-value:cursor:none.description: No cursor is rendered for the element.

css-value:cursor:not-allowed.description: Indicates that the requested action will not be carried out. Often rendered as a circle with a line through it.

css-value:cursor:n-resize.description: Indicates that north edge is to be moved.

css-value:cursor:nw-resize.description: Indicates that movement starts from north-west corner.

css-value:cursor:pointer.description: The cursor is a pointer that indicates a link.

css-value:cursor:progress.description: A progress indicator. The program is performing some processing, but is different from 'wait' in that the user may still interact with the program. Often rendered as a spinning beach ball, or an arrow with a watch or hourglass.

css-value:cursor:row-resize.description: Indicates that the item/row can be resized vertically. Often rendered as arrows pointing up and down with a horizontal bar separating them.

css-value:cursor:se-resize.description: Indicates that movement starts from south-east corner.

css-value:cursor:s-resize.description: Indicates that south edge is to be moved.

css-value:cursor:sw-resize.description: Indicates that movement starts from south-west corner.

css-value:cursor:text.description: Indicates text that may be selected. Often rendered as a vertical I-beam.

css-value:cursor:vertical-text.description: Indicates vertical-text that may be selected. Often rendered as a horizontal I-beam.

css-value:cursor:wait.description: Indicates that the program is busy and the user should wait. Often rendered as a watch or hourglass.

css-value:cursor:-webkit-grab.description: Indicates that something can be grabbed.

css-value:cursor:-webkit-grabbing.description: Indicates that something is being grabbed.

css-value:cursor:-webkit-zoom-in.description: Indicates that something can be zoomed (magnified) in.

css-value:cursor:-webkit-zoom-out.description: Indicates that something can be zoomed (magnified) out.

css-value:cursor:w-resize.description: Indicates that west edge is to be moved.

css-value:cursor:zoom-in.description: Indicates that something can be zoomed (magnified) in.

css-value:cursor:zoom-out.description: Indicates that something can be zoomed (magnified) out.

css:direction.description: Specifies the inline base direction or directionality of any bidi paragraph, embedding, isolate, or override established by the box. Note: for HTML content use the 'dir' attribute and 'bdo' element rather than this property.

css:display.description: In combination with 'float' and 'position', determines the type of box or boxes that are generated for an element.

css-value:display:block.description: The element generates a block-level box

css-value:display:contents.description: The element itself does not generate any boxes, but its children and pseudo-elements still generate boxes as normal.

css-value:display:flex.description: The element generates a principal flex container box and establishes a flex formatting context.

css-value:display:flexbox.description: The element lays out its contents using flow layout (block-and-inline layout). Standardized as 'flex'.

css-value:display:flow-root.description: The element generates a block container box, and lays out its contents using flow layout.

css-value:display:grid.description: The element generates a principal grid container box, and establishes a grid formatting context.

css-value:display:inline.description: The element generates an inline-level box.

css-value:display:inline-block.description: A block box, which itself is flowed as a single inline box, similar to a replaced element. The inside of an inline-block is formatted as a block box, and the box itself is formatted as an inline box.

css-value:display:inline-table.description: Inline-level table wrapper box containing table box.

css-value:display:list-item.description: One or more block boxes and one marker box.

css-value:display:-moz-box.description: The element lays out its contents using flow layout (block-and-inline layout). Standardized as 'flex'.

css-value:display:-ms-flexbox.description: The element lays out its contents using flow layout (block-and-inline layout). Standardized as 'flex'.

css-value:display:-ms-grid.description: The element generates a principal grid container box, and establishes a grid formatting context.

css-value:display:none.description: The element and its descendants generates no boxes.

css-value:display:ruby.description: The element generates a principal ruby container box, and establishes a ruby formatting context.

css-value:display:run-in.description: The element generates a run-in box. Run-in elements act like inlines or blocks, depending on the surrounding elements.

css-value:display:table.description: The element generates a principal table wrapper box containing an additionally-generated table box, and establishes a table formatting context.

css-value:display:-webkit-box.description: The element lays out its contents using flow layout (block-and-inline layout). Standardized as 'flex'.

css-value:display:-webkit-flex.description: The element lays out its contents using flow layout (block-and-inline layout).

css:empty-cells.description: In the separated borders model, this property controls the rendering of borders and backgrounds around cells that have no visible content.

css-value:empty-cells:hide.description: No borders or backgrounds are drawn around/behind empty cells.

css-value:empty-cells:show.description: Borders and backgrounds are drawn around/behind empty cells (like normal cells).

css:enable-background.description: Deprecated. Use 'isolation' property instead when support allows. Specifies how the accumulation of the background image is managed.

css-value:enable-background:accumulate.description: If the ancestor container element has a property of new, then all graphics elements within the current container are rendered both on the parent's background image and onto the target.

css-value:enable-background:new.description: Create a new background image canvas. All children of the current container element can access the background, and they will be rendered onto both the parent's background image canvas in addition to the target device.

css:fallback.description: @counter-style descriptor. Specifies a fallback counter style to be used when the current counter style can't create a representation for a given counter value.

css:fill.description: Paints the interior of the given graphical element.

css-value:fill:url().description: A URL reference to a paint server element, which is an element that defines a paint server: 'hatch', 'linearGradient', 'mesh', 'pattern', 'radialGradient' and 'solidcolor'.

css-value:fill:none.description: No paint is applied in this layer.

css:fill-opacity.description: Specifies the opacity of the painting operation used to paint the interior the current object.

css:fill-rule.description: Indicates the algorithm (or winding rule) which is to be used to determine what parts of the canvas are included inside the shape.

css-value:fill-rule:evenodd.description: Determines the 'insideness' of a point on the canvas by drawing a ray from that point to infinity in any direction and counting the number of path segments from the given shape that the ray crosses.

css-value:fill-rule:nonzero.description: Determines the 'insideness' of a point on the canvas by drawing a ray from that point to infinity in any direction and then examining the places where a segment of the shape crosses the ray.

css:filter.description: Processes an element's rendering before it is displayed in the document, by applying one or more filter effects.

css-value:filter:blur().description: Applies a Gaussian blur to the input image.

css-value:filter:brightness().description: Applies a linear multiplier to input image, making it appear more or less bright.

css-value:filter:contrast().description: Adjusts the contrast of the input.

css-value:filter:drop-shadow().description: Applies a drop shadow effect to the input image.

css-value:filter:grayscale().description: Converts the input image to grayscale.

css-value:filter:hue-rotate().description: Applies a hue rotation on the input image.

css-value:filter:invert().description: Inverts the samples in the input image.

css-value:filter:opacity().description: Applies transparency to the samples in the input image.

css-value:filter:sepia().description: Converts the input image to sepia.

css-value:filter:url().description: A filter reference to a <filter> element.

css:flex.description: Specifies the components of a flexible length: the flex grow factor and flex shrink factor, and the flex basis.

css-value:flex:auto.description: Retrieves the value of the main size property as the used 'flex-basis'.

css-value:flex:content.description: Indicates automatic sizing, based on the flex item's content.

css-value:flex-basis:auto.description: Retrieves the value of the main size property as the used 'flex-basis'.

css-value:flex-basis:content.description: Indicates automatic sizing, based on the flex item's content.

css:flex-direction.description: Specifies how flex items are placed in the flex container, by setting the direction of the flex container's main axis.

css-value:flex-direction:column.description: The flex container's main axis has the same orientation as the block axis of the current writing mode.

css-value:flex-direction:column-reverse.description: Same as 'column', except the main-start and main-end directions are swapped.

css-value:flex-direction:row.description: The flex container's main axis has the same orientation as the inline axis of the current writing mode.

css-value:flex-direction:row-reverse.description: Same as 'row', except the main-start and main-end directions are swapped.

css:flex-flow.description: Specifies how flexbox items are placed in the flexbox.

css-value:flex-flow:column.description: The flex container's main axis has the same orientation as the block axis of the current writing mode.

css-value:flex-flow:column-reverse.description: Same as 'column', except the main-start and main-end directions are swapped.

css-value:flex-flow:row.description: The flex container's main axis has the same orientation as the inline axis of the current writing mode.

css-value:flex-flow:row-reverse.description: Same as 'row', except the main-start and main-end directions are swapped.

css-value:flex-flow:wrap-reverse.description: Same as 'wrap', except the cross-start and cross-end directions are swapped.

css:flex-grow.description: Sets the flex grow factor. Negative numbers are invalid.

css:flex-shrink.description: Sets the flex shrink factor. Negative numbers are invalid.

css:flex-wrap.description: Controls whether the flex container is single-line or multi-line, and the direction of the cross-axis, which determines the direction new lines are stacked in.

css-value:flex-wrap:wrap-reverse.description: Same as 'wrap', except the cross-start and cross-end directions are swapped.

css:float.description: Specifies how a box should be floated. It may be set for any element, but only applies to elements that generate boxes that are not absolutely positioned.
css:float.syntax: float: left | right | none | inline-start | inline-end;

css-value:float:inline-end.description: A keyword indicating that the element must float on the end side of its containing block. That is the right side with ltr scripts, and the left side with rtl scripts.

css-value:float:inline-start.description: A keyword indicating that the element must float on the start side of its containing block. That is the left side with ltr scripts, and the right side with rtl scripts.

css-value:float:left.description: The element generates a block box that is floated to the left. Content flows on the right side of the box, starting at the top (subject to the 'clear' property).

css-value:float:right.description: Similar to 'left', except the box is floated to the right, and content flows on the left side of the box, starting at the top.

css:flood-color.description: Indicates what color to use to flood the current filter primitive subregion.

css:flood-opacity.description: Indicates what opacity to use to flood the current filter primitive subregion.

css:font.description: Shorthand property for setting 'font-style', 'font-variant', 'font-weight', 'font-size', 'line-height', and 'font-family', at the same place in the style sheet. The syntax of this property is based on a traditional typographical shorthand notation to set multiple properties related to fonts.

css-value:font:bolder.description: Specifies the weight of the face bolder than the inherited value.

css-value:font:caption.description: The font used for captioned controls (e.g., buttons, drop-downs, etc.).

css-value:font:icon.description: The font used to label icons.

css-value:font:italic.description: Selects a font that is labeled 'italic', or, if that is not available, one labeled 'oblique'.

css-value:font:lighter.description: Specifies the weight of the face lighter than the inherited value.

css-value:font:menu.description: The font used in menus (e.g., dropdown menus and menu lists).

css-value:font:message-box.description: The font used in dialog boxes.

css-value:font:normal.description: Specifies a face that is not labeled as a small-caps font.

css-value:font:oblique.description: Selects a font that is labeled 'oblique'.

css-value:font:small-caps.description: Specifies a font that is labeled as a small-caps font. If a genuine small-caps font is not available, user agents should simulate a small-caps font.

css-value:font:small-caption.description: The font used for labeling small controls.

css-value:font:status-bar.description: The font used in window status bars.

css:font-family.description: Specifies a prioritized list of font family names or generic family names. A user agent iterates through the list of family names until it matches an available font that contains a glyph for the character to be rendered.

css:font-feature-settings.description: Provides low-level control over OpenType font features. It is intended as a way of providing access to font features that are not widely used but are needed for a particular use case.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"abvf\".description: Above-base Forms. Required in Khmer script.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"abvm\".description: Above-base Mark Positioning. Required in Indic scripts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"abvs\".description: Above-base Substitutions. Required in Indic scripts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"akhn\".description: Akhand. Required in most Indic scripts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"blwf\".description: Below-base Form. Required in a number of Indic scripts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"blwm\".description: Below-base Mark Positioning. Required in Indic scripts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"blws\".description: Below-base Substitutions. Required in Indic scripts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"case\".description: Case-Sensitive Forms. Applies only to European scripts; particularly prominent in Spanish-language setting.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"cfar\".description: Conjunct Form After Ro. Required in Khmer scripts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"cjct\".description: Conjunct Forms. Required in Indic scripts that show similarity to Devanagari.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"cpct\".description: Centered CJK Punctuation. Used primarily in Chinese fonts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"cpsp\".description: Capital Spacing. Should not be used in connecting scripts (e.g. most Arabic).

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"curs\".description: Cursive Positioning. Can be used in any cursive script.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"c2pc\".description: Petite Capitals From Capitals. Applies only to bicameral scripts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"c2sc\".description: Small Capitals From Capitals. Applies only to bicameral scripts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"dtls\".description: Dotless Forms. Applied to math formula layout.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"expt\".description: Expert Forms. Applies only to Japanese.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"falt\".description: Final Glyph on Line Alternates. Can be used in any cursive script.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"fin2\".description: Terminal Form #2. Used only with the Syriac script.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"fin3\".description: Terminal Form #3. Used only with the Syriac script.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"fina\".description: Terminal Forms. Can be used in any alphabetic script.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"flac\".description: Flattened ascent forms. Applied to math formula layout.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"fwid\".description: Full Widths. Applies to any script which can use monospaced forms.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"half\".description: Half Forms. Required in Indic scripts that show similarity to Devanagari.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"haln\".description: Halant Forms. Required in Indic scripts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"halt\".description: Alternate Half Widths. Used only in CJKV fonts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"hkna\".description: Horizontal Kana Alternates. Applies only to fonts that support kana (hiragana and katakana).

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"hojo\".description: Hojo Kanji Forms (JIS X 0212-1990 Kanji Forms). Used only with Kanji script.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"hwid\".description: Half Widths. Generally used only in CJKV fonts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"init\".description: Initial Forms. Can be used in any alphabetic script.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"isol\".description: Isolated Forms. Can be used in any cursive script.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"ital\".description: Italics. Applies mostly to Latin; note that many non-Latin fonts contain Latin as well.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"jalt\".description: Justification Alternates. Can be used in any cursive script.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"jp78\".description: JIS78 Forms. Applies only to Japanese.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"jp83\".description: JIS83 Forms. Applies only to Japanese.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"jp90\".description: JIS90 Forms. Applies only to Japanese.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"jp04\".description: JIS2004 Forms. Applies only to Japanese.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"ljmo\".description: Leading Jamo Forms. Required for Hangul script when Ancient Hangul writing system is supported.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"med2\".description: Medial Form #2. Used only with the Syriac script.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"nlck\".description: NLC Kanji Forms. Used only with Kanji script.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"nukt\".description: Nukta Forms. Required in Indic scripts..

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"ordn\".description: Ordinals. Applies mostly to Latin script.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"palt\".description: Proportional Alternate Widths. Used mostly in CJKV fonts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"pkna\".description: Proportional Kana. Generally used only in Japanese fonts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"pref\".description: Pre-base Forms. Required in Khmer and Myanmar (Burmese) scripts and southern Indic scripts that may display a pre-base form of Ra.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"pres\".description: Pre-base Substitutions. Required in Indic scripts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"pstf\".description: Post-base Forms. Required in scripts of south and southeast Asia that have post-base forms for consonants eg: Gurmukhi, Malayalam, Khmer.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"qwid\".description: Quarter Widths. Generally used only in CJKV fonts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"rclt\".description: Required Contextual Alternates. May apply to any script, but is especially important for many styles of Arabic.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"rlig\".description: Required Ligatures. Applies to Arabic and Syriac. May apply to some other scripts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"rkrf\".description: Rakar Forms. Required in Devanagari and Gujarati scripts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"rphf\".description: Reph Form. Required in Indic scripts. E.g. Devanagari, Kannada.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"ruby\".description: Ruby Notation Forms. Applies only to Japanese.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"smcp\".description: Small Capitals. Applies only to bicameral scripts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"smpl\".description: Simplified Forms. Applies only to Chinese and Japanese.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"swsh\".description: Swash. Does not apply to ideographic scripts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"tjmo\".description: Trailing Jamo Forms. Required for Hangul script when Ancient Hangul writing system is supported.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"tnam\".description: Traditional Name Forms. Applies only to Japanese.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"trad\".description: Traditional Forms. Applies only to Chinese and Japanese.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"twid\".description: Third Widths. Generally used only in CJKV fonts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"valt\".description: Alternate Vertical Metrics. Applies only to scripts with vertical writing modes.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"vatu\".description: Vattu Variants. Used for Indic scripts. E.g. Devanagari.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"vert\".description: Vertical Alternates. Applies only to scripts with vertical writing modes.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"vhal\".description: Alternate Vertical Half Metrics. Used only in CJKV fonts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"vjmo\".description: Vowel Jamo Forms. Required for Hangul script when Ancient Hangul writing system is supported.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"vkna\".description: Vertical Kana Alternates. Applies only to fonts that support kana (hiragana and katakana).

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"vpal\".description: Proportional Alternate Vertical Metrics. Used mostly in CJKV fonts.

css-value:font-feature-settings:\"vrt2\".description: Vertical Alternates and Rotation. Applies only to scripts with vertical writing modes.

css-value:font-feature-settings:normal.description: No change in glyph substitution or positioning occurs.

css:font-kerning.description: Kerning is the contextual adjustment of inter-glyph spacing. This property controls metric kerning, kerning that utilizes adjustment data contained in the font.

css-value:font-kerning:auto.description: Specifies that kerning is applied at the discretion of the user agent.

css-value:font-kerning:none.description: Specifies that kerning is not applied.

css:font-language-override.description: The value of 'normal' implies that when rendering with OpenType fonts the language of the document is used to infer the OpenType language system, used to select language specific features when rendering.

css-value:font-language-override:normal.description: Implies that when rendering with OpenType fonts the language of the document is used to infer the OpenType language system, used to select language specific features when rendering.

css:font-size.description: Indicates the desired height of glyphs from the font. For scalable fonts, the font-size is a scale factor applied to the EM unit of the font. (Note that certain glyphs may bleed outside their EM box.) For non-scalable fonts, the font-size is converted into absolute units and matched against the declared font-size of the font, using the same absolute coordinate space for both of the matched values.

css:font-size-adjust.description: Preserves the readability of text when font fallback occurs by adjusting the font-size so that the x-height is the same regardless of the font used.
css:font-size-adjust.syntax: font-size-adjust: none | [ ex-height | cap-height | ch-width | ic-width | ic-height ]? [ from-font | <number> ];

css-value:font-size-adjust:none.description: Do not preserve the font's x-height.

css:font-stretch.description: Selects a normal, condensed, or expanded face from a font family.

css-value:font-stretch:narrower.description: Indicates a narrower value relative to the width of the parent element.

css-value:font-stretch:wider.description: Indicates a wider value relative to the width of the parent element.

css:font-style.description: Allows italic or oblique faces to be selected. Italic forms are generally cursive in nature while oblique faces are typically sloped versions of the regular face.

css-value:font-style:italic.description: Selects a font that is labeled as an 'italic' face, or an 'oblique' face if one is not

css-value:font-style:normal.description: Selects a face that is classified as 'normal'.

css-value:font-style:oblique.description: Selects a font that is labeled as an 'oblique' face, or an 'italic' face if one is not.

css:font-synthesis.description: Controls whether user agents are allowed to synthesize bold or oblique font faces when a font family lacks bold or italic faces.
css:font-synthesis.syntax: font-synthesis: none | [ weight || style || small-caps || position];

css:font-variant.description: Specifies variant representations of the font
css:font-variant.syntax: font-variant: normal | none | [ <common-lig-values> || <discretionary-lig-values> || <historical-lig-values> || <contextual-alt-values> || stylistic( <feature-value-name> ) || historical-forms || styleset( <feature-value-name># ) || character-variant( <feature-value-name># ) || swash( <feature-value-name> ) || ornaments( <feature-value-name> ) || annotation( <feature-value-name> ) || [ small-caps | all-small-caps | petite-caps | all-petite-caps | unicase | titling-caps ] || <numeric-figure-values> || <numeric-spacing-values> || <numeric-fraction-values> || ordinal || slashed-zero || <east-asian-variant-values> || <east-asian-width-values> || ruby ];

css-value:font-variant:normal.description: Specifies a face that is not labeled as a small-caps font.

css-value:font-variant:small-caps.description: Specifies a font that is labeled as a small-caps font. If a genuine small-caps font is not available, user agents should simulate a small-caps font.

css:font-variant-alternates.description: For any given character, fonts can provide a variety of alternate glyphs in addition to the default glyph for that character. This property provides control over the selection of these alternate glyphs.
css:font-variant-alternates.syntax: font-variant-alternates: normal | [ stylistic( <feature-value-name> ) || historical-forms || styleset( <feature-value-name># ) || character-variant( <feature-value-name># ) || swash( <feature-value-name> ) || ornaments( <feature-value-name> ) || annotation( <feature-value-name> ) ];

css-value:font-variant-alternates:annota.description: Enables display of alternate annotation forms.

css-value:font-variant-alternates:charac.description: Enables display of specific character variants.

css-value:font-variant-alternates:normal.description: None of the features are enabled.

css-value:font-variant-alternates:orname.description: Enables replacement of default glyphs with ornaments, if provided in the font.

css:font-variant-caps.syntax: font-variant-caps: normal | small-caps | all-small-caps | petite-caps | all-petite-caps | unicase | titling-caps;

css-value:font-variant-caps:all-petite-c.description: Enables display of petite capitals for both upper and lowercase letters.

css-value:font-variant-caps:all-small-ca.description: Enables display of small capitals for both upper and lowercase letters.

css-value:font-variant-caps:normal.description: None of the features are enabled.

css-value:font-variant-caps:small-caps.description: Enables display of small capitals. Small-caps glyphs typically use the form of uppercase letters but are reduced to the size of lowercase letters.

css-value:font-variant-caps:unicase.description: Enables display of mixture of small capitals for uppercase letters with normal lowercase letters.

css:font-variant-east-asian.description: Allows control of glyph substitute and positioning in East Asian text.

css-value:font-variant-east-asian:normal.description: None of the features are enabled.

css-value:font-variant-east-asian:ruby.description: Enables display of ruby variant glyphs.

css:font-variant-ligatures.description: Specifies control over which ligatures are enabled or disabled. A value of 'normal' implies that the defaults set by the font are used.

css-value:font-variant-ligatures:normal.description: Implies that the defaults set by the font are used.

css-value:font-variant-numeric:diagonal-.description: Enables display of lining diagonal fractions.

css-value:font-variant-numeric:normal.description: None of the features are enabled.

css-value:font-variant-numeric:ordinal.description: Enables display of letter forms used with ordinal numbers.

css-value:font-variant-numeric:stacked-f.description: Enables display of lining stacked fractions.

css-value:font-variant-position:normal.description: None of the features are enabled.

css-value:font-variant-position:sub.description: Enables display of subscript variants (OpenType feature: subs).

css-value:font-variant-position:super.description: Enables display of superscript variants (OpenType feature: sups).

css:font-weight.description: Specifies weight of glyphs in the font, their degree of blackness or stroke thickness.

css-value:font-weight:bolder.description: Specifies the weight of the face bolder than the inherited value.

css-value:font-weight:lighter.description: Specifies the weight of the face lighter than the inherited value.

css:glyph-orientation-horizontal.description: Controls glyph orientation when the inline-progression-direction is horizontal.

css:glyph-orientation-vertical.description: Controls glyph orientation when the inline-progression-direction is vertical.

css-value:glyph-orientation-vertical:aut.description: Sets the orientation based on the fullwidth or non-fullwidth characters and the most common orientation.

css:grid-area.description: Determine a grid item's size and location within the grid by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement. Shorthand for 'grid-row-start', 'grid-column-start', 'grid-row-end', and 'grid-column-end'.

css-value:grid-area:auto.description: The property contributes nothing to the grid item's placement, indicating auto-placement, an automatic span, or a default span of one.

css-value:grid-area:span.description: Contributes a grid span to the grid item's placement such that the corresponding edge of the grid item's grid area is N lines from its opposite edge.

css:grid.description: The grid CSS property is a shorthand property that sets all of the explicit grid properties ('grid-template-rows', 'grid-template-columns', and 'grid-template-areas'), and all the implicit grid properties ('grid-auto-rows', 'grid-auto-columns', and 'grid-auto-flow'), in a single declaration.

css:grid-auto-columns.description: Specifies the size of implicitly created columns.

css-value:grid-auto-columns:min-content.description: Represents the largest min-content contribution of the grid items occupying the grid track.

css-value:grid-auto-columns:max-content.description: Represents the largest max-content contribution of the grid items occupying the grid track.

css-value:grid-auto-columns:auto.description: As a maximum, identical to 'max-content'. As a minimum, represents the largest minimum size (as specified by min-width/min-height) of the grid items occupying the grid track.

css-value:grid-auto-columns:minmax().description: Defines a size range greater than or equal to min and less than or equal to max.

css:grid-auto-flow.description: Controls how the auto-placement algorithm works, specifying exactly how auto-placed items get flowed into the grid.

css-value:grid-auto-flow:row.description: The auto-placement algorithm places items by filling each row in turn, adding new rows as necessary.

css-value:grid-auto-flow:column.description: The auto-placement algorithm places items by filling each column in turn, adding new columns as necessary.

css-value:grid-auto-flow:dense.description: If specified, the auto-placement algorithm uses a "dense" packing algorithm, which attempts to fill in holes earlier in the grid if smaller items come up later.

css:grid-auto-rows.description: Specifies the size of implicitly created rows.

css-value:grid-auto-rows:min-content.description: Represents the largest min-content contribution of the grid items occupying the grid track.

css-value:grid-auto-rows:max-content.description: Represents the largest max-content contribution of the grid items occupying the grid track.

css-value:grid-auto-rows:auto.description: As a maximum, identical to 'max-content'. As a minimum, represents the largest minimum size (as specified by min-width/min-height) of the grid items occupying the grid track.

css-value:grid-auto-rows:minmax().description: Defines a size range greater than or equal to min and less than or equal to max.

css-value:grid-column:auto.description: The property contributes nothing to the grid item's placement, indicating auto-placement, an automatic span, or a default span of one.

css-value:grid-column:span.description: Contributes a grid span to the grid item's placement such that the corresponding edge of the grid item's grid area is N lines from its opposite edge.

css:grid-column-end.description: Determine a grid item's size and location within the grid by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement.

css-value:grid-column-end:auto.description: The property contributes nothing to the grid item's placement, indicating auto-placement, an automatic span, or a default span of one.

css-value:grid-column-end:span.description: Contributes a grid span to the grid item's placement such that the corresponding edge of the grid item's grid area is N lines from its opposite edge.

css:grid-column-gap.description: Specifies the gutters between grid columns. Replaced by 'column-gap' property.

css:grid-column-start.description: Determine a grid item's size and location within the grid by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement.

css-value:grid-column-start:auto.description: The property contributes nothing to the grid item's placement, indicating auto-placement, an automatic span, or a default span of one.

css-value:grid-column-start:span.description: Contributes a grid span to the grid item's placement such that the corresponding edge of the grid item's grid area is N lines from its opposite edge.

css:grid-gap.description: Shorthand that specifies the gutters between grid columns and grid rows in one declaration. Replaced by 'gap' property.

css-value:grid-row:auto.description: The property contributes nothing to the grid item's placement, indicating auto-placement, an automatic span, or a default span of one.

css-value:grid-row:span.description: Contributes a grid span to the grid item's placement such that the corresponding edge of the grid item's grid area is N lines from its opposite edge.

css:grid-row-end.description: Determine a grid item's size and location within the grid by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement.

css-value:grid-row-end:auto.description: The property contributes nothing to the grid item's placement, indicating auto-placement, an automatic span, or a default span of one.

css-value:grid-row-end:span.description: Contributes a grid span to the grid item's placement such that the corresponding edge of the grid item's grid area is N lines from its opposite edge.

css:grid-row-gap.description: Specifies the gutters between grid rows. Replaced by 'row-gap' property.

css:grid-row-start.description: Determine a grid item's size and location within the grid by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement.

css-value:grid-row-start:auto.description: The property contributes nothing to the grid item's placement, indicating auto-placement, an automatic span, or a default span of one.

css-value:grid-row-start:span.description: Contributes a grid span to the grid item's placement such that the corresponding edge of the grid item's grid area is N lines from its opposite edge.

css:grid-template.description: Shorthand for setting grid-template-columns, grid-template-rows, and grid-template-areas in a single declaration.

css-value:grid-template:none.description: Sets all three properties to their initial values.

css-value:grid-template:min-content.description: Represents the largest min-content contribution of the grid items occupying the grid track.

css-value:grid-template:max-content.description: Represents the largest max-content contribution of the grid items occupying the grid track.

css-value:grid-template:auto.description: As a maximum, identical to 'max-content'. As a minimum, represents the largest minimum size (as specified by min-width/min-height) of the grid items occupying the grid track.

css-value:grid-template:subgrid.description: Sets 'grid-template-rows' and 'grid-template-columns' to 'subgrid', and 'grid-template-areas' to its initial value.

css-value:grid-template:minmax().description: Defines a size range greater than or equal to min and less than or equal to max.

css-value:grid-template:repeat().description: Represents a repeated fragment of the track list, allowing a large number of columns or rows that exhibit a recurring pattern to be written in a more compact form.

css:grid-template-areas.description: Specifies named grid areas, which are not associated with any particular grid item, but can be referenced from the grid-placement properties.

css-value:grid-template-areas:none.description: The grid container doesn't define any named grid areas.

css:grid-template-columns.description: specifies, as a space-separated track list, the line names and track sizing functions of the grid.

css-value:grid-template-columns:none.description: There is no explicit grid; any rows/columns will be implicitly generated.

css-value:grid-template-columns:min-cont.description: Represents the largest min-content contribution of the grid items occupying the grid track.

css-value:grid-template-columns:max-cont.description: Represents the largest max-content contribution of the grid items occupying the grid track.

css-value:grid-template-columns:auto.description: As a maximum, identical to 'max-content'. As a minimum, represents the largest minimum size (as specified by min-width/min-height) of the grid items occupying the grid track.

css-value:grid-template-columns:subgrid.description: Indicates that the grid will align to its parent grid in that axis.

css-value:grid-template-columns:minmax().description: Defines a size range greater than or equal to min and less than or equal to max.

css-value:grid-template-columns:repeat().description: Represents a repeated fragment of the track list, allowing a large number of columns or rows that exhibit a recurring pattern to be written in a more compact form.

css:grid-template-rows.description: specifies, as a space-separated track list, the line names and track sizing functions of the grid.

css-value:grid-template-rows:none.description: There is no explicit grid; any rows/columns will be implicitly generated.

css-value:grid-template-rows:min-content.description: Represents the largest min-content contribution of the grid items occupying the grid track.

css-value:grid-template-rows:max-content.description: Represents the largest max-content contribution of the grid items occupying the grid track.
