css-value:grid-template-rows:auto.description: As a maximum, identical to 'max-content'. As a minimum, represents the largest minimum size (as specified by min-width/min-height) of the grid items occupying the grid track.

css-value:grid-template-rows:subgrid.description: Indicates that the grid will align to its parent grid in that axis.

css-value:grid-template-rows:minmax().description: Defines a size range greater than or equal to min and less than or equal to max.

css-value:grid-template-rows:repeat().description: Represents a repeated fragment of the track list, allowing a large number of columns or rows that exhibit a recurring pattern to be written in a more compact form.

css:height.description: Specifies the height of the content area, padding area or border area (depending on 'box-sizing') of certain boxes.
css:height.syntax: height: auto | <length-percentage [0,∞]> | min-content | max-content | fit-content | fit-content(<length-percentage [0,∞]>) | <calc-size()> | <anchor-size()>;

css-value:height:auto.description: The height depends on the values of other properties.

css-value:height:fit-content.description: Use the fit-content inline size or fit-content block size, as appropriate to the writing mode.

css-value:height:max-content.description: Use the max-content inline size or max-content block size, as appropriate to the writing mode.

css-value:height:min-content.description: Use the min-content inline size or min-content block size, as appropriate to the writing mode.

css:hyphens.description: Controls whether hyphenation is allowed to create more break opportunities within a line of text.

css-value:hyphens:auto.description: Conditional hyphenation characters inside a word, if present, take priority over automatic resources when determining hyphenation points within the word.

css-value:hyphens:manual.description: Words are only broken at line breaks where there are characters inside the word that suggest line break opportunities

css-value:hyphens:none.description: Words are not broken at line breaks, even if characters inside the word suggest line break points.

css:image-orientation.description: Specifies an orthogonal rotation to be applied to an image before it is laid out.

css-value:image-orientation:flip.description: After rotating by the precededing angle, the image is flipped horizontally. Defaults to 0deg if the angle is ommitted.

css-value:image-orientation:from-image.description: If the image has an orientation specified in its metadata, such as EXIF, this value computes to the angle that the metadata specifies is necessary to correctly orient the image.

css:image-rendering.description: Provides a hint to the user-agent about what aspects of an image are most important to preserve when the image is scaled, to aid the user-agent in the choice of an appropriate scaling algorithm.

css-value:image-rendering:auto.description: The image should be scaled with an algorithm that maximizes the appearance of the image.

css-value:image-rendering:crisp-edges.description: The image must be scaled with an algorithm that preserves contrast and edges in the image, and which does not smooth colors or introduce blur to the image in the process.

css-value:image-rendering:pixelated.description: When scaling the image up, the 'nearest neighbor' or similar algorithm must be used, so that the image appears to be simply composed of very large pixels.

css:ime-mode.description: Controls the state of the input method editor for text fields.
css:ime-mode.syntax: ime-mode: auto | normal | active | inactive | disabled;

css-value:ime-mode:active.description: The input method editor is initially active; text entry is performed using it unless the user specifically dismisses it.

css-value:ime-mode:auto.description: No change is made to the current input method editor state. This is the default.

css-value:ime-mode:disabled.description: The input method editor is disabled and may not be activated by the user.

css-value:ime-mode:inactive.description: The input method editor is initially inactive, but the user may activate it if they wish.

css-value:ime-mode:normal.description: The IME state should be normal; this value can be used in a user style sheet to override the page setting.

css:inline-size.description: Size of an element in the direction specified by 'writing-mode'.

css-value:inline-size:auto.description: Depends on the values of other properties.

css:isolation.description: In CSS setting to 'isolate' will turn the element into a stacking context. In SVG, it defines whether an element is isolated or not.

css-value:isolation:auto.description: Elements are not isolated unless an operation is applied that causes the creation of a stacking context.

css-value:isolation:isolate.description: In CSS will turn the element into a stacking context.

css:justify-content.description: Aligns flex items along the main axis of the current line of the flex container.

css-value:justify-content:center.description: Flex items are packed toward the center of the line.

css-value:justify-content:start.description: The items are packed flush to each other toward the start edge of the alignment container in the main axis.

css-value:justify-content:end.description: The items are packed flush to each other toward the end edge of the alignment container in the main axis.

css-value:justify-content:left.description: The items are packed flush to each other toward the left edge of the alignment container in the main axis.

css-value:justify-content:right.description: The items are packed flush to each other toward the right edge of the alignment container in the main axis.

css-value:justify-content:safe.description: If the size of the item overflows the alignment container, the item is instead aligned as if the alignment mode were start.

css-value:justify-content:unsafe.description: Regardless of the relative sizes of the item and alignment container, the given alignment value is honored.

css-value:justify-content:stretch.description: If the combined size of the alignment subjects is less than the size of the alignment container, any auto-sized alignment subjects have their size increased equally (not proportionally), while still respecting the constraints imposed by max-height/max-width (or equivalent functionality), so that the combined size exactly fills the alignment container.

css-value:justify-content:space-evenly.description: The items are evenly distributed within the alignment container along the main axis.

css-value:justify-content:flex-end.description: Flex items are packed toward the end of the line.

css-value:justify-content:flex-start.description: Flex items are packed toward the start of the line.

css-value:justify-content:space-around.description: Flex items are evenly distributed in the line, with half-size spaces on either end.

css-value:justify-content:space-between.description: Flex items are evenly distributed in the line.

css:kerning.description: Indicates whether the user agent should adjust inter-glyph spacing based on kerning tables that are included in the relevant font or instead disable auto-kerning and set inter-character spacing to a specific length.

css-value:kerning:auto.description: Indicates that the user agent should adjust inter-glyph spacing based on kerning tables that are included in the font that will be used.

css:left.description: Specifies how far an absolutely positioned box's left margin edge is offset to the right of the left edge of the box's 'containing block'.

css-value:left:auto.description: For non-replaced elements, the effect of this value depends on which of related properties have the value 'auto' as well

css:letter-spacing.description: Specifies the minimum, maximum, and optimal spacing between grapheme clusters.

css-value:letter-spacing:normal.description: The spacing is the normal spacing for the current font. It is typically zero-length.

css:lighting-color.description: Defines the color of the light source for filter primitives 'feDiffuseLighting' and 'feSpecularLighting'.

css:line-break.description: Specifies what set of line breaking restrictions are in effect within the element.
css:line-break.syntax: line-break: auto | loose | normal | strict | anywhere;

css-value:line-break:auto.description: The UA determines the set of line-breaking restrictions to use for CJK scripts, and it may vary the restrictions based on the length of the line; e.g., use a less restrictive set of line-break rules for short lines.

css-value:line-break:loose.description: Breaks text using the least restrictive set of line-breaking rules. Typically used for short lines, such as in newspapers.

css-value:line-break:normal.description: Breaks text using the most common set of line-breaking rules.

css-value:line-break:strict.description: Breaks CJK scripts using a more restrictive set of line-breaking rules than 'normal'.

css-value:line-break:anywhere.description: There is a soft wrap opportunity around every typographic character unit, including around any punctuation character or preserved white spaces, or in the middle of words, disregarding any prohibition against line breaks, even those introduced by characters with the GL, WJ, or ZWJ line breaking classes or mandated by the word-break property.

css:line-height.description: Determines the block-progression dimension of the text content area of an inline box.

css-value:line-height:normal.description: Tells user agents to set the computed value to a 'reasonable' value based on the font size of the element.

css-value:list-style:inside.description: The marker box is outside the principal block box, as described in the section on the ::marker pseudo-element below.

css-value:list-style:outside.description: The ::marker pseudo-element is an inline element placed immediately before all ::before pseudo-elements in the principal block box, after which the element's content flows.

css-value:list-style:symbols().description: Allows a counter style to be defined inline.

css:list-style-image.description: Sets the image that will be used as the list item marker. When the image is available, it will replace the marker set with the 'list-style-type' marker.

css-value:list-style-image:none.description: The default contents of the of the list item's marker are given by 'list-style-type' instead.

css:list-style-position.description: Specifies the position of the '::marker' pseudo-element's box in the list item.

css-value:list-style-position:inside.description: The marker box is outside the principal block box, as described in the section on the ::marker pseudo-element below.

css-value:list-style-position:outside.description: The ::marker pseudo-element is an inline element placed immediately before all ::before pseudo-elements in the principal block box, after which the element's content flows.

css:list-style-type.description: Used to construct the default contents of a list item's marker

css-value:list-style-type:decimal-leadin.description: Decimal numbers padded by initial zeros.

css-value:list-style-type:symbols().description: Allows a counter style to be defined inline.

css:margin.description: Shorthand property to set values for the thickness of the margin area. If left is omitted, it is the same as right. If bottom is omitted it is the same as top, if right is omitted it is the same as top. Negative values for margin properties are allowed, but there may be implementation-specific limits.

css:margin-block-end.description: Logical 'margin-bottom'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:margin-block-start.description: Logical 'margin-top'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:margin-bottom.description: Shorthand property to set values for the thickness of the margin area. If left is omitted, it is the same as right. If bottom is omitted it is the same as top, if right is omitted it is the same as top. Negative values for margin properties are allowed, but there may be implementation-specific limits..

css:margin-inline-end.description: Logical 'margin-right'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:margin-inline-start.description: Logical 'margin-left'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:margin-left.description: Shorthand property to set values for the thickness of the margin area. If left is omitted, it is the same as right. If bottom is omitted it is the same as top, if right is omitted it is the same as top. Negative values for margin properties are allowed, but there may be implementation-specific limits..

css:margin-right.description: Shorthand property to set values for the thickness of the margin area. If left is omitted, it is the same as right. If bottom is omitted it is the same as top, if right is omitted it is the same as top. Negative values for margin properties are allowed, but there may be implementation-specific limits..

css:margin-top.description: Shorthand property to set values for the thickness of the margin area. If left is omitted, it is the same as right. If bottom is omitted it is the same as top, if right is omitted it is the same as top. Negative values for margin properties are allowed, but there may be implementation-specific limits..

css:marker.description: Specifies the marker symbol that shall be used for all points on the sets the value for all vertices on the given 'path' element or basic shape.

css-value:marker:none.description: Indicates that no marker symbol will be drawn at the given vertex or vertices.

css-value:marker:url().description: Indicates that the <marker> element referenced will be used.

css:marker-end.description: Specifies the marker that will be drawn at the last vertices of the given markable element.

css-value:marker-end:none.description: Indicates that no marker symbol will be drawn at the given vertex or vertices.

css-value:marker-end:url().description: Indicates that the <marker> element referenced will be used.

css:marker-mid.description: Specifies the marker that will be drawn at all vertices except the first and last.

css-value:marker-mid:none.description: Indicates that no marker symbol will be drawn at the given vertex or vertices.

css-value:marker-mid:url().description: Indicates that the <marker> element referenced will be used.

css:marker-start.description: Specifies the marker that will be drawn at the first vertices of the given markable element.

css-value:marker-start:none.description: Indicates that no marker symbol will be drawn at the given vertex or vertices.

css-value:marker-start:url().description: Indicates that the <marker> element referenced will be used.

css:mask-image.description: Sets the mask layer image of an element.

css-value:mask-image:none.description: Counts as a transparent black image layer.

css-value:mask-image:url().description: Reference to a <mask element or to a CSS image.

css:mask-mode.description: Indicates whether the mask layer image is treated as luminance mask or alpha mask.

css-value:mask-mode:alpha.description: Alpha values of the mask layer image should be used as the mask values.

css-value:mask-mode:auto.description: Use alpha values if 'mask-image' is an image, luminance if a <mask> element or a CSS image.

css-value:mask-mode:luminance.description: Luminance values of the mask layer image should be used as the mask values.

css:mask-position.description: Specifies how mask layer images are positioned.

css:mask-repeat.description: Specifies how mask layer images are tiled after they have been sized and positioned.

css:mask-size.description: Specifies the size of the mask layer images.

css-value:mask-size:auto.description: Resolved by using the image's intrinsic ratio and the size of the other dimension, or failing that, using the image's intrinsic size, or failing that, treating it as 100%.

css-value:mask-size:contain.description: Scale the image, while preserving its intrinsic aspect ratio (if any), to the largest size such that both its width and its height can fit inside the background positioning area.

css-value:mask-size:cover.description: Scale the image, while preserving its intrinsic aspect ratio (if any), to the smallest size such that both its width and its height can completely cover the background positioning area.

css:mask-type.description: Defines whether the content of the <mask> element is treated as as luminance mask or alpha mask.

css-value:mask-type:alpha.description: Indicates that the alpha values of the mask should be used.

css-value:mask-type:luminance.description: Indicates that the luminance values of the mask should be used.

css:max-block-size.description: Maximum size of an element in the direction opposite that of the direction specified by 'writing-mode'.

css-value:max-block-size:none.description: No limit on the width of the box.

css:max-height.description: Allows authors to constrain content height to a certain range.
css:max-height.syntax: max-height: none | <length-percentage [0,∞]> | min-content | max-content | fit-content | fit-content(<length-percentage [0,∞]>) | <calc-size()> | <anchor-size()>;

css-value:max-height:none.description: No limit on the height of the box.

css-value:max-height:fit-content.description: Use the fit-content inline size or fit-content block size, as appropriate to the writing mode.

css-value:max-height:max-content.description: Use the max-content inline size or max-content block size, as appropriate to the writing mode.

css-value:max-height:min-content.description: Use the min-content inline size or min-content block size, as appropriate to the writing mode.

css:max-inline-size.description: Maximum size of an element in the direction specified by 'writing-mode'.

css-value:max-inline-size:none.description: No limit on the height of the box.

css:max-width.description: Allows authors to constrain content width to a certain range.
css:max-width.syntax: max-width: none | <length-percentage [0,∞]> | min-content | max-content | fit-content | fit-content(<length-percentage [0,∞]>) | <calc-size()> | <anchor-size()>;

css-value:max-width:none.description: No limit on the width of the box.

css-value:max-width:fit-content.description: Use the fit-content inline size or fit-content block size, as appropriate to the writing mode.

css-value:max-width:max-content.description: Use the max-content inline size or max-content block size, as appropriate to the writing mode.

css-value:max-width:min-content.description: Use the min-content inline size or min-content block size, as appropriate to the writing mode.

css:min-block-size.description: Minimal size of an element in the direction opposite that of the direction specified by 'writing-mode'.

css:min-height.description: Allows authors to constrain content height to a certain range.
css:min-height.syntax: min-height: auto | <length-percentage [0,∞]> | min-content | max-content | fit-content | fit-content(<length-percentage [0,∞]>) | <calc-size()> | <anchor-size()>;

css-value:min-height:fit-content.description: Use the fit-content inline size or fit-content block size, as appropriate to the writing mode.

css-value:min-height:max-content.description: Use the max-content inline size or max-content block size, as appropriate to the writing mode.

css-value:min-height:min-content.description: Use the min-content inline size or min-content block size, as appropriate to the writing mode.

css:min-inline-size.description: Minimal size of an element in the direction specified by 'writing-mode'.

css:min-width.description: Allows authors to constrain content width to a certain range.
css:min-width.syntax: min-width: auto | <length-percentage [0,∞]> | min-content | max-content | fit-content | fit-content(<length-percentage [0,∞]>) | <calc-size()> | <anchor-size()>;

css-value:min-width:fit-content.description: Use the fit-content inline size or fit-content block size, as appropriate to the writing mode.

css-value:min-width:max-content.description: Use the max-content inline size or max-content block size, as appropriate to the writing mode.

css-value:min-width:min-content.description: Use the min-content inline size or min-content block size, as appropriate to the writing mode.

css:mix-blend-mode.description: Defines the formula that must be used to mix the colors with the backdrop.

css-value:mix-blend-mode:normal.description: Default attribute which specifies no blending

css-value:mix-blend-mode:multiply.description: The source color is multiplied by the destination color and replaces the destination.

css-value:mix-blend-mode:screen.description: Multiplies the complements of the backdrop and source color values, then complements the result.

css-value:mix-blend-mode:overlay.description: Multiplies or screens the colors, depending on the backdrop color value.

css-value:mix-blend-mode:darken.description: Selects the darker of the backdrop and source colors.

css-value:mix-blend-mode:lighten.description: Selects the lighter of the backdrop and source colors.

css-value:mix-blend-mode:color-dodge.description: Brightens the backdrop color to reflect the source color.

css-value:mix-blend-mode:color-burn.description: Darkens the backdrop color to reflect the source color.

css-value:mix-blend-mode:hard-light.description: Multiplies or screens the colors, depending on the source color value.

css-value:mix-blend-mode:soft-light.description: Darkens or lightens the colors, depending on the source color value.

css-value:mix-blend-mode:difference.description: Subtracts the darker of the two constituent colors from the lighter color..

css-value:mix-blend-mode:exclusion.description: Produces an effect similar to that of the Difference mode but lower in contrast.

css-value:mix-blend-mode:hue.description: Creates a color with the hue of the source color and the saturation and luminosity of the backdrop color.

css-value:mix-blend-mode:saturation.description: Creates a color with the saturation of the source color and the hue and luminosity of the backdrop color.

css-value:mix-blend-mode:color.description: Creates a color with the hue and saturation of the source color and the luminosity of the backdrop color.

css-value:mix-blend-mode:luminosity.description: Creates a color with the luminosity of the source color and the hue and saturation of the backdrop color.

css-value:motion:path().description: Defines an SVG path as a string, with optional 'fill-rule' as the first argument.

css-value:motion:auto.description: Indicates that the object is rotated by the angle of the direction of the motion path.

css-value:motion:reverse.description: Indicates that the object is rotated by the angle of the direction of the motion path plus 180 degrees.

css:motion-offset.description: A distance that describes the position along the specified motion path.

css:motion-path.description: Specifies the motion path the element gets positioned at.

css-value:motion-path:path().description: Defines an SVG path as a string, with optional 'fill-rule' as the first argument.

css:motion-rotation.description: Defines the direction of the element while positioning along the motion path.

css-value:motion-rotation:auto.description: Indicates that the object is rotated by the angle of the direction of the motion path.

css-value:motion-rotation:reverse.description: Indicates that the object is rotated by the angle of the direction of the motion path plus 180 degrees.

css:-moz-animation.description: Shorthand property combines six of the animation properties into a single property.

css-value:-moz-animation:alternate.description: The animation cycle iterations that are odd counts are played in the normal direction, and the animation cycle iterations that are even counts are played in a reverse direction.

css-value:-moz-animation:alternate-rever.description: The animation cycle iterations that are odd counts are played in the reverse direction, and the animation cycle iterations that are even counts are played in a normal direction.

css-value:-moz-animation:backwards.description: The beginning property value (as defined in the first @keyframes at-rule) is applied before the animation is displayed, during the period defined by 'animation-delay'.

css-value:-moz-animation:both.description: Both forwards and backwards fill modes are applied.

css-value:-moz-animation:forwards.description: The final property value (as defined in the last @keyframes at-rule) is maintained after the animation completes.

css-value:-moz-animation:infinite.description: Causes the animation to repeat forever.

css-value:-moz-animation:reverse.description: All iterations of the animation are played in the reverse direction from the way they were specified.

css:-moz-animation-delay.description: Defines when the animation will start.

css:-moz-animation-direction.description: Defines whether or not the animation should play in reverse on alternate cycles.

css-value:-moz-animation-direction:alter.description: The animation cycle iterations that are odd counts are played in the normal direction, and the animation cycle iterations that are even counts are played in a reverse direction.
The animation cycle iterations that are odd counts are played in the reverse direction, and the animation cycle iterations that are even counts are played in a normal direction.

css-value:-moz-animation-direction:rever.description: All iterations of the animation are played in the reverse direction from the way they were specified.

css:-moz-animation-duration.description: Defines the length of time that an animation takes to complete one cycle.

css:-moz-animation-iteration-count.description: Defines the number of times an animation cycle is played. The default value is one, meaning the animation will play from beginning to end once.

css-value:-moz-animation-iteration-count.description: Causes the animation to repeat forever.

css:-moz-animation-name.description: Defines a list of animations that apply. Each name is used to select the keyframe at-rule that provides the property values for the animation.

css:-moz-animation-play-state.description: Defines whether the animation is running or paused.

css-value:-moz-animation-play-state:paus.description: A running animation will be paused.

css-value:-moz-animation-play-state:runn.description: Resume playback of a paused animation.

css:-moz-animation-timing-function.description: Describes how the animation will progress over one cycle of its duration. See the 'transition-timing-function'.

css:-moz-backface-visibility.description: Determines whether or not the 'back' side of a transformed element is visible when facing the viewer. With an identity transform, the front side of an element faces the viewer.

css:-moz-background-inline-policy.description: In Gecko-based applications like Firefox, the -moz-background-inline-policy CSS property specifies how the background image of an inline element is determined when the content of the inline element wraps onto multiple lines. The choice of position has significant effects on repetition.

css:-moz-background-origin.description: For elements rendered as a single box, specifies the background positioning area. For elements rendered as multiple boxes (e.g., inline boxes on several lines, boxes on several pages) specifies which boxes 'box-decoration-break' operates on to determine the background positioning area(s).

css:-moz-border-bottom-colors.description: Sets a list of colors for the bottom border.

css:-moz-border-image.description: Shorthand property for setting 'border-image-source', 'border-image-slice', 'border-image-width', 'border-image-outset' and 'border-image-repeat'. Omitted values are set to their initial values.

css-value:-moz-border-image:auto.description: If 'auto' is specified then the border image width is the intrinsic width or height (whichever is applicable) of the corresponding image slice. If the image does not have the required intrinsic dimension then the corresponding border-width is used instead.

css-value:-moz-border-image:fill.description: Causes the middle part of the border-image to be preserved.

css-value:-moz-border-image:repeat.description: The image is tiled (repeated) to fill the area.

css-value:-moz-border-image:round.description: The image is tiled (repeated) to fill the area. If it does not fill the area with a whole number of tiles, the image is rescaled so that it does.

css-value:-moz-border-image:space.description: The image is tiled (repeated) to fill the area. If it does not fill the area with a whole number of tiles, the extra space is distributed around the tiles.

css-value:-moz-border-image:stretch.description: The image is stretched to fill the area.

css:-moz-border-left-colors.description: Sets a list of colors for the bottom border.

css:-moz-border-right-colors.description: Sets a list of colors for the bottom border.

css:-moz-border-top-colors.description: Ske Firefox, -moz-border-bottom-colors sets a list of colors for the bottom border.

css:-moz-box-align.description: Specifies how a XUL box aligns its contents across (perpendicular to) the direction of its layout. The effect of this is only visible if there is extra space in the box.

css-value:-moz-box-align:baseline.description: If this box orientation is inline-axis or horizontal, all children are placed with their baselines aligned, and extra space placed before or after as necessary. For block flows, the baseline of the first non-empty line box located within the element is used. For tables, the baseline of the first cell is used.

css-value:-moz-box-align:center.description: Any extra space is divided evenly, with half placed above the child and the other half placed after the child.

css-value:-moz-box-align:end.description: For normal direction boxes, the bottom edge of each child is placed along the bottom of the box. Extra space is placed above the element. For reverse direction boxes, the top edge of each child is placed along the top of the box. Extra space is placed below the element.

css-value:-moz-box-align:start.description: For normal direction boxes, the top edge of each child is placed along the top of the box. Extra space is placed below the element. For reverse direction boxes, the bottom edge of each child is placed along the bottom of the box. Extra space is placed above the element.

css-value:-moz-box-align:stretch.description: The height of each child is adjusted to that of the containing block.

css:-moz-box-direction.description: Specifies whether a box lays out its contents normally (from the top or left edge), or in reverse (from the bottom or right edge).

css-value:-moz-box-direction:normal.description: A box with a computed value of horizontal for box-orient displays its children from left to right. A box with a computed value of vertical displays its children from top to bottom.

css-value:-moz-box-direction:reverse.description: A box with a computed value of horizontal for box-orient displays its children from right to left. A box with a computed value of vertical displays its children from bottom to top.

css:-moz-box-flex.description: Specifies how a box grows to fill the box that contains it, in the direction of the containing box's layout.

css:-moz-box-flexgroup.description: Flexible elements can be assigned to flex groups using the 'box-flex-group' property.

css:-moz-box-ordinal-group.description: Indicates the ordinal group the element belongs to. Elements with a lower ordinal group are displayed before those with a higher ordinal group.

css:-moz-box-orient.description: In Mozilla applications, -moz-box-orient specifies whether a box lays out its contents horizontally or vertically.

css-value:-moz-box-orient:block-axis.description: Elements are oriented along the box's axis.

css-value:-moz-box-orient:horizontal.description: The box displays its children from left to right in a horizontal line.

css-value:-moz-box-orient:vertical.description: The box displays its children from stacked from top to bottom vertically.

css:-moz-box-pack.description: Specifies how a box packs its contents in the direction of its layout. The effect of this is only visible if there is extra space in the box.

css-value:-moz-box-pack:center.description: The extra space is divided evenly, with half placed before the first child and the other half placed after the last child.

css-value:-moz-box-pack:end.description: For normal direction boxes, the right edge of the last child is placed at the right side, with all extra space placed before the first child. For reverse direction boxes, the left edge of the first child is placed at the left side, with all extra space placed after the last child.

css-value:-moz-box-pack:justify.description: The space is divided evenly in-between each child, with none of the extra space placed before the first child or after the last child. If there is only one child, treat the pack value as if it were start.

css-value:-moz-box-pack:start.description: For normal direction boxes, the left edge of the first child is placed at the left side, with all extra space placed after the last child. For reverse direction boxes, the right edge of the last child is placed at the right side, with all extra space placed before the first child.

css-value:-moz-box-sizing:border-box.description: The specified width and height (and respective min/max properties) on this element determine the border box of the element.

css-value:-moz-box-sizing:content-box.description: Behavior of width and height as specified by CSS2.1. The specified width and height (and respective min/max properties) apply to the width and height respectively of the content box of the element.

css-value:-moz-box-sizing:padding-box.description: The specified width and height (and respective min/max properties) on this element determine the padding box of the element.

css:-moz-column-count.description: Describes the optimal number of columns into which the content of the element will be flowed.

css-value:-moz-column-count:auto.description: Determines the number of columns by the 'column-width' property and the element width.

css:-moz-column-gap.description: Sets the gap between columns. If there is a column rule between columns, it will appear in the middle of the gap.

css-value:-moz-column-gap:normal.description: User agent specific and typically equivalent to 1em.

css:-moz-column-rule.description: Shorthand for setting 'column-rule-width', 'column-rule-style', and 'column-rule-color' at the same place in the style sheet. Omitted values are set to their initial values.

css:-moz-column-rule-color.description: Sets the color of the column rule

css:-moz-column-rule-style.description: Sets the style of the rule between columns of an element.

css:-moz-column-rule-width.description: Sets the width of the rule between columns. Negative values are not allowed.

css:-moz-columns.description: A shorthand property which sets both 'column-width' and 'column-count'.

css-value:-moz-columns:auto.description: The width depends on the values of other properties.

css:-moz-column-width.description: This property describes the width of columns in multicol elements.

css-value:-moz-column-width:auto.description: The width depends on the values of other properties.

css:-moz-font-feature-settings.description: Provides low-level control over OpenType font features. It is intended as a way of providing access to font features that are not widely used but are needed for a particular use case.

css-value:-moz-font-feature-settings:nor.description: No change in glyph substitution or positioning occurs.

css:-moz-hyphens.description: Controls whether hyphenation is allowed to create more break opportunities within a line of text.

css-value:-moz-hyphens:auto.description: Conditional hyphenation characters inside a word, if present, take priority over automatic resources when determining hyphenation points within the word.

css-value:-moz-hyphens:manual.description: Words are only broken at line breaks where there are characters inside the word that suggest line break opportunities

css-value:-moz-hyphens:none.description: Words are not broken at line breaks, even if characters inside the word suggest line break points.

css:-moz-perspective.description: Applies the same transform as the perspective(<number>) transform function, except that it applies only to the positioned or transformed children of the element, not to the transform on the element itself.

css:-moz-perspective-origin.description: Establishes the origin for the perspective property. It effectively sets the X and Y position at which the viewer appears to be looking at the children of the element.

css:-moz-text-align-last.description: Describes how the last line of a block or a line right before a forced line break is aligned when 'text-align' is set to 'justify'.

css-value:-moz-text-align-last:center.description: The inline contents are centered within the line box.

css-value:-moz-text-align-last:justify.description: The text is justified according to the method specified by the 'text-justify' property.

css-value:-moz-text-align-last:left.description: The inline contents are aligned to the left edge of the line box. In vertical text, 'left' aligns to the edge of the line box that would be the start edge for left-to-right text.

css-value:-moz-text-align-last:right.description: The inline contents are aligned to the right edge of the line box. In vertical text, 'right' aligns to the edge of the line box that would be the end edge for left-to-right text.

css:-moz-text-decoration-color.description: Specifies the color of text decoration (underlines overlines, and line-throughs) set on the element with text-decoration-line.

css:-moz-text-decoration-line.description: Specifies what line decorations, if any, are added to the element.

css-value:-moz-text-decoration-line:line.description: Each line of text has a line through the middle.

css-value:-moz-text-decoration-line:none.description: Neither produces nor inhibits text decoration.

css-value:-moz-text-decoration-line:over.description: Each line of text has a line above it.

css-value:-moz-text-decoration-line:unde.description: Each line of text is underlined.

css:-moz-text-decoration-style.description: Specifies the line style for underline, line-through and overline text decoration.

css:-moz-text-size-adjust.description: Specifies a size adjustment for displaying text content in mobile browsers.

css-value:-moz-text-size-adjust:auto.description: Renderers must use the default size adjustment when displaying on a small device.

css-value:-moz-text-size-adjust:none.description: Renderers must not do size adjustment when displaying on a small device.

css:-moz-transform.description: A two-dimensional transformation is applied to an element through the 'transform' property. This property contains a list of transform functions similar to those allowed by SVG.

css-value:-moz-transform:matrix().description: Specifies a 2D transformation in the form of a transformation matrix of six values. matrix(a,b,c,d,e,f) is equivalent to applying the transformation matrix [a b c d e f]

css-value:-moz-transform:matrix3d().description: Specifies a 3D transformation as a 4x4 homogeneous matrix of 16 values in column-major order.

css-value:-moz-transform:rotate().description: Specifies a 2D rotation by the angle specified in the parameter about the origin of the element, as defined by the transform-origin property.

css-value:-moz-transform:rotate3d().description: Specifies a clockwise 3D rotation by the angle specified in last parameter about the [x,y,z] direction vector described by the first 3 parameters.

css-value:-moz-transform:rotateX('angle'.description: Specifies a clockwise rotation by the given angle about the X axis.

css-value:-moz-transform:rotateY('angle'.description: Specifies a clockwise rotation by the given angle about the Y axis.

css-value:-moz-transform:rotateZ('angle'.description: Specifies a clockwise rotation by the given angle about the Z axis.

css-value:-moz-transform:scale().description: Specifies a 2D scale operation by the [sx,sy] scaling vector described by the 2 parameters. If the second parameter is not provided, it is takes a value equal to the first.

css-value:-moz-transform:scale3d().description: Specifies a 3D scale operation by the [sx,sy,sz] scaling vector described by the 3 parameters.

css-value:-moz-transform:scaleX().description: Specifies a scale operation using the [sx,1] scaling vector, where sx is given as the parameter.

css-value:-moz-transform:scaleY().description: Specifies a scale operation using the [sy,1] scaling vector, where sy is given as the parameter.

css-value:-moz-transform:scaleZ().description: Specifies a scale operation using the [1,1,sz] scaling vector, where sz is given as the parameter.

css-value:-moz-transform:skew().description: Specifies a skew transformation along the X and Y axes. The first angle parameter specifies the skew on the X axis. The second angle parameter specifies the skew on the Y axis. If the second parameter is not given then a value of 0 is used for the Y angle (ie: no skew on the Y axis).

css-value:-moz-transform:skewX().description: Specifies a skew transformation along the X axis by the given angle.

css-value:-moz-transform:skewY().description: Specifies a skew transformation along the Y axis by the given angle.

css-value:-moz-transform:translate().description: Specifies a 2D translation by the vector [tx, ty], where tx is the first translation-value parameter and ty is the optional second translation-value parameter.

css-value:-moz-transform:translate3d().description: Specifies a 3D translation by the vector [tx,ty,tz], with tx, ty and tz being the first, second and third translation-value parameters respectively.

css-value:-moz-transform:translateX().description: Specifies a translation by the given amount in the X direction.

css-value:-moz-transform:translateY().description: Specifies a translation by the given amount in the Y direction.

css-value:-moz-transform:translateZ().description: Specifies a translation by the given amount in the Z direction. Note that percentage values are not allowed in the translateZ translation-value, and if present are evaluated as 0.

css:-moz-transform-origin.description: Establishes the origin of transformation for an element.

css:-moz-transition.description: Shorthand property combines four of the transition properties into a single property.

css-value:-moz-transition:all.description: Every property that is able to undergo a transition will do so.

css:-moz-transition-delay.description: Defines when the transition will start. It allows a transition to begin execution some period of time from when it is applied.

css:-moz-transition-duration.description: Specifies how long the transition from the old value to the new value should take.

css:-moz-transition-property.description: Specifies the name of the CSS property to which the transition is applied.

css-value:-moz-transition-property:all.description: Every property that is able to undergo a transition will do so.

css:-moz-transition-timing-function.description: Describes how the intermediate values used during a transition will be calculated.

css:-moz-user-focus.description: Used to indicate whether the element can have focus.
css:-moz-user-focus.syntax: -moz-user-focus: ignore | normal | select-after | select-before | select-menu | select-same | select-all | none;

css:-ms-accelerator.description: IE only. Has the ability to turn off its system underlines for accelerator keys until the ALT key is pressed

css-value:-ms-accelerator:false.description: The element does not contain an accelerator key sequence.

css-value:-ms-accelerator:true.description: The element contains an accelerator key sequence.

css:-ms-behavior.description: IE only. Used to extend behaviors of the browser

css:-ms-block-progression.description: Sets the block-progression value and the flow orientation

css-value:-ms-block-progression:bt.description: Bottom-to-top block flow. Layout is horizontal.

css-value:-ms-block-progression:lr.description: Left-to-right direction. The flow orientation is vertical.

css-value:-ms-block-progression:rl.description: Right-to-left direction. The flow orientation is vertical.

css-value:-ms-block-progression:tb.description: Top-to-bottom direction. The flow orientation is horizontal.

css:-ms-content-zoom-chaining.description: Specifies the zoom behavior that occurs when a user hits the zoom limit during a manipulation.

css-value:-ms-content-zoom-chaining:chai.description: The nearest zoomable parent element begins zooming when the user hits a zoom limit during a manipulation. No bounce effect is shown.

css-value:-ms-content-zoom-chaining:none.description: A bounce effect is shown when the user hits a zoom limit during a manipulation.

css:-ms-content-zoom-limit.description: Shorthand property for the -ms-content-zoom-limit-min and -ms-content-zoom-limit-max properties.

css:-ms-content-zoom-snap.description: Shorthand property for the -ms-content-zoom-snap-type and -ms-content-zoom-snap-points properties.

css-value:-ms-content-zoom-snap:mandator.description: Indicates that the motion of the content after the contact is picked up is always adjusted so that it lands on a snap-point.

css-value:-ms-content-zoom-snap:none.description: Indicates that zooming is unaffected by any defined snap-points.

css-value:-ms-content-zoom-snap:proximit.description: Indicates that the motion of the content after the contact is picked up may be adjusted if the content would normally stop "close enough" to a snap-point.

css-value:-ms-content-zoom-snap:snapInte.description: Specifies where the snap-points will be placed.

css-value:-ms-content-zoom-snap:snapList.description: Specifies the position of individual snap-points as a comma-separated list of zoom factors.

css:-ms-content-zoom-snap-points.description: Defines where zoom snap-points are located.

css-value:-ms-content-zoom-snap-points:s.description: Specifies where the snap-points will be placed.
Specifies the position of individual snap-points as a comma-separated list of zoom factors.

css:-ms-content-zoom-snap-type.description: Specifies how zooming is affected by defined snap-points.

css-value:-ms-content-zoom-snap-type:man.description: Indicates that the motion of the content after the contact is picked up is always adjusted so that it lands on a snap-point.

css-value:-ms-content-zoom-snap-type:non.description: Indicates that zooming is unaffected by any defined snap-points.

css-value:-ms-content-zoom-snap-type:pro.description: Indicates that the motion of the content after the contact is picked up may be adjusted if the content would normally stop "close enough" to a snap-point.

css:-ms-filter.description: IE only. Used to produce visual effects.

css:-ms-flex.description: specifies the parameters of a flexible length: the positive and negative flexibility, and the preferred size.

css-value:-ms-flex:auto.description: Retrieves the value of the main size property as the used 'flex-basis'.

css:-ms-flex-align.description: Aligns flex items along the cross axis of the current line of the flex container.

css-value:-ms-flex-align:baseline.description: If the flex item's inline axis is the same as the cross axis, this value is identical to 'flex-start'. Otherwise, it participates in baseline alignment.

css-value:-ms-flex-align:center.description: The flex item's margin box is centered in the cross axis within the line.

css-value:-ms-flex-align:end.description: The cross-end margin edge of the flex item is placed flush with the cross-end edge of the line.

css-value:-ms-flex-align:start.description: The cross-start margin edge of the flexbox item is placed flush with the cross-start edge of the line.

css-value:-ms-flex-align:stretch.description: If the cross size property of the flexbox item is anything other than 'auto', this value is identical to 'start'.

css:-ms-flex-direction.description: Specifies how flex items are placed in the flex container, by setting the direction of the flex container's main axis.

css-value:-ms-flex-direction:column.description: The flex container's main axis has the same orientation as the block axis of the current writing mode.

css-value:-ms-flex-direction:column-reve.description: Same as 'column', except the main-start and main-end directions are swapped.

css-value:-ms-flex-direction:row.description: The flex container's main axis has the same orientation as the inline axis of the current writing mode.

css-value:-ms-flex-direction:row-reverse.description: Same as 'row', except the main-start and main-end directions are swapped.

css:-ms-flex-flow.description: Specifies how flexbox items are placed in the flexbox.

css-value:-ms-flex-flow:column.description: The flex container's main axis has the same orientation as the block axis of the current writing mode.

css-value:-ms-flex-flow:column-reverse.description: Same as 'column', except the main-start and main-end directions are swapped.

css-value:-ms-flex-flow:row.description: The flex container's main axis has the same orientation as the inline axis of the current writing mode.

css-value:-ms-flex-flow:wrap-reverse.description: Same as 'wrap', except the cross-start and cross-end directions are swapped.

css:-ms-flex-item-align.description: Allows the default alignment along the cross axis to be overridden for individual flex items.

css-value:-ms-flex-item-align:auto.description: Computes to the value of 'align-items' on the element's parent, or 'stretch' if the element has no parent. On absolutely positioned elements, it computes to itself.

css-value:-ms-flex-item-align:baseline.description: If the flex item's inline axis is the same as the cross axis, this value is identical to 'flex-start'. Otherwise, it participates in baseline alignment.

css-value:-ms-flex-item-align:center.description: The flex item's margin box is centered in the cross axis within the line.

css-value:-ms-flex-item-align:end.description: The cross-end margin edge of the flex item is placed flush with the cross-end edge of the line.

css-value:-ms-flex-item-align:start.description: The cross-start margin edge of the flex item is placed flush with the cross-start edge of the line.

css-value:-ms-flex-item-align:stretch.description: If the cross size property of the flex item computes to auto, and neither of the cross-axis margins are auto, the flex item is stretched.

css:-ms-flex-line-pack.description: Aligns a flex container's lines within the flex container when there is extra space in the cross-axis, similar to how 'justify-content' aligns individual items within the main-axis.

css-value:-ms-flex-line-pack:center.description: Lines are packed toward the center of the flex container.

css-value:-ms-flex-line-pack:distribute.description: Lines are evenly distributed in the flex container, with half-size spaces on either end.

css-value:-ms-flex-line-pack:end.description: Lines are packed toward the end of the flex container.

css-value:-ms-flex-line-pack:justify.description: Lines are evenly distributed in the flex container.

css-value:-ms-flex-line-pack:start.description: Lines are packed toward the start of the flex container.

css-value:-ms-flex-line-pack:stretch.description: Lines stretch to take up the remaining space.

css:-ms-flex-order.description: Controls the order in which children of a flex container appear within the flex container, by assigning them to ordinal groups.

css:-ms-flex-pack.description: Aligns flex items along the main axis of the current line of the flex container.

css-value:-ms-flex-pack:center.description: Flex items are packed toward the center of the line.

css-value:-ms-flex-pack:distribute.description: Flex items are evenly distributed in the line, with half-size spaces on either end.

css-value:-ms-flex-pack:end.description: Flex items are packed toward the end of the line.

css-value:-ms-flex-pack:justify.description: Flex items are evenly distributed in the line.

css-value:-ms-flex-pack:start.description: Flex items are packed toward the start of the line.

css:-ms-flex-wrap.description: Controls whether the flex container is single-line or multi-line, and the direction of the cross-axis, which determines the direction new lines are stacked in.

css-value:-ms-flex-wrap:wrap-reverse.description: Same as 'wrap', except the cross-start and cross-end directions are swapped.

css:-ms-flow-from.description: Makes a block container a region and associates it with a named flow.

css-value:-ms-flow-from:none.description: The block container is not a CSS Region.

css:-ms-flow-into.description: Places an element or its contents into a named flow.

css-value:-ms-flow-into:none.description: The element is not moved to a named flow and normal CSS processing takes place.

css:-ms-grid-column.description: Used to place grid items and explicitly defined grid cells in the Grid.

css:-ms-grid-column-align.description: Aligns the columns in a grid.

css-value:-ms-grid-column-align:center.description: Places the center of the Grid Item's margin box at the center of the Grid Item's column.

css-value:-ms-grid-column-align:end.description: Aligns the end edge of the Grid Item's margin box to the end edge of the Grid Item's column.

css-value:-ms-grid-column-align:start.description: Aligns the starting edge of the Grid Item's margin box to the starting edge of the Grid Item's column.

css-value:-ms-grid-column-align:stretch.description: Ensures that the Grid Item's margin box is equal to the size of the Grid Item's column.

css:-ms-grid-columns.description: Lays out the columns of the grid.

css:-ms-grid-column-span.description: Specifies the number of columns to span.

css:-ms-grid-layer.description: Grid-layer is similar in concept to z-index, but avoids overloading the meaning of the z-index property, which is applicable only to positioned elements.

css:-ms-grid-row.description: grid-row is used to place grid items and explicitly defined grid cells in the Grid.

css:-ms-grid-row-align.description: Aligns the rows in a grid.

css-value:-ms-grid-row-align:center.description: Places the center of the Grid Item's margin box at the center of the Grid Item's row.

css-value:-ms-grid-row-align:end.description: Aligns the end edge of the Grid Item's margin box to the end edge of the Grid Item's row.

css-value:-ms-grid-row-align:start.description: Aligns the starting edge of the Grid Item's margin box to the starting edge of the Grid Item's row.

css-value:-ms-grid-row-align:stretch.description: Ensures that the Grid Item's margin box is equal to the size of the Grid Item's row.

css:-ms-grid-rows.description: Lays out the columns of the grid.

css:-ms-grid-row-span.description: Specifies the number of rows to span.

css:-ms-high-contrast-adjust.description: Specifies if properties should be adjusted in high contrast mode.

css-value:-ms-high-contrast-adjust:auto.description: Properties will be adjusted as applicable.

css:-ms-hyphenate-limit-chars.description: Specifies the minimum number of characters in a hyphenated word.

css-value:-ms-hyphenate-limit-chars:auto.description: The user agent chooses a value that adapts to the current layout.

css:-ms-hyphenate-limit-lines.description: Indicates the maximum number of successive hyphenated lines in an element.

css:-ms-hyphenate-limit-zone.description: Specifies the maximum amount of unfilled space (before justification) that may be left in the line box before hyphenation is triggered to pull part of a word from the next line back up into the current line.

css:-ms-hyphens.description: Controls whether hyphenation is allowed to create more break opportunities within a line of text.

css-value:-ms-hyphens:auto.description: Conditional hyphenation characters inside a word, if present, take priority over automatic resources when determining hyphenation points within the word.

css-value:-ms-hyphens:manual.description: Words are only broken at line breaks where there are characters inside the word that suggest line break opportunities

css-value:-ms-hyphens:none.description: Words are not broken at line breaks, even if characters inside the word suggest line break points.

css:-ms-ime-mode.description: Controls the state of the input method editor for text fields.

css-value:-ms-ime-mode:active.description: The input method editor is initially active; text entry is performed using it unless the user specifically dismisses it.

css-value:-ms-ime-mode:auto.description: No change is made to the current input method editor state. This is the default.

css-value:-ms-ime-mode:disabled.description: The input method editor is disabled and may not be activated by the user.

css-value:-ms-ime-mode:inactive.description: The input method editor is initially inactive, but the user may activate it if they wish.

css-value:-ms-ime-mode:normal.description: The IME state should be normal; this value can be used in a user style sheet to override the page setting.

css:-ms-interpolation-mode.description: Gets or sets the interpolation (resampling) method used to stretch images.

css:-ms-layout-grid.description: Sets or retrieves the composite document grid properties that specify the layout of text characters.

css-value:-ms-layout-grid:char.description: Any of the range of character values available to the -ms-layout-grid-char property.

css-value:-ms-layout-grid:line.description: Any of the range of line values available to the -ms-layout-grid-line property.

css-value:-ms-layout-grid:mode.description: Any of the range of mode values available to the -ms-layout-grid-mode property.

css-value:-ms-layout-grid:type.description: Any of the range of type values available to the -ms-layout-grid-type property.

css:-ms-layout-grid-char.description: Sets or retrieves the size of the character grid used for rendering the text content of an element.

css-value:-ms-layout-grid-char:auto.description: Largest character in the font of the element is used to set the character grid.

css-value:-ms-layout-grid-char:none.description: Default. No character grid is set.

css:-ms-layout-grid-line.description: Sets or retrieves the gridline value used for rendering the text content of an element.

css-value:-ms-layout-grid-line:auto.description: Largest character in the font of the element is used to set the character grid.

css-value:-ms-layout-grid-line:none.description: Default. No grid line is set.

css:-ms-layout-grid-mode.description: Gets or sets whether the text layout grid uses two dimensions.

css-value:-ms-layout-grid-mode:both.description: Default. Both the char and line grid modes are enabled. This setting is necessary to fully enable the layout grid on an element.

css-value:-ms-layout-grid-mode:char.description: Only a character grid is used. This is recommended for use with block-level elements, such as a blockquote, where the line grid is intended to be disabled.

css-value:-ms-layout-grid-mode:line.description: Only a line grid is used. This is recommended for use with inline elements, such as a span, to disable the horizontal grid on runs of text that act as a single entity in the grid layout.

css:-ms-layout-grid-type.description: Sets or retrieves the type of grid used for rendering the text content of an element.

css-value:-ms-layout-grid-type:fixed.description: Grid used for monospaced layout. All noncursive characters are treated as equal; every character is centered within a single grid space by default.

css-value:-ms-layout-grid-type:loose.description: Default. Grid used for Japanese and Korean characters.

css-value:-ms-layout-grid-type:strict.description: Grid used for Chinese, as well as Japanese (Genko) and Korean characters. Only the ideographs, kanas, and wide characters are snapped to the grid.

css:-ms-line-break.description: Specifies what set of line breaking restrictions are in effect within the element.

css-value:-ms-line-break:auto.description: The UA determines the set of line-breaking restrictions to use for CJK scripts, and it may vary the restrictions based on the length of the line; e.g., use a less restrictive set of line-break rules for short lines.

css-value:-ms-line-break:keep-all.description: Sequences of CJK characters can no longer break on implied break points. This option should only be used where the presence of word separator characters still creates line-breaking opportunities, as in Korean.

css-value:-ms-line-break:newspaper.description: Breaks CJK scripts using the least restrictive set of line-breaking rules. Typically used for short lines, such as in newspapers.

css-value:-ms-line-break:normal.description: Breaks CJK scripts using a normal set of line-breaking rules.

css-value:-ms-line-break:strict.description: Breaks CJK scripts using a more restrictive set of line-breaking rules than 'normal'.

css:-ms-overflow-style.description: Specify whether content is clipped when it overflows the element's content area.

css-value:-ms-overflow-style:auto.description: No preference, UA should use the first scrolling method in the list that it supports.

css-value:-ms-overflow-style:-ms-autohid.description: Indicates the element displays auto-hiding scrollbars during mouse interactions and panning indicators during touch and keyboard interactions.

css-value:-ms-overflow-style:none.description: Indicates the element does not display scrollbars or panning indicators, even when its content overflows.

css-value:-ms-overflow-style:scrollbar.description: Scrollbars are typically narrow strips inserted on one or two edges of an element and which often have arrows to click on and a "thumb" to drag up and down (or left and right) to move the contents of the element.

css:-ms-perspective.description: Applies the same transform as the perspective(<number>) transform function, except that it applies only to the positioned or transformed children of the element, not to the transform on the element itself.

css:-ms-perspective-origin.description: Establishes the origin for the perspective property. It effectively sets the X and Y position at which the viewer appears to be looking at the children of the element.

css:-ms-perspective-origin-x.description: Establishes the origin for the perspective property. It effectively sets the X  position at which the viewer appears to be looking at the children of the element.

css:-ms-perspective-origin-y.description: Establishes the origin for the perspective property. It effectively sets the Y position at which the viewer appears to be looking at the children of the element.

css:-ms-progress-appearance.description: Gets or sets a value that specifies whether a progress control displays as a bar or a ring.

css:-ms-scrollbar-3dlight-color.description: Determines the color of the top and left edges of the scroll box and scroll arrows of a scroll bar.

css:-ms-scrollbar-arrow-color.description: Determines the color of the arrow elements of a scroll arrow.

css:-ms-scrollbar-base-color.description: Determines the color of the main elements of a scroll bar, which include the scroll box, track, and scroll arrows.

css:-ms-scrollbar-darkshadow-color.description: Determines the color of the gutter of a scroll bar.

css:-ms-scrollbar-face-color.description: Determines the color of the scroll box and scroll arrows of a scroll bar.

css:-ms-scrollbar-highlight-color.description: Determines the color of the top and left edges of the scroll box and scroll arrows of a scroll bar.

css:-ms-scrollbar-shadow-color.description: Determines the color of the bottom and right edges of the scroll box and scroll arrows of a scroll bar.

css:-ms-scrollbar-track-color.description: Determines the color of the track element of a scroll bar.

css:-ms-scroll-chaining.description: Gets or sets a value that indicates the scrolling behavior that occurs when a user hits the content boundary during a manipulation.

css:-ms-scroll-limit.description: Gets or sets a shorthand value that sets values for the -ms-scroll-limit-x-min, -ms-scroll-limit-y-min, -ms-scroll-limit-x-max, and -ms-scroll-limit-y-max properties.

css:-ms-scroll-limit-x-max.description: Gets or sets a value that specifies the maximum value for the scrollLeft property.

css:-ms-scroll-limit-x-min.description: Gets or sets a value that specifies the minimum value for the scrollLeft property.

css:-ms-scroll-limit-y-max.description: Gets or sets a value that specifies the maximum value for the scrollTop property.

css:-ms-scroll-limit-y-min.description: Gets or sets a value that specifies the minimum value for the scrollTop property.

css:-ms-scroll-rails.description: Gets or sets a value that indicates whether or not small motions perpendicular to the primary axis of motion will result in either changes to both the scrollTop and scrollLeft properties or a change to the primary axis (for instance, either the scrollTop or scrollLeft properties will change, but not both).

css:-ms-scroll-snap-points-x.description: Gets or sets a value that defines where snap-points will be located along the x-axis.

css:-ms-scroll-snap-points-y.description: Gets or sets a value that defines where snap-points will be located along the y-axis.

css:-ms-scroll-snap-type.description: Gets or sets a value that defines what type of snap-point should be used for the current element. There are two type of snap-points, with the primary difference being whether or not the user is guaranteed to always stop on a snap-point.

css-value:-ms-scroll-snap-type:none.description: The visual viewport of this scroll container must ignore snap points, if any, when scrolled.

css-value:-ms-scroll-snap-type:mandatory.description: The visual viewport of this scroll container is guaranteed to rest on a snap point when there are no active scrolling operations.

css-value:-ms-scroll-snap-type:proximity.description: The visual viewport of this scroll container may come to rest on a snap point at the termination of a scroll at the discretion of the UA given the parameters of the scroll.

css:-ms-scroll-snap-x.description: Gets or sets a shorthand value that sets values for the -ms-scroll-snap-type and -ms-scroll-snap-points-x properties.

css:-ms-scroll-snap-y.description: Gets or sets a shorthand value that sets values for the -ms-scroll-snap-type and -ms-scroll-snap-points-y properties.

css:-ms-scroll-translation.description: Gets or sets a value that specifies whether vertical-to-horizontal scroll wheel translation occurs on the specified element.

css:-ms-text-align-last.description: Describes how the last line of a block or a line right before a forced line break is aligned when 'text-align' is set to 'justify'.

css-value:-ms-text-align-last:center.description: The inline contents are centered within the line box.

css-value:-ms-text-align-last:justify.description: The text is justified according to the method specified by the 'text-justify' property.

css-value:-ms-text-align-last:left.description: The inline contents are aligned to the left edge of the line box. In vertical text, 'left' aligns to the edge of the line box that would be the start edge for left-to-right text.

css-value:-ms-text-align-last:right.description: The inline contents are aligned to the right edge of the line box. In vertical text, 'right' aligns to the edge of the line box that would be the end edge for left-to-right text.

css:-ms-text-autospace.description: Determines whether or not a full-width punctuation mark character should be trimmed if it appears at the beginning of a line, so that its 'ink' lines up with the first glyph in the line above and below.

css-value:-ms-text-autospace:ideograph-a.description: Creates 1/4em extra spacing between runs of ideographic letters and non-ideographic letters, such as Latin-based, Cyrillic, Greek, Arabic or Hebrew.

css-value:-ms-text-autospace:ideograph-n.description: Creates 1/4em extra spacing between runs of ideographic letters and numeric glyphs.

css-value:-ms-text-autospace:ideograph-p.description: Creates extra spacing between normal (non wide) parenthesis and ideographs.

css-value:-ms-text-autospace:ideograph-s.description: Extends the width of the space character while surrounded by ideographs.

css-value:-ms-text-autospace:punctuation.description: Creates extra non-breaking spacing around punctuation as required by language-specific typographic conventions.

css:-ms-text-combine-horizontal.description: This property specifies the combination of multiple characters into the space of a single character.

css-value:-ms-text-combine-horizontal:al.description: Attempt to typeset horizontally all consecutive characters within the box such that they take up the space of a single character within the vertical line box.

css-value:-ms-text-combine-horizontal:di.description: Attempt to typeset horizontally each maximal sequence of consecutive ASCII digits (U+0030-U+0039) that has as many or fewer characters than the specified integer such that it takes up the space of a single character within the vertical line box.

css:-ms-text-justify.description: Selects the justification algorithm used when 'text-align' is set to 'justify'. The property applies to block containers, but the UA may (but is not required to) also support it on inline elements.

css-value:-ms-text-justify:auto.description: The UA determines the justification algorithm to follow, based on a balance between performance and adequate presentation quality.

css-value:-ms-text-justify:distribute.description: Justification primarily changes spacing both at word separators and at grapheme cluster boundaries in all scripts except those in the connected and cursive groups. This value is sometimes used in e.g. Japanese, often with the 'text-align-last' property.

css-value:-ms-text-justify:inter-cluster.description: Justification primarily changes spacing at word separators and at grapheme cluster boundaries in clustered scripts. This value is typically used for Southeast Asian scripts such as Thai.

css-value:-ms-text-justify:inter-ideogra.description: Justification primarily changes spacing at word separators and at inter-graphemic boundaries in scripts that use no word spaces. This value is typically used for CJK languages.

css-value:-ms-text-justify:inter-word.description: Justification primarily changes spacing at word separators. This value is typically used for languages that separate words using spaces, like English or (sometimes) Korean.

css-value:-ms-text-justify:kashida.description: Justification primarily stretches Arabic and related scripts through the use of kashida or other calligraphic elongation.

css:-ms-text-kashida-space.description: Sets or retrieves the ratio of kashida expansion to white space expansion when justifying lines of text in the object.

css:-ms-text-overflow.description: Text can overflow for example when it is prevented from wrapping

css-value:-ms-text-overflow:clip.description: Clip inline content that overflows. Characters may be only partially rendered.

css-value:-ms-text-overflow:ellipsis.description: Render an ellipsis character (U+2026) to represent clipped inline content.

css:-ms-text-size-adjust.description: Specifies a size adjustment for displaying text content in mobile browsers.

css-value:-ms-text-size-adjust:auto.description: Renderers must use the default size adjustment when displaying on a small device.

css-value:-ms-text-size-adjust:none.description: Renderers must not do size adjustment when displaying on a small device.

css:-ms-text-underline-position.description: Sets the position of an underline specified on the same element: it does not affect underlines specified by ancestor elements.This property is typically used in vertical writing contexts such as in Japanese documents where it often desired to have the underline appear 'over' (to the right of) the affected run of text

css-value:-ms-text-underline-position:al.description: The underline is aligned with the alphabetic baseline. In this case the underline is likely to cross some descenders.

css-value:-ms-text-underline-position:au.description: The user agent may use any algorithm to determine the underline's position. In horizontal line layout, the underline should be aligned as for alphabetic. In vertical line layout, if the language is set to Japanese or Korean, the underline should be aligned as for over.

css-value:-ms-text-underline-position:ov.description: The underline is aligned with the 'top' (right in vertical writing) edge of the element's em-box. In this mode, an overline also switches sides.

css-value:-ms-text-underline-position:un.description: The underline is aligned with the 'bottom' (left in vertical writing) edge of the element's em-box. In this case the underline usually does not cross the descenders. This is sometimes called 'accounting' underline.

css:-ms-touch-action.description: Gets or sets a value that indicates whether and how a given region can be manipulated by the user.

css-value:-ms-touch-action:auto.description: The element is a passive element, with several exceptions.

css-value:-ms-touch-action:double-tap-zo.description: The element will zoom on double-tap.

css-value:-ms-touch-action:manipulation.description: The element is a manipulation-causing element.

css-value:-ms-touch-action:none.description: The element is a manipulation-blocking element.

css-value:-ms-touch-action:pan-x.description: The element permits touch-driven panning on the horizontal axis. The touch pan is performed on the nearest ancestor with horizontally scrollable content.

css-value:-ms-touch-action:pan-y.description: The element permits touch-driven panning on the vertical axis. The touch pan is performed on the nearest ancestor with vertically scrollable content.

css-value:-ms-touch-action:pinch-zoom.description: The element permits pinch-zooming. The pinch-zoom is performed on the nearest ancestor with zoomable content.

css:-ms-touch-select.description: Gets or sets a value that toggles the 'gripper' visual elements that enable touch text selection.

css:-ms-transform.description: A two-dimensional transformation is applied to an element through the 'transform' property. This property contains a list of transform functions similar to those allowed by SVG.

css-value:-ms-transform:matrix().description: Specifies a 2D transformation in the form of a transformation matrix of six values. matrix(a,b,c,d,e,f) is equivalent to applying the transformation matrix [a b c d e f]

css-value:-ms-transform:matrix3d().description: Specifies a 3D transformation as a 4x4 homogeneous matrix of 16 values in column-major order.

css-value:-ms-transform:rotate().description: Specifies a 2D rotation by the angle specified in the parameter about the origin of the element, as defined by the transform-origin property.

css-value:-ms-transform:rotate3d().description: Specifies a clockwise 3D rotation by the angle specified in last parameter about the [x,y,z] direction vector described by the first 3 parameters.

css-value:-ms-transform:rotateX('angle').description: Specifies a clockwise rotation by the given angle about the X axis.

css-value:-ms-transform:rotateY('angle').description: Specifies a clockwise rotation by the given angle about the Y axis.

css-value:-ms-transform:rotateZ('angle').description: Specifies a clockwise rotation by the given angle about the Z axis.

css-value:-ms-transform:scale().description: Specifies a 2D scale operation by the [sx,sy] scaling vector described by the 2 parameters. If the second parameter is not provided, it is takes a value equal to the first.

css-value:-ms-transform:scale3d().description: Specifies a 3D scale operation by the [sx,sy,sz] scaling vector described by the 3 parameters.

css-value:-ms-transform:scaleX().description: Specifies a scale operation using the [sx,1] scaling vector, where sx is given as the parameter.

css-value:-ms-transform:scaleY().description: Specifies a scale operation using the [sy,1] scaling vector, where sy is given as the parameter.

css-value:-ms-transform:scaleZ().description: Specifies a scale operation using the [1,1,sz] scaling vector, where sz is given as the parameter.

css-value:-ms-transform:skew().description: Specifies a skew transformation along the X and Y axes. The first angle parameter specifies the skew on the X axis. The second angle parameter specifies the skew on the Y axis. If the second parameter is not given then a value of 0 is used for the Y angle (ie: no skew on the Y axis).

css-value:-ms-transform:skewX().description: Specifies a skew transformation along the X axis by the given angle.

css-value:-ms-transform:skewY().description: Specifies a skew transformation along the Y axis by the given angle.

css-value:-ms-transform:translate().description: Specifies a 2D translation by the vector [tx, ty], where tx is the first translation-value parameter and ty is the optional second translation-value parameter.

css-value:-ms-transform:translate3d().description: Specifies a 3D translation by the vector [tx,ty,tz], with tx, ty and tz being the first, second and third translation-value parameters respectively.

css-value:-ms-transform:translateX().description: Specifies a translation by the given amount in the X direction.

css-value:-ms-transform:translateY().description: Specifies a translation by the given amount in the Y direction.

css-value:-ms-transform:translateZ().description: Specifies a translation by the given amount in the Z direction. Note that percentage values are not allowed in the translateZ translation-value, and if present are evaluated as 0.

css:-ms-transform-origin.description: Establishes the origin of transformation for an element.

css:-ms-transform-origin-x.description: The x coordinate of the origin for transforms applied to an element with respect to its border box.

css:-ms-transform-origin-y.description: The y coordinate of the origin for transforms applied to an element with respect to its border box.

css:-ms-transform-origin-z.description: The z coordinate of the origin for transforms applied to an element with respect to its border box.

css:-ms-word-break.description: Specifies line break opportunities for non-CJK scripts.

css-value:-ms-word-break:break-all.description: Lines may break between any two grapheme clusters for non-CJK scripts.

css-value:-ms-word-break:keep-all.description: Block characters can no longer create implied break points.

css-value:-ms-word-break:normal.description: Breaks non-CJK scripts according to their own rules.

css:-ms-word-wrap.description: Specifies whether the UA may break within a word to prevent overflow when an otherwise-unbreakable string is too long to fit.

css-value:-ms-word-wrap:break-word.description: An unbreakable 'word' may be broken at an arbitrary point if there are no otherwise-acceptable break points in the line.

css-value:-ms-word-wrap:normal.description: Lines may break only at allowed break points.

css:-ms-wrap-flow.description: An element becomes an exclusion when its 'wrap-flow' property has a computed value other than 'auto'.
css:-ms-wrap-flow.syntax: -ms-wrap-flow: auto | both | start | end | maximum | clear;

css-value:-ms-wrap-flow:auto.description: For floats an exclusion is created, for all other elements an exclusion is not created.

css-value:-ms-wrap-flow:both.description: Inline flow content can flow on all sides of the exclusion.
