css-value:-ms-wrap-flow:clear.description: Inline flow content can only wrap on top and bottom of the exclusion and must leave the areas to the start and end edges of the exclusion box empty.

css-value:-ms-wrap-flow:end.description: Inline flow content can wrap on the end side of the exclusion area but must leave the area to the start edge of the exclusion area empty.

css-value:-ms-wrap-flow:maximum.description: Inline flow content can wrap on the side of the exclusion with the largest available space for the given line, and must leave the other side of the exclusion empty.

css-value:-ms-wrap-flow:minimum.description: Inline flow content can flow around the edge of the exclusion with the smallest available space within the flow content's containing block, and must leave the other edge of the exclusion empty.

css-value:-ms-wrap-flow:start.description: Inline flow content can wrap on the start edge of the exclusion area but must leave the area to end edge of the exclusion area empty.

css:-ms-wrap-margin.description: Gets or sets a value that is used to offset the inner wrap shape from other shapes.

css:-ms-wrap-through.description: Specifies if an element inherits its parent wrapping context. In other words if it is subject to the exclusions defined outside the element.

css-value:-ms-wrap-through:none.description: The exclusion element does not inherit its parent node's wrapping context. Its descendants are only subject to exclusion shapes defined inside the element.

css-value:-ms-wrap-through:wrap.description: The exclusion element inherits its parent node's wrapping context. Its descendant inline content wraps around exclusions defined outside the element.

css:-ms-zoom.description: Sets or retrieves the magnification scale of the object.

css:-ms-zoom-animation.description: Gets or sets a value that indicates whether an animation is used when zooming.

css:nav-down.description: Provides an way to control directional focus navigation.

css-value:nav-down:auto.description: The user agent automatically determines which element to navigate the focus to in response to directional navigational input.

css-value:nav-down:current.description: Indicates that the user agent should target the frame that the element is in.

css-value:nav-down:root.description: Indicates that the user agent should target the full window.

css:nav-index.description: Provides an input-method-neutral way of specifying the sequential navigation order (also known as 'tabbing order').

css-value:nav-index:auto.description: The element's sequential navigation order is assigned automatically by the user agent.

css:nav-left.description: Provides an way to control directional focus navigation.

css-value:nav-left:auto.description: The user agent automatically determines which element to navigate the focus to in response to directional navigational input.

css-value:nav-left:current.description: Indicates that the user agent should target the frame that the element is in.

css-value:nav-left:root.description: Indicates that the user agent should target the full window.

css:nav-right.description: Provides an way to control directional focus navigation.

css-value:nav-right:auto.description: The user agent automatically determines which element to navigate the focus to in response to directional navigational input.

css-value:nav-right:current.description: Indicates that the user agent should target the frame that the element is in.

css-value:nav-right:root.description: Indicates that the user agent should target the full window.

css:nav-up.description: Provides an way to control directional focus navigation.

css-value:nav-up:auto.description: The user agent automatically determines which element to navigate the focus to in response to directional navigational input.

css-value:nav-up:current.description: Indicates that the user agent should target the frame that the element is in.

css-value:nav-up:root.description: Indicates that the user agent should target the full window.

css:negative.description: @counter-style descriptor. Defines how to alter the representation when the counter value is negative.

css:-o-animation.description: Shorthand property combines six of the animation properties into a single property.

css-value:-o-animation:alternate.description: The animation cycle iterations that are odd counts are played in the normal direction, and the animation cycle iterations that are even counts are played in a reverse direction.

css-value:-o-animation:alternate-reverse.description: The animation cycle iterations that are odd counts are played in the reverse direction, and the animation cycle iterations that are even counts are played in a normal direction.

css-value:-o-animation:backwards.description: The beginning property value (as defined in the first @keyframes at-rule) is applied before the animation is displayed, during the period defined by 'animation-delay'.

css-value:-o-animation:both.description: Both forwards and backwards fill modes are applied.

css-value:-o-animation:forwards.description: The final property value (as defined in the last @keyframes at-rule) is maintained after the animation completes.

css-value:-o-animation:infinite.description: Causes the animation to repeat forever.

css-value:-o-animation:reverse.description: All iterations of the animation are played in the reverse direction from the way they were specified.

css:-o-animation-delay.description: Defines when the animation will start.

css:-o-animation-direction.description: Defines whether or not the animation should play in reverse on alternate cycles.

css-value:-o-animation-direction:alterna.description: The animation cycle iterations that are odd counts are played in the normal direction, and the animation cycle iterations that are even counts are played in a reverse direction.
The animation cycle iterations that are odd counts are played in the reverse direction, and the animation cycle iterations that are even counts are played in a normal direction.

css-value:-o-animation-direction:reverse.description: All iterations of the animation are played in the reverse direction from the way they were specified.

css:-o-animation-duration.description: Defines the length of time that an animation takes to complete one cycle.

css:-o-animation-fill-mode.description: Defines what values are applied by the animation outside the time it is executing.

css-value:-o-animation-fill-mode:backwar.description: The beginning property value (as defined in the first @keyframes at-rule) is applied before the animation is displayed, during the period defined by 'animation-delay'.

css-value:-o-animation-fill-mode:both.description: Both forwards and backwards fill modes are applied.

css-value:-o-animation-fill-mode:forward.description: The final property value (as defined in the last @keyframes at-rule) is maintained after the animation completes.

css-value:-o-animation-fill-mode:none.description: There is no change to the property value between the time the animation is applied and the time the animation begins playing or after the animation completes.

css:-o-animation-iteration-count.description: Defines the number of times an animation cycle is played. The default value is one, meaning the animation will play from beginning to end once.

css-value:-o-animation-iteration-count:i.description: Causes the animation to repeat forever.

css:-o-animation-name.description: Defines a list of animations that apply. Each name is used to select the keyframe at-rule that provides the property values for the animation.

css:-o-animation-play-state.description: Defines whether the animation is running or paused.

css-value:-o-animation-play-state:paused.description: A running animation will be paused.

css-value:-o-animation-play-state:runnin.description: Resume playback of a paused animation.

css:-o-animation-timing-function.description: Describes how the animation will progress over one cycle of its duration. See the 'transition-timing-function'.

css:object-fit.description: Specifies how the contents of a replaced element should be scaled relative to the box established by its used height and width.
css:object-fit.syntax: object-fit: fill | contain | cover | none | scale-down;

css-value:object-fit:contain.description: The replaced content is sized to maintain its aspect ratio while fitting within the element's content box: its concrete object size is resolved as a contain constraint against the element's used width and height.

css-value:object-fit:cover.description: The replaced content is sized to maintain its aspect ratio while filling the element's entire content box: its concrete object size is resolved as a cover constraint against the element's used width and height.

css-value:object-fit:fill.description: The replaced content is sized to fill the element's content box: the object's concrete object size is the element's used width and height.

css-value:object-fit:none.description: The replaced content is not resized to fit inside the element's content box

css-value:object-fit:scale-down.description: Size the content as if 'none' or 'contain' were specified, whichever would result in a smaller concrete object size.

css:object-position.description: Determines the alignment of the replaced element inside its box.

css:-o-border-image.description: Shorthand property for setting 'border-image-source', 'border-image-slice', 'border-image-width', 'border-image-outset' and 'border-image-repeat'. Omitted values are set to their initial values.

css-value:-o-border-image:auto.description: If 'auto' is specified then the border image width is the intrinsic width or height (whichever is applicable) of the corresponding image slice. If the image does not have the required intrinsic dimension then the corresponding border-width is used instead.

css-value:-o-border-image:fill.description: Causes the middle part of the border-image to be preserved.

css-value:-o-border-image:repeat.description: The image is tiled (repeated) to fill the area.

css-value:-o-border-image:round.description: The image is tiled (repeated) to fill the area. If it does not fill the area with a whole number of tiles, the image is rescaled so that it does.

css-value:-o-border-image:space.description: The image is tiled (repeated) to fill the area. If it does not fill the area with a whole number of tiles, the extra space is distributed around the tiles.

css-value:-o-border-image:stretch.description: The image is stretched to fill the area.

css:-o-object-fit.description: Specifies how the contents of a replaced element should be scaled relative to the box established by its used height and width.

css-value:-o-object-fit:contain.description: The replaced content is sized to maintain its aspect ratio while fitting within the element's content box: its concrete object size is resolved as a contain constraint against the element's used width and height.

css-value:-o-object-fit:cover.description: The replaced content is sized to maintain its aspect ratio while filling the element's entire content box: its concrete object size is resolved as a cover constraint against the element's used width and height.

css-value:-o-object-fit:fill.description: The replaced content is sized to fill the element's content box: the object's concrete object size is the element's used width and height.

css-value:-o-object-fit:none.description: The replaced content is not resized to fit inside the element's content box

css-value:-o-object-fit:scale-down.description: Size the content as if 'none' or 'contain' were specified, whichever would result in a smaller concrete object size.

css:-o-object-position.description: Determines the alignment of the replaced element inside its box.

css:opacity.description: Opacity of an element's text, where 1 is opaque and 0 is entirely transparent.

css:order.description: Controls the order in which children of a flex container appear within the flex container, by assigning them to ordinal groups.

css:orphans.description: Specifies the minimum number of line boxes in a block container that must be left in a fragment before a fragmentation break.

css:-o-table-baseline.description: Determines which row of a inline-table should be used as baseline of inline-table.

css:-o-tab-size.description: This property determines the width of the tab character (U+0009), in space characters (U+0020), when rendered.

css:-o-text-overflow.description: Text can overflow for example when it is prevented from wrapping

css-value:-o-text-overflow:clip.description: Clip inline content that overflows. Characters may be only partially rendered.

css-value:-o-text-overflow:ellipsis.description: Render an ellipsis character (U+2026) to represent clipped inline content.

css:-o-transform.description: A two-dimensional transformation is applied to an element through the 'transform' property. This property contains a list of transform functions similar to those allowed by SVG.

css-value:-o-transform:matrix().description: Specifies a 2D transformation in the form of a transformation matrix of six values. matrix(a,b,c,d,e,f) is equivalent to applying the transformation matrix [a b c d e f]

css-value:-o-transform:matrix3d().description: Specifies a 3D transformation as a 4x4 homogeneous matrix of 16 values in column-major order.

css-value:-o-transform:rotate().description: Specifies a 2D rotation by the angle specified in the parameter about the origin of the element, as defined by the transform-origin property.

css-value:-o-transform:rotate3d().description: Specifies a clockwise 3D rotation by the angle specified in last parameter about the [x,y,z] direction vector described by the first 3 parameters.

css-value:-o-transform:rotateX('angle').description: Specifies a clockwise rotation by the given angle about the X axis.

css-value:-o-transform:rotateY('angle').description: Specifies a clockwise rotation by the given angle about the Y axis.

css-value:-o-transform:rotateZ('angle').description: Specifies a clockwise rotation by the given angle about the Z axis.

css-value:-o-transform:scale().description: Specifies a 2D scale operation by the [sx,sy] scaling vector described by the 2 parameters. If the second parameter is not provided, it is takes a value equal to the first.

css-value:-o-transform:scale3d().description: Specifies a 3D scale operation by the [sx,sy,sz] scaling vector described by the 3 parameters.

css-value:-o-transform:scaleX().description: Specifies a scale operation using the [sx,1] scaling vector, where sx is given as the parameter.

css-value:-o-transform:scaleY().description: Specifies a scale operation using the [sy,1] scaling vector, where sy is given as the parameter.

css-value:-o-transform:scaleZ().description: Specifies a scale operation using the [1,1,sz] scaling vector, where sz is given as the parameter.

css-value:-o-transform:skew().description: Specifies a skew transformation along the X and Y axes. The first angle parameter specifies the skew on the X axis. The second angle parameter specifies the skew on the Y axis. If the second parameter is not given then a value of 0 is used for the Y angle (ie: no skew on the Y axis).

css-value:-o-transform:skewX().description: Specifies a skew transformation along the X axis by the given angle.

css-value:-o-transform:skewY().description: Specifies a skew transformation along the Y axis by the given angle.

css-value:-o-transform:translate().description: Specifies a 2D translation by the vector [tx, ty], where tx is the first translation-value parameter and ty is the optional second translation-value parameter.

css-value:-o-transform:translate3d().description: Specifies a 3D translation by the vector [tx,ty,tz], with tx, ty and tz being the first, second and third translation-value parameters respectively.

css-value:-o-transform:translateX().description: Specifies a translation by the given amount in the X direction.

css-value:-o-transform:translateY().description: Specifies a translation by the given amount in the Y direction.

css-value:-o-transform:translateZ().description: Specifies a translation by the given amount in the Z direction. Note that percentage values are not allowed in the translateZ translation-value, and if present are evaluated as 0.

css:-o-transform-origin.description: Establishes the origin of transformation for an element.

css:-o-transition.description: Shorthand property combines four of the transition properties into a single property.

css-value:-o-transition:all.description: Every property that is able to undergo a transition will do so.

css:-o-transition-delay.description: Defines when the transition will start. It allows a transition to begin execution some period of time from when it is applied.

css:-o-transition-duration.description: Specifies how long the transition from the old value to the new value should take.

css:-o-transition-property.description: Specifies the name of the CSS property to which the transition is applied.

css-value:-o-transition-property:all.description: Every property that is able to undergo a transition will do so.

css:-o-transition-timing-function.description: Describes how the intermediate values used during a transition will be calculated.

css:offset-block-end.description: Logical 'bottom'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css-value:offset-block-end:auto.description: For non-replaced elements, the effect of this value depends on which of related properties have the value 'auto' as well.

css:offset-block-start.description: Logical 'top'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css-value:offset-block-start:auto.description: For non-replaced elements, the effect of this value depends on which of related properties have the value 'auto' as well.

css:offset-inline-end.description: Logical 'right'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css-value:offset-inline-end:auto.description: For non-replaced elements, the effect of this value depends on which of related properties have the value 'auto' as well.

css:offset-inline-start.description: Logical 'left'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css-value:offset-inline-start:auto.description: For non-replaced elements, the effect of this value depends on which of related properties have the value 'auto' as well.

css-value:outline:auto.description: Permits the user agent to render a custom outline style, typically the default platform style.

css-value:outline:invert.description: Performs a color inversion on the pixels on the screen.

css-value:outline-color:invert.description: Performs a color inversion on the pixels on the screen.

css:outline-offset.description: Offset the outline and draw it beyond the border edge.

css-value:outline-style:auto.description: Permits the user agent to render a custom outline style, typically the default platform style.

css:overflow.syntax: overflow: [ visible | hidden | clip | scroll | auto ]{1,2};

css-value:overflow:auto.description: The behavior of the 'auto' value is UA-dependent, but should cause a scrolling mechanism to be provided for overflowing boxes.

css-value:overflow:hidden.description: Content is clipped and no scrolling mechanism should be provided to view the content outside the clipping region.

css-value:overflow:-moz-hidden-unscrolla.description: Same as the standardized 'clip', except doesn't establish a block formatting context.

css-value:overflow:scroll.description: Content is clipped and if the user agent uses a scrolling mechanism that is visible on the screen (such as a scroll bar or a panner), that mechanism should be displayed for a box whether or not any of its content is clipped.

css-value:overflow:visible.description: Content is not clipped, i.e., it may be rendered outside the content box.

css:overflow-wrap.description: Specifies whether the UA may break within a word to prevent overflow when an otherwise-unbreakable string is too long to fit within the line box.

css-value:overflow-wrap:break-word.description: An otherwise unbreakable sequence of characters may be broken at an arbitrary point if there are no otherwise-acceptable break points in the line.

css-value:overflow-wrap:normal.description: Lines may break only at allowed break points.

css-value:overflow-wrap:anywhere.description: There is a soft wrap opportunity around every typographic character unit, including around any punctuation character or preserved white spaces, or in the middle of words, disregarding any prohibition against line breaks, even those introduced by characters with the GL, WJ, or ZWJ line breaking classes or mandated by the word-break property.

css:overflow-x.description: Specifies the handling of overflow in the horizontal direction.
css:overflow-x.syntax: overflow-x: visible | hidden | clip | scroll | auto;

css-value:overflow-x:auto.description: The behavior of the 'auto' value is UA-dependent, but should cause a scrolling mechanism to be provided for overflowing boxes.

css-value:overflow-x:hidden.description: Content is clipped and no scrolling mechanism should be provided to view the content outside the clipping region.

css-value:overflow-x:scroll.description: Content is clipped and if the user agent uses a scrolling mechanism that is visible on the screen (such as a scroll bar or a panner), that mechanism should be displayed for a box whether or not any of its content is clipped.

css-value:overflow-x:visible.description: Content is not clipped, i.e., it may be rendered outside the content box.

css:overflow-y.description: Specifies the handling of overflow in the vertical direction.
css:overflow-y.syntax: overflow-y: visible | hidden | clip | scroll | auto;

css-value:overflow-y:auto.description: The behavior of the 'auto' value is UA-dependent, but should cause a scrolling mechanism to be provided for overflowing boxes.

css-value:overflow-y:hidden.description: Content is clipped and no scrolling mechanism should be provided to view the content outside the clipping region.

css-value:overflow-y:scroll.description: Content is clipped and if the user agent uses a scrolling mechanism that is visible on the screen (such as a scroll bar or a panner), that mechanism should be displayed for a box whether or not any of its content is clipped.

css-value:overflow-y:visible.description: Content is not clipped, i.e., it may be rendered outside the content box.

css:pad.description: @counter-style descriptor. Specifies a "fixed-width" counter style, where representations shorter than the pad value are padded with a particular <symbol>

css:padding.description: Shorthand property to set values for the thickness of the padding area. If left is omitted, it is the same as right. If bottom is omitted it is the same as top, if right is omitted it is the same as top. The value may not be negative.

css:padding-bottom.description: Shorthand property to set values for the thickness of the padding area. If left is omitted, it is the same as right. If bottom is omitted it is the same as top, if right is omitted it is the same as top. The value may not be negative.

css:padding-block-end.description: Logical 'padding-bottom'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:padding-block-start.description: Logical 'padding-top'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:padding-inline-end.description: Logical 'padding-right'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:padding-inline-start.description: Logical 'padding-left'. Mapping depends on the parent element's 'writing-mode', 'direction', and 'text-orientation'.

css:padding-left.description: Shorthand property to set values for the thickness of the padding area. If left is omitted, it is the same as right. If bottom is omitted it is the same as top, if right is omitted it is the same as top. The value may not be negative.

css:padding-right.description: Shorthand property to set values for the thickness of the padding area. If left is omitted, it is the same as right. If bottom is omitted it is the same as top, if right is omitted it is the same as top. The value may not be negative.

css:padding-top.description: Shorthand property to set values for the thickness of the padding area. If left is omitted, it is the same as right. If bottom is omitted it is the same as top, if right is omitted it is the same as top. The value may not be negative.

css:page-break-after.description: Defines rules for page breaks after an element.
css:page-break-after.syntax: page-break-after: auto | always | avoid | left | right | recto | verso;

css-value:page-break-after:always.description: Always force a page break after the generated box.

css-value:page-break-after:auto.description: Neither force nor forbid a page break after generated box.

css-value:page-break-after:avoid.description: Avoid a page break after the generated box.

css-value:page-break-after:left.description: Force one or two page breaks after the generated box so that the next page is formatted as a left page.

css-value:page-break-after:right.description: Force one or two page breaks after the generated box so that the next page is formatted as a right page.

css:page-break-before.description: Defines rules for page breaks before an element.
css:page-break-before.syntax: page-break-before: auto | always | avoid | left | right | recto | verso;

css-value:page-break-before:always.description: Always force a page break before the generated box.

css-value:page-break-before:auto.description: Neither force nor forbid a page break before the generated box.

css-value:page-break-before:avoid.description: Avoid a page break before the generated box.

css-value:page-break-before:left.description: Force one or two page breaks before the generated box so that the next page is formatted as a left page.

css-value:page-break-before:right.description: Force one or two page breaks before the generated box so that the next page is formatted as a right page.

css:page-break-inside.description: Defines rules for page breaks inside an element.

css-value:page-break-inside:auto.description: Neither force nor forbid a page break inside the generated box.

css-value:page-break-inside:avoid.description: Avoid a page break inside the generated box.

css:paint-order.description: Controls the order that the three paint operations that shapes and text are rendered with: their fill, their stroke and any markers they might have.

css-value:paint-order:normal.description: The element is painted with the standard order of painting operations: the 'fill' is painted first, then its 'stroke' and finally its markers.

css:perspective.description: Applies the same transform as the perspective(<number>) transform function, except that it applies only to the positioned or transformed children of the element, not to the transform on the element itself.

css:perspective-origin.description: Establishes the origin for the perspective property. It effectively sets the X and Y position at which the viewer appears to be looking at the children of the element.

css:pointer-events.description: Specifies under what circumstances a given element can be the target element for a pointer event.
css:pointer-events.syntax: pointer-events: auto | none | visiblePainted | visibleFill | visibleStroke | visible | painted | fill | stroke | all | inherit;

css-value:pointer-events:all.description: The given element can be the target element for pointer events whenever the pointer is over either the interior or the perimeter of the element.

css-value:pointer-events:fill.description: The given element can be the target element for pointer events whenever the pointer is over the interior of the element.

css-value:pointer-events:none.description: The given element does not receive pointer events.

css-value:pointer-events:painted.description: The given element can be the target element for pointer events when the pointer is over a "painted" area.

css-value:pointer-events:stroke.description: The given element can be the target element for pointer events whenever the pointer is over the perimeter of the element.

css-value:pointer-events:visible.description: The given element can be the target element for pointer events when the 'visibility' property is set to visible and the pointer is over either the interior or the perimeter of the element.

css-value:pointer-events:visibleFill.description: The given element can be the target element for pointer events when the 'visibility' property is set to visible and when the pointer is over the interior of the element.

css-value:pointer-events:visiblePainted.description: The given element can be the target element for pointer events when the 'visibility' property is set to visible and when the pointer is over a 'painted' area.

css-value:pointer-events:visibleStroke.description: The given element can be the target element for pointer events when the 'visibility' property is set to visible and when the pointer is over the perimeter of the element.

css:position.description: The position CSS property sets how an element is positioned in a document. The top, right, bottom, and left properties determine the final location of positioned elements.
css:position.syntax: position: static | relative | absolute | sticky | fixed;

css-value:position:absolute.description: The box's position (and possibly size) is specified with the 'top', 'right', 'bottom', and 'left' properties. These properties specify offsets with respect to the box's 'containing block'.

css-value:position:fixed.description: The box's position is calculated according to the 'absolute' model, but in addition, the box is fixed with respect to some reference. As with the 'absolute' model, the box's margins do not collapse with any other margins.

css-value:position:-ms-page.description: The box's position is calculated according to the 'absolute' model.

css-value:position:relative.description: The box's position is calculated according to the normal flow (this is called the position in normal flow). Then the box is offset relative to its normal position.

css-value:position:static.description: The box is a normal box, laid out according to the normal flow. The 'top', 'right', 'bottom', and 'left' properties do not apply.

css-value:position:sticky.description: The box's position is calculated according to the normal flow. Then the box is offset relative to its flow root and containing block and in all cases, including table elements, does not affect the position of any following boxes.

css-value:position:-webkit-sticky.description: The box's position is calculated according to the normal flow. Then the box is offset relative to its flow root and containing block and in all cases, including table elements, does not affect the position of any following boxes.

css:prefix.description: @counter-style descriptor. Specifies a <symbol> that is prepended to the marker representation.

css:quotes.description: Specifies quotation marks for any number of embedded quotations.

css-value:quotes:none.description: The 'open-quote' and 'close-quote' values of the 'content' property produce no quotations marks, as if they were 'no-open-quote' and 'no-close-quote' respectively.

css:range.description: @counter-style descriptor. Defines the ranges over which the counter style is defined.

css-value:range:auto.description: The range depends on the counter system.

css-value:range:infinite.description: If used as the first value in a range, it represents negative infinity; if used as the second value, it represents positive infinity.

css:resize.description: Specifies whether or not an element is resizable by the user, and if so, along which axis/axes.
css:resize.syntax: resize: none | both | horizontal | vertical | block | inline;

css-value:resize:both.description: The UA presents a bidirectional resizing mechanism to allow the user to adjust both the height and the width of the element.

css-value:resize:horizontal.description: The UA presents a unidirectional horizontal resizing mechanism to allow the user to adjust only the width of the element.

css-value:resize:none.description: The UA does not present a resizing mechanism on the element, and the user is given no direct manipulation mechanism to resize the element.

css-value:resize:vertical.description: The UA presents a unidirectional vertical resizing mechanism to allow the user to adjust only the height of the element.

css:right.description: Specifies how far an absolutely positioned box's right margin edge is offset to the left of the right edge of the box's 'containing block'.

css-value:right:auto.description: For non-replaced elements, the effect of this value depends on which of related properties have the value 'auto' as well

css:ruby-align.description: Specifies how text is distributed within the various ruby boxes when their contents do not exactly fill their respective boxes.

css-value:ruby-align:auto.description: The user agent determines how the ruby contents are aligned. This is the initial value.

css-value:ruby-align:center.description: The ruby content is centered within its box.

css-value:ruby-align:distribute-letter.description: If the width of the ruby text is smaller than that of the base, then the ruby text contents are evenly distributed across the width of the base, with the first and last ruby text glyphs lining up with the corresponding first and last base glyphs. If the width of the ruby text is at least the width of the base, then the letters of the base are evenly distributed across the width of the ruby text.

css-value:ruby-align:distribute-space.description: If the width of the ruby text is smaller than that of the base, then the ruby text contents are evenly distributed across the width of the base, with a certain amount of white space preceding the first and following the last character in the ruby text. That amount of white space is normally equal to half the amount of inter-character space of the ruby text.

css-value:ruby-align:left.description: The ruby text content is aligned with the start edge of the base.

css-value:ruby-align:line-edge.description: If the ruby text is not adjacent to a line edge, it is aligned as in 'auto'. If it is adjacent to a line edge, then it is still aligned as in auto, but the side of the ruby text that touches the end of the line is lined up with the corresponding edge of the base.

css-value:ruby-align:right.description: The ruby text content is aligned with the end edge of the base.

css-value:ruby-align:start.description: The ruby text content is aligned with the start edge of the base.

css-value:ruby-align:space-between.description: The ruby content expands as defined for normal text justification (as defined by 'text-justify'),

css-value:ruby-align:space-around.description: As for 'space-between' except that there exists an extra justification opportunities whose space is distributed half before and half after the ruby content.

css:ruby-overhang.description: Determines whether, and on which side, ruby text is allowed to partially overhang any adjacent text in addition to its own base, when the ruby text is wider than the ruby base.

css-value:ruby-overhang:auto.description: The ruby text can overhang text adjacent to the base on either side. This is the initial value.

css-value:ruby-overhang:end.description: The ruby text can overhang the text that follows it.

css-value:ruby-overhang:none.description: The ruby text cannot overhang any text adjacent to its base, only its own base.

css-value:ruby-overhang:start.description: The ruby text can overhang the text that precedes it.

css:ruby-position.description: Used by the parent of elements with display: ruby-text to control the position of the ruby text with respect to its base.

css-value:ruby-position:after.description: The ruby text appears after the base. This is a relatively rare setting used in ideographic East Asian writing systems, most easily found in educational text.

css-value:ruby-position:before.description: The ruby text appears before the base. This is the most common setting used in ideographic East Asian writing systems.

css-value:ruby-position:right.description: The ruby text appears on the right of the base. Unlike 'before' and 'after', this value is not relative to the text flow direction.

css:ruby-span.description: Determines whether, and on which side, ruby text is allowed to partially overhang any adjacent text in addition to its own base, when the ruby text is wider than the ruby base.

css-value:ruby-span:attr(x).description: The value of attribute 'x' is a string value. The string value is evaluated as a <number> to determine the number of ruby base elements to be spanned by the annotation element.

css-value:ruby-span:none.description: No spanning. The computed value is '1'.

css:scrollbar-3dlight-color.description: Determines the color of the top and left edges of the scroll box and scroll arrows of a scroll bar.

css:scrollbar-arrow-color.description: Determines the color of the arrow elements of a scroll arrow.

css:scrollbar-base-color.description: Determines the color of the main elements of a scroll bar, which include the scroll box, track, and scroll arrows.

css:scrollbar-darkshadow-color.description: Determines the color of the gutter of a scroll bar.

css:scrollbar-face-color.description: Determines the color of the scroll box and scroll arrows of a scroll bar.

css:scrollbar-highlight-color.description: Determines the color of the top and left edges of the scroll box and scroll arrows of a scroll bar.

css:scrollbar-shadow-color.description: Determines the color of the bottom and right edges of the scroll box and scroll arrows of a scroll bar.

css:scrollbar-track-color.description: Determines the color of the track element of a scroll bar.

css:scroll-behavior.description: Specifies the scrolling behavior for a scrolling box, when scrolling happens due to navigation or CSSOM scrolling APIs.

css-value:scroll-behavior:smooth.description: Scrolls in a smooth fashion using a user-agent-defined timing function and time period.

css:scroll-snap-coordinate.description: Defines the x and y coordinate within the element which will align with the nearest ancestor scroll container's snap-destination for the respective axis.

css-value:scroll-snap-coordinate:none.description: Specifies that this element does not contribute a snap point.

css:scroll-snap-destination.description: Define the x and y coordinate within the scroll container's visual viewport which element snap points will align with.

css:scroll-snap-points-x.description: Defines the positioning of snap points along the x axis of the scroll container it is applied to.

css-value:scroll-snap-points-x:none.description: No snap points are defined by this scroll container.

css-value:scroll-snap-points-x:repeat().description: Defines an interval at which snap points are defined, starting from the container's relevant start edge.

css:scroll-snap-points-y.description: Defines the positioning of snap points along the y axis of the scroll container it is applied to.

css-value:scroll-snap-points-y:none.description: No snap points are defined by this scroll container.

css-value:scroll-snap-points-y:repeat().description: Defines an interval at which snap points are defined, starting from the container's relevant start edge.

css:scroll-snap-type.description: Defines how strictly snap points are enforced on the scroll container.
css:scroll-snap-type.syntax: scroll-snap-type: none | [ x | y | block | inline | both ] [ mandatory | proximity ]?;

css-value:scroll-snap-type:none.description: The visual viewport of this scroll container must ignore snap points, if any, when scrolled.

css-value:scroll-snap-type:mandatory.description: The visual viewport of this scroll container is guaranteed to rest on a snap point when there are no active scrolling operations.

css-value:scroll-snap-type:proximity.description: The visual viewport of this scroll container may come to rest on a snap point at the termination of a scroll at the discretion of the UA given the parameters of the scroll.

css:shape-image-threshold.description: Defines the alpha channel threshold used to extract the shape using an image. A value of 0.5 means that the shape will enclose all the pixels that are more than 50% opaque.

css:shape-margin.description: Adds a margin to a 'shape-outside'. This defines a new shape that is the smallest contour that includes all the points that are the 'shape-margin' distance outward in the perpendicular direction from a point on the underlying shape.

css:shape-outside.description: Specifies an orthogonal rotation to be applied to an image before it is laid out.

css-value:shape-outside:margin-box.description: The background is painted within (clipped to) the margin box.

css:shape-rendering.description: Provides hints about what tradeoffs to make as it renders vector graphics elements such as <path> elements and basic shapes such as circles and rectangles.

css-value:shape-rendering:crispEdges.description: Emphasize the contrast between clean edges of artwork over rendering speed and geometric precision.

css-value:shape-rendering:geometricPreci.description: Emphasize geometric precision over speed and crisp edges.

css-value:shape-rendering:optimizeSpeed.description: Emphasize rendering speed over geometric precision and crisp edges.

css:size.description: The size CSS at-rule descriptor, used with the @page at-rule, defines the size and orientation of the box which is used to represent a page. Most of the time, this size corresponds to the target size of the printed page if applicable.

css:src.description: @font-face descriptor. Specifies the resource containing font data. It is required, whether the font is downloadable or locally installed.

css-value:src:format().description: Optional hint describing the format of the font resource.

css-value:src:local().description: Format-specific string that identifies a locally available copy of a given font.

css:stop-color.description: Indicates what color to use at that gradient stop.

css:stop-opacity.description: Defines the opacity of a given gradient stop.

css:stroke.description: Paints along the outline of the given graphical element.

css-value:stroke:url().description: A URL reference to a paint server element, which is an element that defines a paint server: 'hatch', 'linearGradient', 'mesh', 'pattern', 'radialGradient' and 'solidcolor'.

css-value:stroke:none.description: No paint is applied in this layer.

css:stroke-dasharray.description: Controls the pattern of dashes and gaps used to stroke paths.

css-value:stroke-dasharray:none.description: Indicates that no dashing is used.

css:stroke-dashoffset.description: Specifies the distance into the dash pattern to start the dash.

css:stroke-linecap.description: Specifies the shape to be used at the end of open subpaths when they are stroked.

css-value:stroke-linecap:butt.description: Indicates that the stroke for each subpath does not extend beyond its two endpoints.

css-value:stroke-linecap:round.description: Indicates that at each end of each subpath, the shape representing the stroke will be extended by a half circle with a radius equal to the stroke width.

css-value:stroke-linecap:square.description: Indicates that at the end of each subpath, the shape representing the stroke will be extended by a rectangle with the same width as the stroke width and whose length is half of the stroke width.

css:stroke-linejoin.description: Specifies the shape to be used at the corners of paths or basic shapes when they are stroked.
css:stroke-linejoin.syntax: stroke-linejoin: miter | miter-clip | round | bevel | arcs;

css-value:stroke-linejoin:bevel.description: Indicates that a bevelled corner is to be used to join path segments.

css-value:stroke-linejoin:miter.description: Indicates that a sharp corner is to be used to join path segments.

css-value:stroke-linejoin:round.description: Indicates that a round corner is to be used to join path segments.

css:stroke-miterlimit.description: When two line segments meet at a sharp angle and miter joins have been specified for 'stroke-linejoin', it is possible for the miter to extend far beyond the thickness of the line stroking the path.

css:stroke-opacity.description: Specifies the opacity of the painting operation used to stroke the current object.

css:stroke-width.description: Specifies the width of the stroke on the current object.

css:suffix.description: @counter-style descriptor. Specifies a <symbol> that is appended to the marker representation.

css:system.description: @counter-style descriptor. Specifies which algorithm will be used to construct the counter's representation based on the counter value.
css:system.syntax: system: cyclic | numeric | alphabetic | symbolic | additive | [ fixed <integer>? ] | [ extends <counter-style-name> ];

css-value:system:additive.description: Represents "sign-value" numbering systems, which, rather than using reusing digits in different positions to change their value, define additional digits with much larger values, so that the value of the number can be obtained by adding all the digits together.

css-value:system:alphabetic.description: Interprets the list of counter symbols as digits to an alphabetic numbering system, similar to the default lower-alpha counter style, which wraps from "a", "b", "c", to "aa", "ab", "ac".

css-value:system:cyclic.description: Cycles repeatedly through its provided symbols, looping back to the beginning when it reaches the end of the list.

css-value:system:extends.description: Use the algorithm of another counter style, but alter other aspects.

css-value:system:fixed.description: Runs through its list of counter symbols once, then falls back.

css-value:system:numeric.description: interprets the list of counter symbols as digits to a "place-value" numbering system, similar to the default 'decimal' counter style.

css-value:system:symbolic.description: Cycles repeatedly through its provided symbols, doubling, tripling, etc. the symbols on each successive pass through the list.

css:symbols.description: @counter-style descriptor. Specifies the symbols used by the marker-construction algorithm specified by the system descriptor.

css:table-layout.description: Controls the algorithm used to lay out the table cells, rows, and columns.

css-value:table-layout:auto.description: Use any automatic table layout algorithm.

css-value:table-layout:fixed.description: Use the fixed table layout algorithm.

css:tab-size.description: Determines the width of the tab character (U+0009), in space characters (U+0020), when rendered.

css:text-align.description: Describes how inline contents of a block are horizontally aligned if the contents do not completely fill the line box.
css:text-align.syntax: text-align: start | end | left | right | center | justify | match-parent;

css-value:text-align:center.description: The inline contents are centered within the line box.

css-value:text-align:end.description: The inline contents are aligned to the end edge of the line box.

css-value:text-align:justify.description: The text is justified according to the method specified by the 'text-justify' property.

css-value:text-align:left.description: The inline contents are aligned to the left edge of the line box. In vertical text, 'left' aligns to the edge of the line box that would be the start edge for left-to-right text.

css-value:text-align:right.description: The inline contents are aligned to the right edge of the line box. In vertical text, 'right' aligns to the edge of the line box that would be the end edge for left-to-right text.

css-value:text-align:start.description: The inline contents are aligned to the start edge of the line box.

css:text-align-last.description: Describes how the last line of a block or a line right before a forced line break is aligned when 'text-align' is set to 'justify'.
css:text-align-last.syntax: text-align-last: auto | start | end | left | right | center | justify;

css-value:text-align-last:auto.description: Content on the affected line is aligned per 'text-align' unless 'text-align' is set to 'justify', in which case it is 'start-aligned'.

css-value:text-align-last:center.description: The inline contents are centered within the line box.

css-value:text-align-last:justify.description: The text is justified according to the method specified by the 'text-justify' property.

css-value:text-align-last:left.description: The inline contents are aligned to the left edge of the line box. In vertical text, 'left' aligns to the edge of the line box that would be the start edge for left-to-right text.

css-value:text-align-last:right.description: The inline contents are aligned to the right edge of the line box. In vertical text, 'right' aligns to the edge of the line box that would be the end edge for left-to-right text.

css:text-anchor.description: Used to align (start-, middle- or end-alignment) a string of text relative to a given point.

css-value:text-anchor:end.description: The rendered characters are aligned such that the end of the resulting rendered text is at the initial current text position.

css-value:text-anchor:middle.description: The rendered characters are aligned such that the geometric middle of the resulting rendered text is at the initial current text position.

css-value:text-anchor:start.description: The rendered characters are aligned such that the start of the resulting rendered text is at the initial current text position.

css:text-decoration.description: Decorations applied to font used for an element's text.

css-value:text-decoration:line-through.description: Each line of text has a line through the middle.

css-value:text-decoration:overline.description: Each line of text has a line above it.

css-value:text-decoration:underline.description: Each line of text is underlined.

css:text-decoration-color.description: Specifies the color of text decoration (underlines overlines, and line-throughs) set on the element with text-decoration-line.

css:text-decoration-line.description: Specifies what line decorations, if any, are added to the element.
css:text-decoration-line.syntax: text-decoration-line: none | [ underline || overline || line-through || blink ] | spelling-error | grammar-error;

css-value:text-decoration-line:line-thro.description: Each line of text has a line through the middle.

css-value:text-decoration-line:none.description: Neither produces nor inhibits text decoration.

css-value:text-decoration-line:overline.description: Each line of text has a line above it.

css-value:text-decoration-line:underline.description: Each line of text is underlined.

css:text-decoration-style.description: Specifies the line style for underline, line-through and overline text decoration.
css:text-decoration-style.syntax: text-decoration-style: solid | double | dotted | dashed | wavy;

css:text-indent.description: Specifies the indentation applied to lines of inline content in a block. The indentation only affects the first line of inline content in the block unless the 'hanging' keyword is specified, in which case it affects all lines except the first.

css:text-justify.description: Selects the justification algorithm used when 'text-align' is set to 'justify'. The property applies to block containers, but the UA may (but is not required to) also support it on inline elements.

css-value:text-justify:auto.description: The UA determines the justification algorithm to follow, based on a balance between performance and adequate presentation quality.

css-value:text-justify:distribute.description: Justification primarily changes spacing both at word separators and at grapheme cluster boundaries in all scripts except those in the connected and cursive groups. This value is sometimes used in e.g. Japanese, often with the 'text-align-last' property.

css-value:text-justify:inter-cluster.description: Justification primarily changes spacing at word separators and at grapheme cluster boundaries in clustered scripts. This value is typically used for Southeast Asian scripts such as Thai.

css-value:text-justify:inter-ideograph.description: Justification primarily changes spacing at word separators and at inter-graphemic boundaries in scripts that use no word spaces. This value is typically used for CJK languages.

css-value:text-justify:inter-word.description: Justification primarily changes spacing at word separators. This value is typically used for languages that separate words using spaces, like English or (sometimes) Korean.

css-value:text-justify:kashida.description: Justification primarily stretches Arabic and related scripts through the use of kashida or other calligraphic elongation.

css:text-orientation.description: Specifies the orientation of text within a line.

css-value:text-orientation:sideways.description: This value is equivalent to 'sideways-right' in 'vertical-rl' writing mode and equivalent to 'sideways-left' in 'vertical-lr' writing mode.

css-value:text-orientation:sideways-righ.description: In vertical writing modes, this causes text to be set as if in a horizontal layout, but rotated 90° clockwise.

css-value:text-orientation:upright.description: In vertical writing modes, characters from horizontal-only scripts are rendered upright, i.e. in their standard horizontal orientation.

css:text-overflow.description: Text can overflow for example when it is prevented from wrapping.

css-value:text-overflow:clip.description: Clip inline content that overflows. Characters may be only partially rendered.

css-value:text-overflow:ellipsis.description: Render an ellipsis character (U+2026) to represent clipped inline content.

css:text-rendering.description: The creator of SVG content might want to provide a hint to the implementation about what tradeoffs to make as it renders text. The 'text-rendering' property provides these hints.

css-value:text-rendering:geometricPrecis.description: Indicates that the user agent shall emphasize geometric precision over legibility and rendering speed.

css-value:text-rendering:optimizeLegibil.description: Indicates that the user agent shall emphasize legibility over rendering speed and geometric precision.

css-value:text-rendering:optimizeSpeed.description: Indicates that the user agent shall emphasize rendering speed over legibility and geometric precision.

css:text-shadow.description: Enables shadow effects to be applied to the text of the element.

css:text-transform.description: Controls capitalization effects of an element's text.
css:text-transform.syntax: text-transform: none | [ capitalize | uppercase | lowercase ] || full-width || full-size-kana | math-auto;

css-value:text-transform:capitalize.description: Puts the first typographic letter unit of each word in titlecase.

css:text-underline-position.description: Sets the position of an underline specified on the same element: it does not affect underlines specified by ancestor elements. This property is typically used in vertical writing contexts such as in Japanese documents where it often desired to have the underline appear 'over' (to the right of) the affected run of text
css:text-underline-position.syntax: text-underline-position: auto | from-font | [ under || [ left | right ] ];

css-value:text-underline-position:auto.description: The user agent may use any algorithm to determine the underline's position. In horizontal line layout, the underline should be aligned as for alphabetic. In vertical line layout, if the language is set to Japanese or Korean, the underline should be aligned as for over.

css-value:text-underline-position:below.description: The underline is aligned with the under edge of the element's content box.

css:top.description: Specifies how far an absolutely positioned box's top margin edge is offset below the top edge of the box's 'containing block'.

css-value:top:auto.description: For non-replaced elements, the effect of this value depends on which of related properties have the value 'auto' as well

css:touch-action.description: Determines whether touch input may trigger default behavior supplied by user agent.
css:touch-action.syntax: touch-action: auto | none | [ [ pan-x | pan-left | pan-right ] || [ pan-y | pan-up | pan-down ] || pinch-zoom ] | manipulation;

css-value:touch-action:auto.description: The user agent may determine any permitted touch behaviors for touches that begin on the element.

css-value:touch-action:manipulation.description: The user agent may consider touches that begin on the element only for the purposes of scrolling and continuous zooming.

css-value:touch-action:none.description: Touches that begin on the element must not trigger default touch behaviors.

css-value:touch-action:pan-x.description: The user agent may consider touches that begin on the element only for the purposes of horizontally scrolling the element's nearest ancestor with horizontally scrollable content.

css-value:touch-action:pan-y.description: The user agent may consider touches that begin on the element only for the purposes of vertically scrolling the element's nearest ancestor with vertically scrollable content.

css:transform.description: A two-dimensional transformation is applied to an element through the 'transform' property. This property contains a list of transform functions similar to those allowed by SVG.

css-value:transform:matrix().description: Specifies a 2D transformation in the form of a transformation matrix of six values. matrix(a,b,c,d,e,f) is equivalent to applying the transformation matrix [a b c d e f]

css-value:transform:matrix3d().description: Specifies a 3D transformation as a 4x4 homogeneous matrix of 16 values in column-major order.

css-value:transform:rotate().description: Specifies a 2D rotation by the angle specified in the parameter about the origin of the element, as defined by the transform-origin property.

css-value:transform:rotate3d().description: Specifies a clockwise 3D rotation by the angle specified in last parameter about the [x,y,z] direction vector described by the first 3 parameters.

css-value:transform:rotateX('angle').description: Specifies a clockwise rotation by the given angle about the X axis.

css-value:transform:rotateY('angle').description: Specifies a clockwise rotation by the given angle about the Y axis.

css-value:transform:rotateZ('angle').description: Specifies a clockwise rotation by the given angle about the Z axis.

css-value:transform:scale().description: Specifies a 2D scale operation by the [sx,sy] scaling vector described by the 2 parameters. If the second parameter is not provided, it is takes a value equal to the first.

css-value:transform:scale3d().description: Specifies a 3D scale operation by the [sx,sy,sz] scaling vector described by the 3 parameters.

css-value:transform:scaleX().description: Specifies a scale operation using the [sx,1] scaling vector, where sx is given as the parameter.

css-value:transform:scaleY().description: Specifies a scale operation using the [sy,1] scaling vector, where sy is given as the parameter.

css-value:transform:scaleZ().description: Specifies a scale operation using the [1,1,sz] scaling vector, where sz is given as the parameter.

css-value:transform:skew().description: Specifies a skew transformation along the X and Y axes. The first angle parameter specifies the skew on the X axis. The second angle parameter specifies the skew on the Y axis. If the second parameter is not given then a value of 0 is used for the Y angle (ie: no skew on the Y axis).

css-value:transform:skewX().description: Specifies a skew transformation along the X axis by the given angle.

css-value:transform:skewY().description: Specifies a skew transformation along the Y axis by the given angle.

css-value:transform:translate().description: Specifies a 2D translation by the vector [tx, ty], where tx is the first translation-value parameter and ty is the optional second translation-value parameter.

css-value:transform:translate3d().description: Specifies a 3D translation by the vector [tx,ty,tz], with tx, ty and tz being the first, second and third translation-value parameters respectively.

css-value:transform:translateX().description: Specifies a translation by the given amount in the X direction.

css-value:transform:translateY().description: Specifies a translation by the given amount in the Y direction.

css-value:transform:translateZ().description: Specifies a translation by the given amount in the Z direction. Note that percentage values are not allowed in the translateZ translation-value, and if present are evaluated as 0.

css:transform-origin.description: Establishes the origin of transformation for an element.
css:transform-origin.syntax: transform-origin: [ <length-percentage> | left | center | right | top | bottom ] | [ [ <length-percentage> | left | center | right ] && [ <length-percentage> | top | center | bottom ] ] <length>?;

css:transform-style.description: Defines how nested elements are rendered in 3D space.

css-value:transform-style:flat.description: All children of this element are rendered flattened into the 2D plane of the element.

css-value:transform-style:preserve-3d.description: Flattening is not performed, so children maintain their position in 3D space.

css:transition.description: Shorthand property combines four of the transition properties into a single property.

css-value:transition:all.description: Every property that is able to undergo a transition will do so.

css:transition-delay.description: Defines when the transition will start. It allows a transition to begin execution some period of time from when it is applied.

css:transition-duration.description: Specifies how long the transition from the old value to the new value should take.

css:transition-property.description: Specifies the name of the CSS property to which the transition is applied.

css-value:transition-property:all.description: Every property that is able to undergo a transition will do so.

css:transition-timing-function.description: Describes how the intermediate values used during a transition will be calculated.

css:unicode-bidi.description: The level of embedding with respect to the bidirectional algorithm.
css:unicode-bidi.syntax: unicode-bidi: normal | embed | isolate | bidi-override | isolate-override | plaintext;

css-value:unicode-bidi:bidi-override.description: Inside the element, reordering is strictly in sequence according to the 'direction' property; the implicit part of the bidirectional algorithm is ignored.

css-value:unicode-bidi:embed.description: If the element is inline-level, this value opens an additional level of embedding with respect to the bidirectional algorithm. The direction of this embedding level is given by the 'direction' property.

css-value:unicode-bidi:isolate.description: The contents of the element are considered to be inside a separate, independent paragraph.

css-value:unicode-bidi:isolate-override.description: This combines the isolation behavior of 'isolate' with the directional override behavior of 'bidi-override'

css-value:unicode-bidi:normal.description: The element does not open an additional level of embedding with respect to the bidirectional algorithm. For inline-level elements, implicit reordering works across element boundaries.

css-value:unicode-bidi:plaintext.description: For the purposes of the Unicode bidirectional algorithm, the base directionality of each bidi paragraph for which the element forms the containing block is determined not by the element's computed 'direction'.

css:unicode-range.description: @font-face descriptor. Defines the set of Unicode codepoints that may be supported by the font face for which it is declared.

css-value:unicode-range:U+20-24F, U+2B0-.syntax: unicode-range: U+20-24F, U+2B0-2FF, U+370-4FF, U+1E00-1EFF, U+2000-20CF, U+2100-23FF, U+2500-26FF, U+E000-F8FF, U+FB00-FB4F;

css-value:unicode-range:U+20-17F, U+2B0-.description: The Multilingual European Subset No. 1. Latin. Covers ~44 languages.

css-value:unicode-range:U+20-2FF, U+370-.description: The Multilingual European Subset No. 2. Latin, Greek, and Cyrillic. Covers ~128 language.
css-value:unicode-range:U+20-2FF, U+370-.syntax: unicode-range: U+20-2FF, U+370-4FF, U+1E00-20CF, U+2100-23FF, U+2500-26FF, U+FB00-FB4F, U+FFF0-FFFD;

css-value:unicode-range:U+20-4FF, U+530-.description: The Multilingual European Subset No. 3. Covers all characters belonging to European scripts.
css-value:unicode-range:U+20-4FF, U+530-.syntax: unicode-range: U+20-4FF, U+530-58F, U+10D0-10FF, U+1E00-23FF, U+2440-245F, U+2500-26FF, U+FB00-FB4F, U+FE20-FE2F, U+FFF0-FFFD;

css-value:unicode-range:U+80-FF.description: Latin-1 Supplement. Accented characters for Western European languages, common punctuation characters, multiplication and division signs.

css-value:unicode-range:U+100-17F.description: Latin Extended-A. Accented characters for for Czech, Dutch, Polish, and Turkish.

css-value:unicode-range:U+180-24F.description: Latin Extended-B. Croatian, Slovenian, Romanian, Non-European and historic latin, Khoisan, Pinyin, Livonian, Sinology.

css-value:unicode-range:U+1E00-1EFF.description: Latin Extended Additional. Vietnamese, German captial sharp s, Medievalist, Latin general use.

css-value:unicode-range:U+1F00-1FFF.description: Greek Extended. Accented characters for polytonic Greek.

css-value:unicode-range:U+500-52F.description: Cyrillic Supplement. Extra letters for Komi, Khanty, Chukchi, Mordvin, Kurdish, Aleut, Chuvash, Abkhaz, Azerbaijani, and Orok.

css-value:unicode-range:U+00-52F, U+1E00.description: Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, some punctuation and symbols.

css-value:unicode-range:U+750-77F.description: Arabic Supplement. Additional letters for African languages, Khowar, Torwali, Burushaski, and early Persian.

css-value:unicode-range:U+8A0-8FF.description: Arabic Extended-A. Additional letters for African languages, European and Central Asian languages, Rohingya, Tamazight, Arwi, and Koranic annotation signs.

css-value:unicode-range:U+1380-139F.description: Ethiopic Supplement. Extra Syllables for Sebatbeit, and Tonal marks

css-value:unicode-range:U+2D80-2DDF.description: Ethiopic Extended. Extra Syllables for Me'en, Blin, and Sebatbeit.

css-value:unicode-range:U+AB00-AB2F.description: Ethiopic Extended-A. Extra characters for Gamo-Gofa-Dawro, Basketo, and Gumuz.

css-value:unicode-range:U+4E00-9FD5.description: CJK (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) Unified Ideographs. Most common ideographs for modern Chinese and Japanese.

css-value:unicode-range:U+3400-4DB5.description: CJK Unified Ideographs Extension A. Rare ideographs.

css-value:unicode-range:U+2E80-2EFF.description: CJK Radicals Supplement. Alternative forms of Kangxi Radicals.

css-value:unicode-range:U+A5, U+4E00-9FF.description: Japanese Kanji, Hiragana and Katakana characters plus Yen/Yuan symbol.

css-value:unicode-range:U+FB00-FB4F.description: Alphabetic Presentation Forms. Ligatures for latin, Armenian, and Hebrew.

css-value:unicode-range:U+FB50-FDFF.description: Arabic Presentation Forms-A. Contextual forms / ligatures for Persian, Urdu, Sindhi, Central Asian languages, etc, Arabic pedagogical symbols, word ligatures.

css-value:user-select:all.description: The content of the element must be selected atomically

css-value:user-select:contain.description: UAs must not allow a selection which is started in this element to be extended outside of this element.

css-value:user-select:none.description: The UA must not allow selections to be started in this element.

css-value:user-select:text.description: The element imposes no constraint on the selection.

css:vertical-align.description: Affects the vertical positioning of the inline boxes generated by an inline-level element inside a line box.
css:vertical-align.syntax: vertical-align: baseline | sub | super | text-top | text-bottom | middle | top | bottom | <percentage> | <length>;

css-value:vertical-align:auto.description: Align the dominant baseline of the parent box with the equivalent, or heuristically reconstructed, baseline of the element inline box.

css-value:vertical-align:baseline.description: Align the 'alphabetic' baseline of the element with the 'alphabetic' baseline of the parent element.

css-value:vertical-align:bottom.description: Align the after edge of the extended inline box with the after-edge of the line box.

css-value:vertical-align:middle.description: Align the 'middle' baseline of the inline element with the middle baseline of the parent.

css-value:vertical-align:sub.description: Lower the baseline of the box to the proper position for subscripts of the parent's box. (This value has no effect on the font size of the element's text.)

css-value:vertical-align:super.description: Raise the baseline of the box to the proper position for superscripts of the parent's box. (This value has no effect on the font size of the element's text.)

css-value:vertical-align:text-bottom.description: Align the bottom of the box with the after-edge of the parent element's font.

css-value:vertical-align:text-top.description: Align the top of the box with the before-edge of the parent element's font.

css-value:vertical-align:top.description: Align the before edge of the extended inline box with the before-edge of the line box.

css:visibility.description: Specifies whether the boxes generated by an element are rendered. Invisible boxes still affect layout (set the 'display' property to 'none' to suppress box generation altogether).

css-value:visibility:collapse.description: Table-specific. If used on elements other than rows, row groups, columns, or column groups, 'collapse' has the same meaning as 'hidden'.

css-value:visibility:hidden.description: The generated box is invisible (fully transparent, nothing is drawn), but still affects layout.

css:-webkit-animation.description: Shorthand property combines six of the animation properties into a single property.

css-value:-webkit-animation:alternate.description: The animation cycle iterations that are odd counts are played in the normal direction, and the animation cycle iterations that are even counts are played in a reverse direction.

css-value:-webkit-animation:alternate-re.description: The animation cycle iterations that are odd counts are played in the reverse direction, and the animation cycle iterations that are even counts are played in a normal direction.

css-value:-webkit-animation:backwards.description: The beginning property value (as defined in the first @keyframes at-rule) is applied before the animation is displayed, during the period defined by 'animation-delay'.

css-value:-webkit-animation:both.description: Both forwards and backwards fill modes are applied.

css-value:-webkit-animation:forwards.description: The final property value (as defined in the last @keyframes at-rule) is maintained after the animation completes.

css-value:-webkit-animation:infinite.description: Causes the animation to repeat forever.

css-value:-webkit-animation:reverse.description: All iterations of the animation are played in the reverse direction from the way they were specified.

css:-webkit-animation-delay.description: Defines when the animation will start.

css:-webkit-animation-direction.description: Defines whether or not the animation should play in reverse on alternate cycles.

css-value:-webkit-animation-direction:al.description: The animation cycle iterations that are odd counts are played in the normal direction, and the animation cycle iterations that are even counts are played in a reverse direction.
The animation cycle iterations that are odd counts are played in the reverse direction, and the animation cycle iterations that are even counts are played in a normal direction.

css-value:-webkit-animation-direction:re.description: All iterations of the animation are played in the reverse direction from the way they were specified.

css:-webkit-animation-duration.description: Defines the length of time that an animation takes to complete one cycle.

css:-webkit-animation-fill-mode.description: Defines what values are applied by the animation outside the time it is executing.

css-value:-webkit-animation-fill-mode:ba.description: The beginning property value (as defined in the first @keyframes at-rule) is applied before the animation is displayed, during the period defined by 'animation-delay'.

css-value:-webkit-animation-fill-mode:bo.description: Both forwards and backwards fill modes are applied.

css-value:-webkit-animation-fill-mode:fo.description: The final property value (as defined in the last @keyframes at-rule) is maintained after the animation completes.

css-value:-webkit-animation-fill-mode:no.description: There is no change to the property value between the time the animation is applied and the time the animation begins playing or after the animation completes.

css:-webkit-animation-iteration-count.description: Defines the number of times an animation cycle is played. The default value is one, meaning the animation will play from beginning to end once.

css-value:-webkit-animation-iteration-co.description: Causes the animation to repeat forever.

css:-webkit-animation-name.description: Defines a list of animations that apply. Each name is used to select the keyframe at-rule that provides the property values for the animation.

css:-webkit-animation-play-state.description: Defines whether the animation is running or paused.

css-value:-webkit-animation-play-state:p.description: A running animation will be paused.

css-value:-webkit-animation-play-state:r.description: Resume playback of a paused animation.

css:-webkit-animation-timing-function.description: Describes how the animation will progress over one cycle of its duration. See the 'transition-timing-function'.

css:-webkit-appearance.description: Changes the appearance of buttons and other controls to resemble native controls.
css:-webkit-appearance.syntax: -webkit-appearance: none | button | button-bevel | caret | checkbox | default-button | inner-spin-button | listbox | listitem | media-controls-background | media-controls-fullscreen-background | media-current-time-display | media-enter-fullscreen-button | media-exit-fullscreen-button | media-fullscreen-button | media-mute-button | media-overlay-play-button | media-play-button | media-seek-back-button | media-seek-forward-button | media-slider | media-sliderthumb | media-time-remaining-display | media-toggle-closed-captions-button | media-volume-slider | media-volume-slider-container | media-volume-sliderthumb | menulist | menulist-button | menulist-text | menulist-textfield | meter | progress-bar | progress-bar-value | push-button | radio | searchfield | searchfield-cancel-button | searchfield-decoration | searchfield-results-button | searchfield-results-decoration | slider-horizontal | slider-vertical | sliderthumb-horizontal | sliderthumb-vertical | square-button | textarea | textfield | -apple-pay-button;

css:-webkit-backdrop-filter.description: Applies a filter effect where the first filter in the list takes the element's background image as the input image.

css-value:-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur().description: Applies a Gaussian blur to the input image.

css-value:-webkit-backdrop-filter:bright.description: Applies a linear multiplier to input image, making it appear more or less bright.

css-value:-webkit-backdrop-filter:contra.description: Adjusts the contrast of the input.

css-value:-webkit-backdrop-filter:drop-s.description: Applies a drop shadow effect to the input image.

css-value:-webkit-backdrop-filter:graysc.description: Converts the input image to grayscale.

css-value:-webkit-backdrop-filter:hue-ro.description: Applies a hue rotation on the input image.

css-value:-webkit-backdrop-filter:invert.description: Inverts the samples in the input image.

css-value:-webkit-backdrop-filter:opacit.description: Applies transparency to the samples in the input image.

css-value:-webkit-backdrop-filter:sepia(.description: Converts the input image to sepia.

css-value:-webkit-backdrop-filter:url().description: A filter reference to a <filter> element.

css:-webkit-backface-visibility.description: Determines whether or not the 'back' side of a transformed element is visible when facing the viewer. With an identity transform, the front side of an element faces the viewer.

css:-webkit-background-origin.description: For elements rendered as a single box, specifies the background positioning area. For elements rendered as multiple boxes (e.g., inline boxes on several lines, boxes on several pages) specifies which boxes 'box-decoration-break' operates on to determine the background positioning area(s).

css:-webkit-border-image.description: Shorthand property for setting 'border-image-source', 'border-image-slice', 'border-image-width', 'border-image-outset' and 'border-image-repeat'. Omitted values are set to their initial values.

css-value:-webkit-border-image:auto.description: If 'auto' is specified then the border image width is the intrinsic width or height (whichever is applicable) of the corresponding image slice. If the image does not have the required intrinsic dimension then the corresponding border-width is used instead.

css-value:-webkit-border-image:fill.description: Causes the middle part of the border-image to be preserved.

css-value:-webkit-border-image:repeat.description: The image is tiled (repeated) to fill the area.

css-value:-webkit-border-image:round.description: The image is tiled (repeated) to fill the area. If it does not fill the area with a whole number of tiles, the image is rescaled so that it does.

css-value:-webkit-border-image:space.description: The image is tiled (repeated) to fill the area. If it does not fill the area with a whole number of tiles, the extra space is distributed around the tiles.

css-value:-webkit-border-image:stretch.description: The image is stretched to fill the area.

css:-webkit-box-align.description: Specifies the alignment of nested elements within an outer flexible box element.

css-value:-webkit-box-align:baseline.description: If this box orientation is inline-axis or horizontal, all children are placed with their baselines aligned, and extra space placed before or after as necessary. For block flows, the baseline of the first non-empty line box located within the element is used. For tables, the baseline of the first cell is used.

css-value:-webkit-box-align:center.description: Any extra space is divided evenly, with half placed above the child and the other half placed after the child.

css-value:-webkit-box-align:end.description: For normal direction boxes, the bottom edge of each child is placed along the bottom of the box. Extra space is placed above the element. For reverse direction boxes, the top edge of each child is placed along the top of the box. Extra space is placed below the element.

css-value:-webkit-box-align:start.description: For normal direction boxes, the top edge of each child is placed along the top of the box. Extra space is placed below the element. For reverse direction boxes, the bottom edge of each child is placed along the bottom of the box. Extra space is placed above the element.

css-value:-webkit-box-align:stretch.description: The height of each child is adjusted to that of the containing block.
