js:AudioBufferSourceNode:loopEnd.description: The loopEnd property of the AudioBufferSourceNode interface specifies is a floating point number specifying, in seconds, at what offset into playing the AudioBuffer playback should loop back to the time indicated by the loopStart property. This is only used if the loop property is true.

js:AudioBufferSourceNode:loopStart.description: The loopStart property of the AudioBufferSourceNode interface is a floating-point value indicating, in seconds, where in the AudioBuffer the restart of the play must happen.

js:AudioBufferSourceNode:playbackRate.description: The playbackRate property of the AudioBufferSourceNode interface Is a k-rate AudioParam that defines the speed at which the audio asset will be played.

js:AudioBufferSourceNode:start.description: The start() method of the AudioBufferSourceNode Interface is used to schedule playback of the audio data contained in the buffer, or to begin playback immediately.
js:AudioBufferSourceNode:start.syntax: start(when?: number, offset?: number, duration?: number): void

js:AudioContext:baseLatency.description: The baseLatency read-only property of the AudioContext interface returns a double that represents the number of seconds of processing latency incurred by the AudioContext passing an audio buffer from the AudioDestinationNode — i.e., the end of the audio graph — into the host system's audio subsystem ready for playing.

js:AudioContext:outputLatency.description: The outputLatency read-only property of the AudioContext Interface provides an estimation of the output latency of the current audio context.

js:AudioContext:close.description: The close() method of the AudioContext Interface closes the audio context, releasing any system audio resources that it uses.

js:AudioContext:createMediaElementSource.description: The createMediaElementSource() method of the AudioContext Interface is used to create a new MediaElementAudioSourceNode object, given an existing HTML <audio> or <video> element, the audio from which can then be played and manipulated.

js:AudioContext:createMediaStreamDestina.description: The createMediaStreamDestination() method of the AudioContext Interface is used to create a new MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode object associated with a WebRTC MediaStream representing an audio stream, which may be stored in a local file or sent to another computer.

js:AudioContext:createMediaStreamSource.description: The createMediaStreamSource() method of the AudioContext Interface is used to create a new MediaStreamAudioSourceNode object, given a media stream (say, from a MediaDevices.getUserMedia instance), the audio from which can then be played and manipulated.

js:AudioContext:getOutputTimestamp.description: The getOutputTimestamp() method of the AudioContext interface returns a new AudioTimestamp object containing two audio timestamp values relating to the current audio context.

js:AudioContext:resume.description: The resume() method of the AudioContext interface resumes the progression of time in an audio context that has previously been suspended.

js:AudioContext:suspend.description: The suspend() method of the AudioContext Interface suspends the progression of time in the audio context, temporarily halting audio hardware access and reducing CPU/battery usage in the process — this is useful if you want an application to power down the audio hardware when it will not be using an audio context for a while.

js:AudioData:duration.description: The duration read-only property of the AudioData interface returns the duration in microseconds of this AudioData object.

js:AudioData:format.description: The format read-only property of the AudioData interface returns the sample format of the AudioData object.

js:AudioData:numberOfChannels.description: The numberOfChannels read-only property of the AudioData interface returns the number of channels in the AudioData object.

js:AudioData:numberOfFrames.description: The numberOfFrames read-only property of the AudioData interface returns the number of frames in the AudioData object.

js:AudioData:sampleRate.description: The sampleRate read-only property of the AudioData interface returns the sample rate in Hz.

js:AudioData:timestamp.description: The timestamp read-only property of the AudioData interface returns the timestamp of this AudioData object.

js:AudioData:allocationSize.description: The allocationSize() method of the AudioData interface returns the size in bytes required to hold the current sample as filtered by options passed into the method.

js:AudioData:clone.description: The clone() method of the AudioData interface creates a new AudioData object with reference to the same media resource as the original.

js:AudioData:close.description: The close() method of the AudioData interface clears all states and releases the reference to the media resource.

js:AudioData:copyTo.description: The copyTo() method of the AudioData interface copies a plane of an AudioData object to a destination buffer.

js:AudioDecoder:decodeQueueSize.description: The decodeQueueSize read-only property of the AudioDecoder interface returns the number of pending decode requests in the queue.

js:AudioDecoder:state.description: The state read-only property of the AudioDecoder interface returns the current state of the underlying codec.

js:AudioDecoder:close.description: The close() method of the AudioDecoder interface ends all pending work and releases system resources.

js:AudioDecoder:configure.description: The configure() method of the AudioDecoder interface enqueues a control message to configure the audio decoder for decoding chunks.

js:AudioDecoder:decode.description: The decode() method of the AudioDecoder interface enqueues a control message to decode a given chunk of audio.

js:AudioDecoder:flush.description: The flush() method of the AudioDecoder interface returns a Promise that resolves once all pending messages in the queue have been completed.

js:AudioDecoder:reset.description: The reset() method of the AudioDecoder interface resets all states including configuration, control messages in the control message queue, and all pending callbacks.

js:AudioDestinationNode:maxChannelCount.description: The maxChannelCount property of the AudioDestinationNode interface is an unsigned long defining the maximum amount of channels that the physical device can handle.

js:AudioEncoder:encodeQueueSize.description: The encodeQueueSize read-only property of the AudioEncoder interface returns the number of pending encode requests in the queue.

js:AudioEncoder:state.description: The state read-only property of the AudioEncoder interface returns the current state of the underlying codec.

js:AudioEncoder:close.description: The close() method of the AudioEncoder interface ends all pending work and releases system resources.

js:AudioEncoder:configure.description: The configure() method of the AudioEncoder interface enqueues a control message to configure the audio encoder for encoding chunks.

js:AudioEncoder:encode.description: The encode() method of the AudioEncoder interface enqueues a control message to encode a given AudioData object.

js:AudioEncoder:flush.description: The flush() method of the AudioEncoder interface returns a Promise that resolves once all pending messages in the queue have been completed.

js:AudioEncoder:reset.description: The reset() method of the AudioEncoder interface resets all states including configuration, control messages in the control message queue, and all pending callbacks.

js:AudioListener:forwardX.description: The forwardX read-only property of the AudioListener interface is an AudioParam representing the x value of the direction vector defining the forward direction the listener is pointing in.

js:AudioListener:forwardY.description: The forwardY read-only property of the AudioListener interface is an AudioParam representing the y value of the direction vector defining the forward direction the listener is pointing in.

js:AudioListener:forwardZ.description: The forwardZ read-only property of the AudioListener interface is an AudioParam representing the z value of the direction vector defining the forward direction the listener is pointing in.

js:AudioListener:positionX.description: The positionX read-only property of the AudioListener interface is an AudioParam representing the x position of the listener in 3D cartesian space.

js:AudioListener:positionY.description: The positionY read-only property of the AudioListener interface is an AudioParam representing the y position of the listener in 3D cartesian space.

js:AudioListener:positionZ.description: The positionZ read-only property of the AudioListener interface is an AudioParam representing the z position of the listener in 3D cartesian space.

js:AudioListener:upX.description: The upX read-only property of the AudioListener interface is an AudioParam representing the x value of the direction vector defining the up direction the listener is pointing in.

js:AudioListener:upY.description: The upY read-only property of the AudioListener interface is an AudioParam representing the y value of the direction vector defining the up direction the listener is pointing in.

js:AudioListener:upZ.description: The upZ read-only property of the AudioListener interface is an AudioParam representing the z value of the direction vector defining the up direction the listener is pointing in.

js:AudioListener:setOrientation.description:
The setOrientation() method of the AudioListener interface defines the orientation of the listener.
@deprecated
js:AudioListener:setOrientation.syntax: setOrientation(x: number, y: number, z: number, xUp: number, yUp: number, zUp: number): void

js:AudioListener:setPosition.description:
The setPosition() method of the AudioListener Interface defines the position of the listener.
@deprecated
js:AudioListener:setPosition.syntax: setPosition(x: number, y: number, z: number): void

js:AudioNode:channelCount.description: The channelCount property of the AudioNode interface represents an integer used to determine how many channels are used when up-mixing and down-mixing connections to any inputs to the node.

js:AudioNode:channelCountMode.description: The channelCountMode property of the AudioNode interface represents an enumerated value describing the way channels must be matched between the node's inputs and outputs.

js:AudioNode:channelInterpretation.description: The channelInterpretation property of the AudioNode interface represents an enumerated value describing how input channels are mapped to output channels when the number of inputs/outputs is different. For example, this setting defines how a mono input will be up-mixed to a stereo or 5.1 channel output, or how a quad channel input will be down-mixed to a stereo or mono output.

js:AudioNode:context.description: The read-only context property of the AudioNode interface returns the associated BaseAudioContext, that is the object representing the processing graph the node is participating in.

js:AudioNode:numberOfInputs.description: The numberOfInputs property of the AudioNode interface returns the number of inputs feeding the node. Source nodes are defined as nodes having a numberOfInputs property with a value of 0.

js:AudioNode:numberOfOutputs.description: The numberOfOutputs property of the AudioNode interface returns the number of outputs coming out of the node. Destination nodes — like AudioDestinationNode — have a value of 0 for this attribute.

js:AudioNode:connect.description: The connect() method of the AudioNode interface lets you connect one of the node's outputs to a target, which may be either another AudioNode (thereby directing the sound data to the specified node) or an AudioParam, so that the node's output data is automatically used to change the value of that parameter over time.
js:AudioNode:connect.syntax: connect(destinationNode: AudioNode, output?: number, input?: number): AudioNode

js:AudioNode:disconnect.description: The disconnect() method of the AudioNode interface lets you disconnect one or more nodes from the node on which the method is called.

js:AudioParam:defaultValue.description: The defaultValue read-only property of the AudioParam interface represents the initial value of the attributes as defined by the specific AudioNode creating the AudioParam.

js:AudioParam:maxValue.description: The maxValue read-only property of the AudioParam interface represents the maximum possible value for the parameter's nominal (effective) range.

js:AudioParam:minValue.description: The minValue read-only property of the AudioParam interface represents the minimum possible value for the parameter's nominal (effective) range.

js:AudioParam:value.description: The value property of the AudioParam interface gets or sets the value of this AudioParam at the current time. Initially, the value is set to AudioParam.defaultValue.

js:AudioParam:cancelAndHoldAtTime.description: The cancelAndHoldAtTime() method of the AudioParam interface cancels all scheduled future changes to the AudioParam but holds its value at a given time until further changes are made using other methods.

js:AudioParam:cancelScheduledValues.description: The cancelScheduledValues() method of the AudioParam Interface cancels all scheduled future changes to the AudioParam.

js:AudioParam:exponentialRampToValueAtTi.description: The exponentialRampToValueAtTime() method of the AudioParam Interface schedules a gradual exponential change in the value of the AudioParam. The change starts at the time specified for the previous event, follows an exponential ramp to the new value given in the value parameter, and reaches the new value at the time given in the endTime parameter.

js:AudioParam:linearRampToValueAtTime.description: The linearRampToValueAtTime() method of the AudioParam Interface schedules a gradual linear change in the value of the AudioParam. The change starts at the time specified for the previous event, follows a linear ramp to the new value given in the value parameter, and reaches the new value at the time given in the endTime parameter.

js:AudioParam:setTargetAtTime.description: The setTargetAtTime() method of the AudioParam interface schedules the start of a gradual change to the AudioParam value. This is useful for decay or release portions of ADSR envelopes.
js:AudioParam:setTargetAtTime.syntax: setTargetAtTime(target: number, startTime: number, timeConstant: number): AudioParam

js:AudioParam:setValueAtTime.description: The setValueAtTime() method of the AudioParam interface schedules an instant change to the AudioParam value at a precise time, as measured against AudioContext.currentTime. The new value is given in the value parameter.

js:AudioParam:setValueCurveAtTime.description: The setValueCurveAtTime() method of the AudioParam interface schedules the parameter's value to change following a curve defined by a list of values.
js:AudioParam:setValueCurveAtTime.syntax: setValueCurveAtTime(values: number[] | Float32Array, startTime: number, duration: number): AudioParam

js:AudioProcessingEvent:inputBuffer.description:
The inputBuffer read-only property of the AudioProcessingEvent interface represents the input buffer of an audio processing event.
@deprecated

js:AudioProcessingEvent:outputBuffer.description:
The outputBuffer read-only property of the AudioProcessingEvent interface represents the output buffer of an audio processing event.
@deprecated

js:AudioProcessingEvent:playbackTime.description:
The playbackTime read-only property of the AudioProcessingEvent interface represents the time when the audio will be played. It is in the same coordinate system as the time used by the AudioContext.
@deprecated

js:AudioScheduledSourceNode:start.description: The start() method on AudioScheduledSourceNode schedules a sound to begin playback at the specified time. If no time is specified, then the sound begins playing immediately.

js:AudioScheduledSourceNode:stop.description: The stop() method on AudioScheduledSourceNode schedules a sound to cease playback at the specified time. If no time is specified, then the sound stops playing immediately.

js:AudioWorkletNode:parameters.description: The read-only parameters property of the AudioWorkletNode interface returns the associated AudioParamMap — that is, a Map-like collection of AudioParam objects. They are instantiated during creation of the underlying AudioWorkletProcessor according to its parameterDescriptors static getter.

js:AudioWorkletNode:port.description: The read-only port property of the AudioWorkletNode interface returns the associated MessagePort. It can be used to communicate between the node and its associated AudioWorkletProcessor.

js:AuthenticatorAssertionResponse:authen.description: The authenticatorData property of the AuthenticatorAssertionResponse interface returns an ArrayBuffer containing information from the authenticator such as the Relying Party ID Hash (rpIdHash), a signature counter, test of user presence, user verification flags, and any extensions processed by the authenticator.

js:AuthenticatorAssertionResponse:signat.description: The signature read-only property of the AuthenticatorAssertionResponse interface is an ArrayBuffer object which is the signature of the authenticator for both AuthenticatorAssertionResponse.authenticatorData and a SHA-256 hash of the client data (AuthenticatorAssertionResponse.clientDataJSON).

js:AuthenticatorAssertionResponse:userHa.description: The userHandle read-only property of the AuthenticatorAssertionResponse interface is an ArrayBuffer object providing an opaque identifier for the given user. Such an identifier can be used by the relying party's server to link the user account with its corresponding credentials and other data.

js:AuthenticatorAttestationResponse:atte.description: The attestationObject property of the AuthenticatorAttestationResponse interface returns an ArrayBuffer containing the new public key, as well as signature over the entire attestationObject with a private key that is stored in the authenticator when it is manufactured.

js:AuthenticatorAttestationResponse:getA.description: The getAuthenticatorData() method of the AuthenticatorAttestationResponse interface returns an ArrayBuffer containing the authenticator data contained within the AuthenticatorAttestationResponse.attestationObject property.

js:AuthenticatorAttestationResponse:getP.description: The getPublicKey() method of the AuthenticatorAttestationResponse interface returns an ArrayBuffer containing the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo of the new credential (see Subject Public Key Info), or null if this is not available.

The getPublicKeyAlgorithm() method of the AuthenticatorAttestationResponse interface returns a number that is equal to a COSE Algorithm Identifier, representing the cryptographic algorithm used for the new credential.

js:AuthenticatorAttestationResponse:getT.description: The getTransports() method of the AuthenticatorAttestationResponse interface returns an array of strings describing the different transports which may be used by the authenticator.

js:AuthenticatorResponse:clientDataJSON.description: The clientDataJSON property of the AuthenticatorResponse interface stores a JSON string in an ArrayBuffer, representing the client data that was passed to navigator.credentials.create() or navigator.credentials.get(). This property is only accessed on one of the child objects of AuthenticatorResponse, specifically AuthenticatorAttestationResponse or AuthenticatorAssertionResponse.

js:BarProp:visible.description: The visible read-only property of the BarProp interface returns true if the user interface element it represents is visible.

js:BaseAudioContext:audioWorklet.description:
The audioWorklet read-only property of the BaseAudioContext interface returns an instance of AudioWorklet that can be used for adding AudioWorkletProcessor-derived classes which implement custom audio processing.
Available only in secure contexts.

js:BaseAudioContext:currentTime.description: The currentTime read-only property of the BaseAudioContext interface returns a double representing an ever-increasing hardware timestamp in seconds that can be used for scheduling audio playback, visualizing timelines, etc. It starts at 0.

js:BaseAudioContext:destination.description: The destination property of the BaseAudioContext interface returns an AudioDestinationNode representing the final destination of all audio in the context. It often represents an actual audio-rendering device such as your device's speakers.

js:BaseAudioContext:listener.description: The listener property of the BaseAudioContext interface returns an AudioListener object that can then be used for implementing 3D audio spatialization.

js:BaseAudioContext:sampleRate.description: The sampleRate property of the BaseAudioContext interface returns a floating point number representing the sample rate, in samples per second, used by all nodes in this audio context. This limitation means that sample-rate converters are not supported.

js:BaseAudioContext:state.description: The state read-only property of the BaseAudioContext interface returns the current state of the AudioContext.

js:BaseAudioContext:createAnalyser.description: The createAnalyser() method of the BaseAudioContext interface creates an AnalyserNode, which can be used to expose audio time and frequency data and create data visualizations.

js:BaseAudioContext:createBiquadFilter.description: The createBiquadFilter() method of the BaseAudioContext interface creates a BiquadFilterNode, which represents a second order filter configurable as several different common filter types.

js:BaseAudioContext:createBuffer.description: The createBuffer() method of the BaseAudioContext Interface is used to create a new, empty AudioBuffer object, which can then be populated by data, and played via an AudioBufferSourceNode.
js:BaseAudioContext:createBuffer.syntax: createBuffer(numberOfChannels: number, length: number, sampleRate: number): AudioBuffer

js:BaseAudioContext:createBufferSource.description: The createBufferSource() method of the BaseAudioContext Interface is used to create a new AudioBufferSourceNode, which can be used to play audio data contained within an AudioBuffer object. AudioBuffers are created using BaseAudioContext.createBuffer or returned by BaseAudioContext.decodeAudioData when it successfully decodes an audio track.

js:BaseAudioContext:createChannelMerger.description: The createChannelMerger() method of the BaseAudioContext interface creates a ChannelMergerNode, which combines channels from multiple audio streams into a single audio stream.

js:BaseAudioContext:createChannelSplitte.description: The createChannelSplitter() method of the BaseAudioContext Interface is used to create a ChannelSplitterNode, which is used to access the individual channels of an audio stream and process them separately.

js:BaseAudioContext:createConstantSource.description: The createConstantSource() property of the BaseAudioContext interface creates a ConstantSourceNode object, which is an audio source that continuously outputs a monaural (one-channel) sound signal whose samples all have the same value.

js:BaseAudioContext:createConvolver.description: The createConvolver() method of the BaseAudioContext interface creates a ConvolverNode, which is commonly used to apply reverb effects to your audio. See the spec definition of Convolution for more information.

js:BaseAudioContext:createDelay.description: The createDelay() method of the BaseAudioContext Interface is used to create a DelayNode, which is used to delay the incoming audio signal by a certain amount of time.

js:BaseAudioContext:createDynamicsCompre.description: The createDynamicsCompressor() method of the BaseAudioContext Interface is used to create a DynamicsCompressorNode, which can be used to apply compression to an audio signal.

js:BaseAudioContext:createGain.description: The createGain() method of the BaseAudioContext interface creates a GainNode, which can be used to control the overall gain (or volume) of the audio graph.

js:BaseAudioContext:createIIRFilter.description: The createIIRFilter() method of the BaseAudioContext interface creates an IIRFilterNode, which represents a general infinite impulse response (IIR) filter which can be configured to serve as various types of filter.

js:BaseAudioContext:createOscillator.description: The createOscillator() method of the BaseAudioContext interface creates an OscillatorNode, a source representing a periodic waveform. It basically generates a constant tone.

js:BaseAudioContext:createPanner.description: The createPanner() method of the BaseAudioContext Interface is used to create a new PannerNode, which is used to spatialize an incoming audio stream in 3D space.

js:BaseAudioContext:createPeriodicWave.description: The createPeriodicWave() method of the BaseAudioContext interface is used to create a PeriodicWave. This wave is used to define a periodic waveform that can be used to shape the output of an OscillatorNode.
js:BaseAudioContext:createPeriodicWave.syntax: createPeriodicWave(real: number[] | Float32Array, imag: number[] | Float32Array, constraints?: PeriodicWaveConstraints): PeriodicWave

js:BaseAudioContext:createScriptProcesso.description:
The createScriptProcessor() method of the BaseAudioContext interface creates a ScriptProcessorNode used for direct audio processing.
@deprecated
js:BaseAudioContext:createScriptProcesso.syntax: createScriptProcessor(bufferSize?: number, numberOfInputChannels?: number, numberOfOutputChannels?: number): ScriptProcessorNode

js:BaseAudioContext:createStereoPanner.description: The createStereoPanner() method of the BaseAudioContext interface creates a StereoPannerNode, which can be used to apply stereo panning to an audio source. It positions an incoming audio stream in a stereo image using a low-cost panning algorithm.

js:BaseAudioContext:createWaveShaper.description: The createWaveShaper() method of the BaseAudioContext interface creates a WaveShaperNode, which represents a non-linear distortion. It is used to apply distortion effects to your audio.

js:BaseAudioContext:decodeAudioData.description: The decodeAudioData() method of the BaseAudioContext Interface is used to asynchronously decode audio file data contained in an ArrayBuffer that is loaded from fetch(), XMLHttpRequest, or FileReader. The decoded AudioBuffer is resampled to the AudioContext's sampling rate, then passed to a callback or promise.
js:BaseAudioContext:decodeAudioData.syntax: decodeAudioData(audioData: ArrayBuffer, successCallback?: DecodeSuccessCallback | null, errorCallback?: DecodeErrorCallback | null): Promise<AudioBuffer>

js:BeforeUnloadEvent:returnValue.description:
The returnValue property of the BeforeUnloadEvent interface, when set to a truthy value, triggers a browser-generated confirmation dialog asking users to confirm if they really want to leave the page when they try to close or reload it, or navigate somewhere else. This is intended to help prevent loss of unsaved data.
@deprecated

js:BiquadFilterNode:Q.description: The Q property of the BiquadFilterNode interface is an a-rate AudioParam, a double representing a Q factor, or quality factor.

js:BiquadFilterNode:detune.description: The detune property of the BiquadFilterNode interface is an a-rate AudioParam representing detuning of the frequency in cents.

js:BiquadFilterNode:frequency.description: The frequency property of the BiquadFilterNode interface is an a-rate AudioParam — a double representing a frequency in the current filtering algorithm measured in hertz (Hz).

js:BiquadFilterNode:gain.description: The gain property of the BiquadFilterNode interface is an a-rate AudioParam — a double representing the gain used in the current filtering algorithm.

js:BiquadFilterNode:type.description: The type property of the BiquadFilterNode interface is a string (enum) value defining the kind of filtering algorithm the node is implementing.

js:BiquadFilterNode:getFrequencyResponse.description: The getFrequencyResponse() method of the BiquadFilterNode interface takes the current filtering algorithm's settings and calculates the frequency response for frequencies specified in a specified array of frequencies.
js:BiquadFilterNode:getFrequencyResponse.syntax: getFrequencyResponse(frequencyHz: Float32Array<ArrayBuffer>, magResponse: Float32Array<ArrayBuffer>, phaseResponse: Float32Array<ArrayBuffer>): void

js:Blob:size.description: The size read-only property of the Blob interface returns the size of the Blob or File in bytes.

js:Blob:type.description: The type read-only property of the Blob interface returns the MIME type of the file.

js:Blob:arrayBuffer.description: The arrayBuffer() method of the Blob interface returns a Promise that resolves with the contents of the blob as binary data contained in an ArrayBuffer.

js:Blob:bytes.description: The bytes() method of the Blob interface returns a Promise that resolves with a Uint8Array containing the contents of the blob as an array of bytes.

js:Blob:slice.description: The slice() method of the Blob interface creates and returns a new Blob object which contains data from a subset of the blob on which it's called.
js:Blob:slice.syntax: slice(start?: number, end?: number, contentType?: string): Blob

js:Blob:stream.description: The stream() method of the Blob interface returns a ReadableStream which upon reading returns the data contained within the Blob.

js:Blob:text.description: The text() method of the Blob interface returns a Promise that resolves with a string containing the contents of the blob, interpreted as UTF-8.

js:BlobEvent:data.description: The data read-only property of the BlobEvent interface represents a Blob associated with the event.

js:BlobEvent:timecode.description: The timecode read-only property of the BlobEvent interface indicates the difference between the timestamp of the first chunk of data, and the timestamp of the first chunk in the first BlobEvent produced by this recorder.

js:Body:body.description: The body read-only property of the Request interface contains a ReadableStream with the body contents that have been added to the request. Note that a request using the GET or HEAD method cannot have a body and null is returned in these cases.

js:Body:bodyUsed.description: The bodyUsed read-only property of the Request interface is a boolean value that indicates whether the request body has been read yet.

js:Body:arrayBuffer.description: The arrayBuffer() method of the Request interface reads the request body and returns it as a promise that resolves with an ArrayBuffer.

js:Body:blob.description: The blob() method of the Request interface reads the request body and returns it as a promise that resolves with a Blob.

js:Body:bytes.description: The bytes() method of the Request interface reads the request body and returns it as a promise that resolves with a Uint8Array.

js:Body:formData.description: The formData() method of the Request interface reads the request body and returns it as a promise that resolves with a FormData object.

js:Body:json.description: The json() method of the Request interface reads the request body and returns it as a promise that resolves with the result of parsing the body text as JSON.

js:Body:text.description: The text() method of the Request interface reads the request body and returns it as a promise that resolves with a String. The response is always decoded using UTF-8.

js:BroadcastChannel:name.description: The name read-only property of the BroadcastChannel interface returns a string, which uniquely identifies the given channel with its name. This name is passed to the BroadcastChannel() constructor at creation time and is therefore read-only.

js:BroadcastChannel:close.description: The close() method of the BroadcastChannel interface terminates the connection to the underlying channel, allowing the object to be garbage collected. This is a necessary step to perform as there is no other way for a browser to know that this channel is not needed anymore.

js:BroadcastChannel:postMessage.description: The postMessage() method of the BroadcastChannel interface sends a message, which can be of any kind of Object, to each listener in any browsing context with the same origin. The message is transmitted as a message event targeted at each BroadcastChannel bound to the channel.

js:ByteLengthQueuingStrategy:highWaterMa.description: The read-only ByteLengthQueuingStrategy.highWaterMark property returns the total number of bytes that can be contained in the internal queue before backpressure is applied.

js:CSSAnimation:animationName.description: The animationName property of the CSSAnimation interface returns the animation-name. This specifies one or more keyframe at-rules which describe the animation applied to the element.

js:CSSConditionRule:conditionText.description: The read-only conditionText property of the CSSConditionRule interface returns or sets the text of the CSS rule.

js:CSSContainerRule:containerName.description: The read-only containerName property of the CSSContainerRule interface represents the container name of the associated CSS @container at-rule.

js:CSSContainerRule:containerQuery.description: The read-only containerQuery property of the CSSContainerRule interface returns a string representing the container conditions that are evaluated when the container changes size in order to determine if the styles in the associated @container are applied.

js:CSSCounterStyleRule:additiveSymbols.description: The additiveSymbols property of the CSSCounterStyleRule interface gets and sets the value of the additive-symbols descriptor. If the descriptor does not have a value set, this attribute returns an empty string.

js:CSSCounterStyleRule:fallback.description: The fallback property of the CSSCounterStyleRule interface gets and sets the value of the fallback descriptor. If the descriptor does not have a value set, this attribute returns an empty string.

js:CSSCounterStyleRule:name.description: The name property of the CSSCounterStyleRule interface gets and sets the <custom-ident> defined as the name for the associated rule.

js:CSSCounterStyleRule:negative.description: The negative property of the CSSCounterStyleRule interface gets and sets the value of the negative descriptor. If the descriptor does not have a value set, this attribute returns an empty string.

js:CSSCounterStyleRule:pad.description: The pad property of the CSSCounterStyleRule interface gets and sets the value of the pad descriptor. If the descriptor does not have a value set, this attribute returns an empty string.

js:CSSCounterStyleRule:prefix.description: The prefix property of the CSSCounterStyleRule interface gets and sets the value of the prefix descriptor. If the descriptor does not have a value set, this attribute returns an empty string.

js:CSSCounterStyleRule:range.description: The range property of the CSSCounterStyleRule interface gets and sets the value of the range descriptor. If the descriptor does not have a value set, this attribute returns an empty string.

js:CSSCounterStyleRule:speakAs.description: The speakAs property of the CSSCounterStyleRule interface gets and sets the value of the speak-as descriptor. If the descriptor does not have a value set, this attribute returns an empty string.

js:CSSCounterStyleRule:suffix.description: The suffix property of the CSSCounterStyleRule interface gets and sets the value of the suffix descriptor. If the descriptor does not have a value set, this attribute returns an empty string.

js:CSSCounterStyleRule:symbols.description: The symbols property of the CSSCounterStyleRule interface gets and sets the value of the symbols descriptor. If the descriptor does not have a value set, this attribute returns an empty string.

js:CSSCounterStyleRule:system.description: The system property of the CSSCounterStyleRule interface gets and sets the value of the system descriptor. If the descriptor does not have a value set, this attribute returns an empty string.

js:CSSFontFaceRule:get.description: The read-only style property of the CSSFontFaceRule interface returns a CSSFontFaceDescriptors object representing the descriptors available in the @font-face rule's body.

js:CSSFontFeatureValuesRule:fontFamily.description: The fontFamily property of the CSSFontFeatureValuesRule interface represents the name of the font family it applies to.

js:CSSFontPaletteValuesRule:basePalette.description: The read-only basePalette property of the CSSFontPaletteValuesRule interface indicates the base palette associated with the rule.

js:CSSFontPaletteValuesRule:fontFamily.description: The read-only fontFamily property of the CSSFontPaletteValuesRule interface lists the font families the rule can be applied to. The font families must be named families; generic families like courier are not valid.

js:CSSFontPaletteValuesRule:name.description: The read-only name property of the CSSFontPaletteValuesRule interface represents the name identifying the associated @font-palette-values at-rule. A valid name always starts with two dashes, such as --Alternate.

js:CSSFontPaletteValuesRule:overrideColo.description: The read-only overrideColors property of the CSSFontPaletteValuesRule interface is a string containing a list of color index and color pair that are to be used instead. It is specified in the same format as the corresponding override-colors descriptor.

js:CSSGroupingRule:cssRules.description: The cssRules property of the CSSGroupingRule interface returns a CSSRuleList containing a collection of CSSRule objects.

js:CSSGroupingRule:deleteRule.description: The deleteRule() method of the CSSGroupingRule interface removes a CSS rule from a list of child CSS rules.

js:CSSGroupingRule:insertRule.description: The insertRule() method of the CSSGroupingRule interface adds a new CSS rule to a list of CSS rules.

js:CSSImportRule:href.description: The read-only href property of the CSSImportRule interface returns the URL specified by the @import at-rule.

js:CSSImportRule:layerName.description: The read-only layerName property of the CSSImportRule interface returns the name of the cascade layer created by the @import at-rule.

js:CSSImportRule:get.description: The read-only media property of the CSSImportRule interface returns a MediaList object representing the media query list of the @import rule.

js:CSSImportRule:styleSheet.description: The read-only styleSheet property of the CSSImportRule interface returns the CSS Stylesheet specified by the @import at-rule. This will be in the form of a CSSStyleSheet object.

js:CSSImportRule:supportsText.description: The read-only supportsText property of the CSSImportRule interface returns the supports condition specified by the @import at-rule.

js:CSSKeyframeRule:keyText.description: The keyText property of the CSSKeyframeRule interface represents the keyframe selector as a comma-separated list of percentage values. The from and to keywords map to 0% and 100%, respectively.

js:CSSKeyframeRule:get.description: The read-only style property of the CSSKeyframeRule interface contains a CSSStyleDeclaration object representing the descriptors available in the @keyframes rule's body.

js:CSSKeyframesRule:cssRules.description: The read-only cssRules property of the CSSKeyframeRule interface returns a CSSRuleList containing the rules in the keyframes at-rule.

js:CSSKeyframesRule:length.description: The read-only length property of the CSSKeyframesRule interface returns the number of CSSKeyframeRule objects in its list. You can then access each keyframe rule by its index directly on the CSSKeyframeRule object.

js:CSSKeyframesRule:name.description: The name property of the CSSKeyframeRule interface gets and sets the name of the animation as used by the animation-name property.

js:CSSKeyframesRule:appendRule.description: The appendRule() method of the CSSKeyframeRule interface appends a CSSKeyFrameRule to the end of the rules.

js:CSSKeyframesRule:deleteRule.description: The deleteRule() method of the CSSKeyframeRule interface deletes the CSSKeyFrameRule that matches the specified keyframe selector.

js:CSSKeyframesRule:findRule.description: The findRule() method of the CSSKeyframeRule interface finds the CSSKeyFrameRule that matches the specified keyframe selector.

js:CSSKeywordValue:value.description: The value property of the CSSKeywordValue interface returns or sets the value of the CSSKeywordValue.

js:CSSLayerBlockRule:name.description: The read-only name property of the CSSLayerBlockRule interface represents the name of the associated cascade layer.

js:CSSLayerStatementRule:nameList.description: The read-only nameList property of the CSSLayerStatementRule interface return the list of associated cascade layer names. The names can't be modified.

js:CSSMathClamp:lower.description: The lower read-only property of the CSSMathClamp interface returns a CSSNumericValue object containing the minimum value of a CSSMathClamp object.

js:CSSMathClamp:upper.description: The upper read-only property of the CSSMathClamp interface returns a CSSNumericValue object containing the maximum value of a CSSMathClamp object.

js:CSSMathClamp:value.description: The value read-only property of the CSSMathClamp interface returns a CSSNumericValue object containing the preferred value of a CSSMathClamp object.

js:CSSMathInvert:value.description: The CSSMathInvert.value read-only property of the CSSMathInvert interface returns a CSSNumericValue object.

js:CSSMathMax:values.description: The CSSMathMax.values read-only property of the CSSMathMax interface returns a CSSNumericArray object which contains one or more CSSNumericValue objects.

js:CSSMathMin:values.description: The CSSMathMin.values read-only property of the CSSMathMin interface returns a CSSNumericArray object which contains one or more CSSNumericValue objects.

js:CSSMathNegate:value.description: The CSSMathNegate.value read-only property of the CSSMathNegate interface returns a CSSNumericValue object.

js:CSSMathProduct:values.description: The CSSMathProduct.values read-only property of the CSSMathProduct interface returns a CSSNumericArray object which contains one or more CSSNumericValue objects.

js:CSSMathSum:values.description: The CSSMathSum.values read-only property of the CSSMathSum interface returns a CSSNumericArray object which contains one or more CSSNumericValue objects.

js:CSSMathValue:operator.description: The CSSMathValue.operator read-only property of the CSSMathValue interface indicates the operator that the current subtype represents. For example, if the current CSSMathValue subtype is CSSMathSum, this property will return the string "sum".

js:CSSMatrixComponent:matrix.description: The matrix property of the CSSMatrixComponent interface gets and sets a 2d or 3d matrix.

js:CSSMediaRule:get.description: The read-only media property of the CSSMediaRule interface contains a MediaList object representing the media query list of the @media rule.

js:CSSNamespaceRule:namespaceURI.description: The read-only namespaceURI property of the CSSNamespaceRule returns a string containing the text of the URI of the given namespace.

js:CSSNamespaceRule:prefix.description: The read-only prefix property of the CSSNamespaceRule returns a string with the name of the prefix associated to this namespace. If there is no such prefix, it returns an empty string.

js:CSSNestedDeclarations:get.description: The read-only style property of the CSSNestedDeclarations interface represents the styles associated with the nested rules.

js:CSSNumericArray:length.description: The read-only length property of the CSSNumericArray interface returns the number of CSSNumericValue objects in the list.

js:CSSNumericValue:add.description: The add() method of the CSSNumericValue interface adds a supplied number to the CSSNumericValue.

js:CSSNumericValue:div.description: The div() method of the CSSNumericValue interface divides the CSSNumericValue by the supplied value.

js:CSSNumericValue:equals.description: The equals() method of the CSSNumericValue interface returns a boolean indicating whether the passed value are strictly equal. To return a value of true, all passed values must be of the same type and value and must be in the same order. This allows structural equality to be tested quickly.

js:CSSNumericValue:max.description: The max() method of the CSSNumericValue interface returns the highest value from among the values passed. The passed values must be of the same type.

js:CSSNumericValue:min.description: The min() method of the CSSNumericValue interface returns the lowest value from among those values passed. The passed values must be of the same type.

js:CSSNumericValue:mul.description: The mul() method of the CSSNumericValue interface multiplies the CSSNumericValue by the supplied value.

js:CSSNumericValue:sub.description: The sub() method of the CSSNumericValue interface subtracts a supplied number from the CSSNumericValue.

js:CSSNumericValue:to.description: The to() method of the CSSNumericValue interface converts a numeric value from one unit to another.

js:CSSNumericValue:toSum.description: The toSum() method of the CSSNumericValue interface converts the object's value to a CSSMathSum object to values of the specified unit.

js:CSSNumericValue:type.description: The type() method of the CSSNumericValue interface returns the type of CSSNumericValue, one of angle, flex, frequency, length, resolution, percent, percentHint, or time.

js:CSSPageRule:selectorText.description: The selectorText property of the CSSPageRule interface gets and sets the selectors associated with the CSSPageRule.

js:CSSPageRule:get.description: The read-only style property of the CSSPageRule interface contains a CSSPageDescriptors object representing the descriptors available in the @page rule's body.

js:CSSPerspective:length.description: The length property of the CSSPerspective interface sets the distance from z=0.

js:CSSPositionTryRule:name.description: The name read-only property of the CSSPositionTryRule interface represents the name of the position try fallback option specified by the @position-try at-rule's <dashed-ident>.

js:CSSPositionTryRule:get.description: The read-only style property of the CSSPositionTryRule interface contains a CSSPositionTryDescriptors object representing the descriptors available in the @position-try rule's body.

js:CSSPropertyRule:inherits.description: The read-only inherits property of the CSSPropertyRule interface returns the inherit flag of the custom property registration represented by the @property rule, a boolean describing whether or not the property inherits by default.

js:CSSPropertyRule:initialValue.description: The read-only initialValue nullable property of the CSSPropertyRule interface returns the initial value of the custom property registration represented by the @property rule, controlling the property's initial value.

js:CSSPropertyRule:name.description: The read-only name property of the CSSPropertyRule interface represents the property name, this being the serialization of the name given to the custom property in the @property rule's prelude.

js:CSSPropertyRule:syntax.description: The read-only syntax property of the CSSPropertyRule interface returns the literal syntax of the custom property registration represented by the @property rule, controlling how the property's value is parsed at computed-value time.

js:CSSRotate:angle.description: The angle property of the CSSRotate interface gets and sets the angle of rotation. A positive angle denotes a clockwise rotation, a negative angle a counter-clockwise one.

js:CSSRotate:x.description: The x property of the CSSRotate interface gets and sets the abscissa or x-axis of the translating vector.

js:CSSRotate:y.description: The y property of the CSSRotate interface gets and sets the ordinate or y-axis of the translating vector.

js:CSSRotate:z.description: The z property of the CSSRotate interface representing the z-component of the translating vector. A positive value moves the element towards the viewer, and a negative value farther away.

js:CSSRule:cssText.description: The cssText property of the CSSRule interface returns the actual text of a CSSStyleSheet style-rule.

js:CSSRule:parentRule.description: The parentRule property of the CSSRule interface returns the containing rule of the current rule if this exists, or otherwise returns null.

js:CSSRule:parentStyleSheet.description: The parentStyleSheet property of the CSSRule interface returns the StyleSheet object in which the current rule is defined.

js:CSSRule:type.description:
The read-only type property of the CSSRule interface is a deprecated property that returns an integer indicating which type of rule the CSSRule represents.
@deprecated

js:CSSRuleList:length.description: The length property of the CSSRuleList interface returns the number of CSSRule objects in the list.

js:CSSRuleList:item.description: The item() method of the CSSRuleList interface returns the CSSRule object at the specified index or null if the specified index doesn't exist.

js:CSSScale:x.description: The x property of the CSSScale interface gets and sets the abscissa or x-axis of the translating vector.

js:CSSScale:y.description: The y property of the CSSScale interface gets and sets the ordinate or y-axis of the translating vector.

js:CSSScale:z.description: The z property of the CSSScale interface representing the z-component of the translating vector. A positive value moves the element towards the viewer, and a negative value farther away.

js:CSSScopeRule:end.description: The end property of the CSSScopeRule interface returns a string containing the value of the @scope at-rule's scope limit.

js:CSSScopeRule:start.description: The start property of the CSSScopeRule interface returns a string containing the value of the @scope at-rule's scope root.

js:CSSSkew:ax.description: The ax property of the CSSSkew interface gets and sets the angle used to distort the element along the x-axis (or abscissa).

js:CSSSkew:ay.description: The ay property of the CSSSkew interface gets and sets the angle used to distort the element along the y-axis (or ordinate).

js:CSSSkewX:ax.description: The ax property of the CSSSkewX interface gets and sets the angle used to distort the element along the x-axis (or abscissa).

js:CSSSkewY:ay.description: The ay property of the CSSSkewY interface gets and sets the angle used to distort the element along the y-axis (or ordinate).

js:CSSStyleDeclarationBase:cssText.description: The cssText property of the CSSStyleDeclaration interface returns or sets the text of the element's inline style declaration only.

js:CSSStyleDeclarationBase:length.description: The read-only property returns an integer that represents the number of style declarations in this CSS declaration block.

js:CSSStyleDeclarationBase:parentRule.description: The CSSStyleDeclaration.parentRule read-only property returns a CSSRule that is the parent of this style block, e.g., a CSSStyleRule representing the style for a CSS selector.

js:CSSStyleDeclarationBase:getPropertyPr.description: The CSSStyleDeclaration.getPropertyPriority() method interface returns a string that provides all explicitly set priorities on the CSS property.

js:CSSStyleDeclarationBase:getPropertyVa.description: The CSSStyleDeclaration.getPropertyValue() method interface returns a string containing the value of a specified CSS property.

js:CSSStyleDeclarationBase:item.description: The CSSStyleDeclaration.item() method interface returns a CSS property name from a CSSStyleDeclaration by index.

js:CSSStyleDeclarationBase:removePropert.description: The CSSStyleDeclaration.removeProperty() method interface removes a property from a CSS style declaration object.

js:CSSStyleDeclarationBase:setProperty.description: The CSSStyleDeclaration.setProperty() method interface sets a new value for a property on a CSS style declaration object.
js:CSSStyleDeclarationBase:setProperty.syntax: setProperty(property: string, value: string | null, priority?: string): void

js:CSSStyleProperties:accentColor.description: The accent-color CSS property sets the accent color for user-interface controls generated by some elements.

js:CSSStyleProperties:alignContent.description: The CSS align-content property sets the distribution of space between and around content items along a flexbox's cross axis, or a grid or block-level element's block axis.

js:CSSStyleProperties:alignItems.description: The CSS align-items property sets the align-self value on all direct children as a group. In flexbox, it controls the alignment of items on the cross axis. In grid layout, it controls the alignment of items on the block axis within their grid areas.

js:CSSStyleProperties:alignSelf.description: The align-self CSS property overrides a grid or flex item's align-items value. In grid, it aligns the item inside the grid area. In flexbox, it aligns the item on the cross axis.

js:CSSStyleProperties:alignmentBaseline.description: The alignment-baseline CSS property specifies the specific baseline used to align the box's text and inline-level contents. Baseline alignment is the relationship among the baselines of multiple alignment subjects within an alignment context. When performing baseline alignment, the alignment-baseline property value specifies which baseline of the box is aligned to the corresponding baseline of its alignment context.

js:CSSStyleProperties:all.description: The all shorthand CSS property resets all of an element's properties except unicode-bidi, direction, and CSS Custom Properties. It can set properties to their initial or inherited values, or to the values specified in another cascade layer or stylesheet origin.

js:CSSStyleProperties:anchorName.description: The anchor-name CSS property enables defining an element as an anchor element by giving it one or more identifying anchor names. Each name can then be set as the value of a positioned element's position-anchor property to associate it with the anchor.

js:CSSStyleProperties:anchorScope.description: The anchor-scope CSS property can be used to limit the scope in which a positioned element can be associated with anchor elements to a particular subtree.

js:CSSStyleProperties:animation.description: The animation shorthand CSS property applies an animation between styles. It is a shorthand for animation-name, animation-duration, animation-timing-function, animation-delay, animation-iteration-count, animation-direction, animation-fill-mode, animation-play-state, and animation-timeline.

js:CSSStyleProperties:animationCompositi.description: The animation-composition CSS property specifies the composite operation to use when multiple animations affect the same property simultaneously.

js:CSSStyleProperties:animationDelay.description: The animation-delay CSS property specifies the amount of time to wait from applying the animation to an element before beginning to perform the animation. The animation can start later, immediately from its beginning, or immediately and partway through the animation.

js:CSSStyleProperties:animationDirection.description: The animation-direction CSS property sets whether an animation should play forward, backward, or alternate back and forth between playing the sequence forward and backward.

js:CSSStyleProperties:animationDuration.description: The animation-duration CSS property sets the length of time that an animation takes to complete one cycle.

js:CSSStyleProperties:animationFillMode.description: The animation-fill-mode CSS property sets how a CSS animation applies styles to its target before and after its execution.

js:CSSStyleProperties:animationIteration.description: The animation-iteration-count CSS property sets the number of times an animation sequence should be played before stopping.

js:CSSStyleProperties:animationName.description: The animation-name CSS property specifies the names of one or more @keyframes at-rules that describe the animation to apply to an element. Multiple @keyframes at-rules are specified as a comma-separated list of names. If the specified name does not match any @keyframes at-rule, no properties are animated.

js:CSSStyleProperties:animationPlayState.description: The animation-play-state CSS property sets whether an animation is running or paused.

js:CSSStyleProperties:animationRange.description: The animation-range CSS shorthand property is used to set the start and end of an animation's attachment range along its timeline, i.e., where along the timeline an animation will start and end.

js:CSSStyleProperties:animationRangeEnd.description: The animation-range-end CSS property sets the point on the timeline where an animation should end.

js:CSSStyleProperties:animationRangeStar.description: The animation-range-start CSS property sets the point on the timeline where an animation should start.

js:CSSStyleProperties:animationTimeline.description: The animation-timeline CSS property specifies the timeline used to control the progress of a CSS animation.

js:CSSStyleProperties:animationTimingFun.description: The animation-timing-function CSS property sets how an animation progresses through the duration of each cycle.

js:CSSStyleProperties:appearance.description: The appearance CSS property specifies the rendered appearance of replaced UI widget elements such as form controls. Most commonly, such elements are given native, platform-specific styling based on the operating system's theme, or a primitive appearance with styles that can be overridden using CSS.

js:CSSStyleProperties:aspectRatio.description: The aspect-ratio CSS property allows you to define the desired width-to-height ratio of an element's box. This means that even if the parent container or viewport size changes, the browser will adjust the element's dimensions to maintain the specified width-to-height ratio. The specified aspect ratio is used in the calculation of auto sizes and some other layout functions.

js:CSSStyleProperties:backdropFilter.description: The backdrop-filter CSS property lets you apply graphical effects such as blurring or color shifting to the area behind an element. Because it applies to everything behind the element, to see the effect the element or its background needs to be transparent or partially transparent.

js:CSSStyleProperties:backfaceVisibility.description: The backface-visibility CSS property sets whether the back face of an element is visible when turned towards the user.

js:CSSStyleProperties:background.description: The background shorthand CSS property sets all background style properties at once, such as color, image, origin, size, and repeat method.

js:CSSStyleProperties:backgroundAttachme.description: The background-attachment CSS property sets whether a background image's position is fixed within the viewport, or scrolls with its containing block.

js:CSSStyleProperties:backgroundBlendMod.description: The background-blend-mode CSS property sets how an element's background images should blend with each other and with the element's background color.

js:CSSStyleProperties:backgroundClip.description: The background-clip CSS property sets whether an element's background extends underneath its border box, padding box, or content box.

js:CSSStyleProperties:backgroundColor.description: The background-color CSS property sets the background color of an element.

js:CSSStyleProperties:backgroundImage.description: The background-image CSS property sets one or more background images on an element.

js:CSSStyleProperties:backgroundOrigin.description: The background-origin CSS property sets the background's origin: from the border start, inside the border, or inside the padding.

js:CSSStyleProperties:backgroundPosition.description: The background-position CSS property sets the initial position for each background image. The position is relative to the position layer set by background-origin.
The background-position-x CSS property sets the initial horizontal position for each background image. The position is relative to the position layer set by background-origin.
The background-position-y CSS property sets the initial vertical position for each background image. The position is relative to the position layer set by background-origin.

js:CSSStyleProperties:backgroundRepeat.description: The background-repeat CSS property sets how background images are repeated. A background image can be repeated along the horizontal and vertical axes, or not repeated at all.

js:CSSStyleProperties:backgroundSize.description: The background-size CSS property sets the size of the element's background image. The image can be left to its natural size, stretched, or constrained to fit the available space.

js:CSSStyleProperties:baselineShift.description: The baseline-shift CSS property repositions the dominant-baseline of a text element relative to the dominant-baseline of its parent text content element. The shifted element might be a sub- or superscript. If the property is present, the value overrides the element's baseline-shift attribute.

js:CSSStyleProperties:baselineSource.description: The baseline-source CSS property defines which baseline to use when inline-level boxes have multiple possible baselines, such as multi-line inline blocks or inline flex containers. The values allow for choosing between aligning to the box's first baseline, last baseline, or letting the browser decide automatically based on the box type.

js:CSSStyleProperties:blockSize.description: The block-size CSS property defines the size of an element's block along the block axis. If the writing-mode is horizontal, it corresponds to the height; if the writing mode is vertical, it corresponds to the width. A related property is inline-size, which defines the other dimension of the element.

js:CSSStyleProperties:border.description: The border shorthand CSS property sets an element's border. It sets the values of border-width, border-style, and border-color.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderBlock.description: The border-block CSS property is a shorthand property for setting the individual logical block border property values in a single place in the style sheet.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderBlockColor.description: The border-block-color CSS property defines the color of the logical block borders of an element, which maps to a physical border color depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-color and border-bottom-color, or border-right-color and border-left-color property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderBlockEnd.description: The border-block-end CSS property is a shorthand property for setting the individual logical block-end border property values in a single place in the style sheet.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderBlockEndColo.description: The border-block-end-color CSS property defines the color of the logical block-end border of an element, which maps to a physical border color depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-color, border-right-color, border-bottom-color, or border-left-color property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderBlockEndStyl.description: The border-block-end-style CSS property defines the style of the logical block-end border of an element, which maps to a physical border style depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-style, border-right-style, border-bottom-style, or border-left-style property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderBlockEndWidt.description: The border-block-end-width CSS property defines the width of the logical block-end border of an element, which maps to a physical border width depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-width, border-right-width, border-bottom-width, or border-left-width property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderBlockStart.description: The border-block-start CSS property is a shorthand property for setting the individual logical block-start border property values in a single place in the style sheet.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderBlockStartCo.description: The border-block-start-color CSS property defines the color of the logical block-start border of an element, which maps to a physical border color depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-color, border-right-color, border-bottom-color, or border-left-color property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderBlockStartSt.description: The border-block-start-style CSS property defines the style of the logical block start border of an element, which maps to a physical border style depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-style, border-right-style, border-bottom-style, or border-left-style property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderBlockStartWi.description: The border-block-start-width CSS property defines the width of the logical block-start border of an element, which maps to a physical border width depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-width, border-right-width, border-bottom-width, or border-left-width property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderBlockStyle.description: The border-block-style CSS property defines the style of the logical block borders of an element, which maps to a physical border style depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-style and border-bottom-style, or border-left-style and border-right-style properties depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderBlockWidth.description: The border-block-width CSS property defines the width of the logical block borders of an element, which maps to a physical border width depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-width and border-bottom-width, or border-left-width, and border-right-width property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderBottom.description: The border-bottom shorthand CSS property sets an element's bottom border. It sets the values of border-bottom-width, border-bottom-style and border-bottom-color.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderBottomColor.description: The border-bottom-color CSS property sets the color of an element's bottom border. It can also be set with the shorthand CSS properties border-color or border-bottom.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderBottomLeftRa.description: The border-bottom-left-radius CSS property rounds the bottom-left corner of an element by specifying the radius (or the radius of the semi-major and semi-minor axes) of the ellipse defining the curvature of the corner.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderBottomRightR.description: The border-bottom-right-radius CSS property rounds the bottom-right corner of an element by specifying the radius (or the radius of the semi-major and semi-minor axes) of the ellipse defining the curvature of the corner.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderBottomStyle.description: The border-bottom-style CSS property sets the line style of an element's bottom border.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderBottomWidth.description: The border-bottom-width CSS property sets the width of the bottom border of an element.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderCollapse.description: The border-collapse CSS property sets whether cells inside a <table> have shared or separate borders.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderColor.description: The border-color shorthand CSS property sets the color of an element's border.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderEndEndRadius.description: The border-end-end-radius CSS property defines a logical border radius on an element, which maps to a physical border radius that depends on the element's writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation. This is useful when building styles to work regardless of the text orientation and writing mode.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderEndStartRadi.description: The border-end-start-radius CSS property defines a logical border radius on an element, which maps to a physical border radius depending on the element's writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation. This is useful when building styles to work regardless of the text orientation and writing mode.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderImage.description: The border-image CSS property draws an image around a given element. It replaces the element's regular border.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderImageOutset.description: The border-image-outset CSS property sets the distance by which an element's border image is set out from its border box.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderImageRepeat.description: The border-image-repeat CSS property defines how the images for the sides and the middle part of the border image are scaled and tiled. The middle region can be displayed by using the keyword "fill" in the border-image-slice property.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderImageSlice.description: The border-image-slice CSS property divides the image specified by border-image-source into regions. These regions form the components of an element's border image.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderImageSource.description: The border-image-source CSS property sets the source image used to create an element's border image.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderImageWidth.description: The border-image-width CSS property sets the width of an element's border image.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderInline.description: The border-inline CSS property is a shorthand property for setting the individual logical inline border property values in a single place in the style sheet.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderInlineColor.description: The border-inline-color CSS property defines the color of the logical inline borders of an element, which maps to a physical border color depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-color and border-bottom-color, or border-right-color and border-left-color property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderInlineEnd.description: The border-inline-end CSS property is a shorthand property for setting the individual logical inline-end border property values in a single place in the style sheet.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderInlineEndCol.description: The border-inline-end-color CSS property defines the color of the logical inline-end border of an element, which maps to a physical border color depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-color, border-right-color, border-bottom-color, or border-left-color property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderInlineEndSty.description: The border-inline-end-style CSS property defines the style of the logical inline end border of an element, which maps to a physical border style depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-style, border-right-style, border-bottom-style, or border-left-style property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderInlineEndWid.description: The border-inline-end-width CSS property defines the width of the logical inline-end border of an element, which maps to a physical border width depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-width, border-right-width, border-bottom-width, or border-left-width property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderInlineStart.description: The border-inline-start CSS property is a shorthand property for setting the individual logical inline-start border property values in a single place in the style sheet.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderInlineStartC.description: The border-inline-start-color CSS property defines the color of the logical inline start border of an element, which maps to a physical border color depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-color, border-right-color, border-bottom-color, or border-left-color property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderInlineStartS.description: The border-inline-start-style CSS property defines the style of the logical inline start border of an element, which maps to a physical border style depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-style, border-right-style, border-bottom-style, or border-left-style property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderInlineStartW.description: The border-inline-start-width CSS property defines the width of the logical inline-start border of an element, which maps to a physical border width depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-width, border-right-width, border-bottom-width, or border-left-width property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderInlineStyle.description: The border-inline-style CSS property defines the style of the logical inline borders of an element, which maps to a physical border style depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-style and border-bottom-style, or border-left-style and border-right-style properties depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderInlineWidth.description: The border-inline-width CSS property defines the width of the logical inline borders of an element, which maps to a physical border width depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-width and border-bottom-width, or border-left-width, and border-right-width property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderLeft.description: The border-left shorthand CSS property sets all the properties of an element's left border.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderLeftColor.description: The border-left-color CSS property sets the color of an element's left border. It can also be set with the shorthand CSS properties border-color or border-left.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderLeftStyle.description: The border-left-style CSS property sets the line style of an element's left border.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderLeftWidth.description: The border-left-width CSS property sets the width of the left border of an element.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderRadius.description: The border-radius CSS property rounds the corners of an element's outer border edge. You can set a single radius to make circular corners, or two radii to make elliptical corners.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderRight.description: The border-right shorthand CSS property sets all the properties of an element's right border.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderRightColor.description: The border-right-color CSS property sets the color of an element's right border. It can also be set with the shorthand CSS properties border-color or border-right.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderRightStyle.description: The border-right-style CSS property sets the line style of an element's right border.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderRightWidth.description: The border-right-width CSS property sets the width of the right border of an element.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderSpacing.description: The border-spacing CSS property sets the distance between the borders of adjacent cells in a <table>. This property applies only when border-collapse is separate.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderStartEndRadi.description: The border-start-end-radius CSS property defines a logical border radius on an element, which maps to a physical border radius depending on the element's writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation. This is useful when building styles to work regardless of the text orientation and writing mode.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderStartStartRa.description: The border-start-start-radius CSS property defines a logical border radius on an element, which maps to a physical border radius that depends on the element's writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation. This is useful when building styles to work regardless of the text orientation and writing mode.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderStyle.description: The border-style shorthand CSS property sets the line style for all four sides of an element's border.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderTop.description: The border-top shorthand CSS property sets all the properties of an element's top border.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderTopColor.description: The border-top-color CSS property sets the color of an element's top border. It can also be set with the shorthand CSS properties border-color or border-top.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderTopLeftRadiu.description: The border-top-left-radius CSS property rounds the top-left corner of an element by specifying the radius (or the radius of the semi-major and semi-minor axes) of the ellipse defining the curvature of the corner.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderTopRightRadi.description: The border-top-right-radius CSS property rounds the top-right corner of an element by specifying the radius (or the radius of the semi-major and semi-minor axes) of the ellipse defining the curvature of the corner.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderTopStyle.description: The border-top-style CSS property sets the line style of an element's top border.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderTopWidth.description: The border-top-width CSS property sets the width of the top border of an element.

js:CSSStyleProperties:borderWidth.description: The border-width shorthand CSS property sets the width of an element's border.

js:CSSStyleProperties:bottom.description: The bottom CSS property participates in setting the vertical position of a positioned element. This inset property has no effect on non-positioned elements.

js:CSSStyleProperties:boxDecorationBreak.description: The box-decoration-break CSS property specifies how an element's fragments should be rendered when broken across multiple lines, columns, or pages.
